sql_infos.sql: SELECT c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN member m ON s.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1982.23 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND r.region_no = 5 GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(s.statement_amt) > 236316.73 ORDER BY total_statement DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c LEFT JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no LEFT JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt < '1990-01-01' AND (m.lastname LIKE 'A%' OR m.lastname IS NULL) GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 94129.42 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS distinct_providers FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 999.04 GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) > 56 ORDER BY distinct_members DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4848.23 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9775.53 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 35551.1 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2242.35 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 334363.91 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6580.63 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > (SELECT AVG(charge_amt) FROM charge WHERE charge_amt > 2599.24) ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 72876.12 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 26.17 GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 7416.96 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE c.category_desc LIKE '%Health%' GROUP BY c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, COUNT(s.statement_no) AS statement_count, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge, MAX(p.payment_dt) AS latest_payment, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS latest_statement, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, SUM(ch.charge_amt - COALESCE(p.payment_amt, 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.statement_amt) DESC) AS statement_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.category_no) AS category_dense_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_row FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 110.74 AND p.payment_amt > 8496.78 AND s.statement_amt > 7971.88 GROUP BY c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_no, m.region_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 16113.08 AND COUNT(*) > 361.55 INTERSECT SELECT c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, COUNT(s.statement_no) AS statement_count, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge, MAX(p.payment_dt) AS latest_payment, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS latest_statement, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, SUM(ch.charge_amt - COALESCE(p.payment_amt, 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.statement_amt) DESC) AS statement_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.category_no) AS category_dense_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_row FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_no, m.region_no HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 91922.98 AND COUNT(p.payment_no) > 796.56 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC, total_statements DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, m.region_no, m.corp_no, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no ORDER BY c.category_no ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_charges_by_region FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3355.67 AND p.payment_amt > 4114.04 AND s.statement_amt > 6007.12 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 34561.87 AND m.prev_balance > 1037.71 GROUP BY c.category_desc, m.region_no, m.corp_no, c.category_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 1410.06 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, m.region_no, m.corp_no, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no ORDER BY c.category_no ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_charges_by_region FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8153.28 AND p.payment_amt > 9343.93 AND s.statement_amt > 2115.25 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 8724.11 AND m.prev_balance > 40175.76 GROUP BY c.category_desc, m.region_no, m.corp_no, c.category_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 35143.77 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, m.region_no, m.corp_no, p.region_no, p.provider_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge, AVG(pay.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, MAX(s.statement_amt) AS max_statement_amt, MIN(s.due_dt) AS earliest_due_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_desc ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(pay.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no, m.corp_no) AS member_count_per_corp FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment pay ON m.member_no = pay.member_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND pay.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN corporation cor ON m.corp_no = cor.corp_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no AND p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.statement_dt::DATE) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ch.charge_dt::DATE) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.statement_dt::DATE) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ch.charge_dt::DATE) + 1 GROUP BY c.category_desc, m.region_no, m.corp_no, p.region_no, p.provider_name, r.region_name, cor.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 288260.79 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 43 ORDER BY total_charge DESC, avg_payment ASC;

SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN region r ON co.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((c.category_desc, r.region_name), (c.category_desc), ()) ORDER BY c.category_desc, r.region_name;

SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(pm.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(pm.payment_amt), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0), 2) AS payment_coverage_percent, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ch.provider_no ORDER BY MIN(ch.charge_dt)) AS prev_provider_charge_total FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation cr ON m.corp_no = cr.corp_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON s.statement_no = pm.statement_no AND s.member_no = pm.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt < '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_amt > 29254.53 AND ch.charge_amt BETWEEN 7532.13 AND 4568.01 AND p.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name, r.region_no, ch.provider_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 22532.61 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 430 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, region_charge_rank;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND r.region_no IN (SELECT region_no FROM provider WHERE provider_code = 'A') GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 186.03 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM statement s WHERE s.member_no = ch.member_no AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' ) GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 75199.17 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 7280.83 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_amt > 681.9) GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 37639.1 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3583.14 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment py WHERE py.member_no = m.member_no AND py.payment_dt >= '2000-01-01' ) GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 61669.57 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS unique_providers, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6603.63 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS unique_providers, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8448.08 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 178.03 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 39868.34 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = ch.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS recent_payments_count FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND r.region_no = 569 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc, ch.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 18388.81 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_per_statement FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND s.due_dt < '1992-02-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 67420.59 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, CASE WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 6061.94 THEN 'High' WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) BETWEEN 3159.39 AND 1636.61 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS charge_category FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE r.region_no = 7 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 3009.12 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.charge_amt, c.charge_code, s.statement_code, m.member_code, p.provider_code, cat.category_code, SUM(c.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY s.statement_code ORDER BY c.charge_dt ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 9778.7) AS sub1) AS high_pay_member_count FROM charge c JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN member m ON c.member_no = m.member_no JOIN provider p ON c.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 1318.42 AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.charge_amt, c.charge_code, s.statement_code, m.member_code, p.provider_code, cat.category_code, c.charge_dt HAVING COUNT(c.charge_no) > 5.72 ORDER BY running_total DESC;

SELECT c.member_no, c.lastname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_count FROM member c JOIN charge ch ON c.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no JOIN region r ON pv.region_no = r.region_no JOIN payment p ON c.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON p.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY c.member_no, c.lastname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 133317.67 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 15 INTERSECT SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, AVG(p2.payment_amt) AS avg_payment2, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statements_count2 FROM member m JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN payment p2 ON s.statement_no = p2.statement_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r2 ON corp.region_no = r2.region_no WHERE s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p2.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND corp.corp_code = 'A' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.statement_amt) > 651132.36 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) >= 46 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.region_no, m.state_prov, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS average_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date FROM charge ch JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN member m ON s.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation c ON m.corp_no = c.corp_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN region r ON c.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 45485.61 AND p.payment_amt < 40845.86 AND s.statement_amt >= 96977.66 GROUP BY c.region_no, m.state_prov ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 3896.42 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 392.06 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 8104.69 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 9952.35 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charge c WHERE c.member_no = m.member_no AND c.charge_amt > 766.67) AS high_charge_count, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_payments FROM member m WHERE m.region_no = 8 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM corporation corp WHERE corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND corp.region_no = m.region_no ) ORDER BY high_charge_count DESC, recent_payments DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COALESCE(SUM(s.statement_amt), 0) AS total_statement, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payment, (COALESCE(SUM(s.statement_amt), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance FROM member m LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND s.statement_dt >= '2023-01-01' LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01' WHERE m.issue_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING (COALESCE(SUM(s.statement_amt), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) > 7203.35 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS charge_count FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN provider p ON c.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1998-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment pm WHERE pm.member_no = m.member_no AND pm.payment_dt >= '1998-01-01') GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 95737.64 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(c.charge_no) AS charge_count FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt >= 3371.94 AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 37176.07 UNION ALL SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(p.payment_no) AS payment_count FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt >= 5602.17 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 21976.66 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (SUM(c.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) DESC) AS balance_rank FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING (SUM(c.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) > 29718.94 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_payments_count FROM member m JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN statement st ON ch.statement_no = st.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 653.14 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 6010.88 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.charge_dt, c.charge_amt, AVG(c.charge_amt) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY c.charge_dt::DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_charge FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 1270.65 AND c.charge_dt::DATE >= '2020-01-01'::DATE AND cat.category_no = 16 ORDER BY m.member_no, c.charge_dt;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amt, AVG(outer_subquery.avg_charge_per_category) AS overall_avg_charge_per_category FROM member m JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN ( SELECT c.member_no, cat.category_desc, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_per_category FROM charge c JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.member_no, cat.category_desc ) outer_subquery ON m.member_no = outer_subquery.member_no WHERE s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name HAVING SUM(s.statement_amt) > 8924.41 ORDER BY overall_avg_charge_per_category DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance_change, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS region_net_rank FROM member m JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation cr ON m.corp_no = cr.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 777768.3 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name, r.region_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 166303.87 ORDER BY region_net_rank;

SELECT m.region_no, m.corp_no, c.category_no, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE)) AS charge_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE)) AS charge_month, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(*) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charged, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, MAX(ch.charge_amt) AS max_charge, MIN(ch.charge_amt) AS min_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_prev_balance, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_curr_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no, m.corp_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS corp_charge_rank, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE))) AS region_monthly_running_total FROM member m JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.payment_dt AS DATE)) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE)) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(p.payment_dt AS DATE)) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE)) LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(s.statement_dt AS DATE)) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE)) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(s.statement_dt AS DATE)) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE)) WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5279.41 AND CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' AND CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE) <= '2000-01-01' AND pr.provider_no IN (SELECT provider_no FROM provider WHERE region_no = m.region_no AND CAST(expr_dt AS DATE) > '2000-01-01') GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (m.region_no, m.corp_no, c.category_no, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE))), (m.region_no, m.corp_no, c.category_no), (m.region_no, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE))), (m.region_no, m.corp_no), (m.region_no), (c.category_no), (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE))), () ) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 697439.58 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 878 ORDER BY m.region_no, m.corp_no, c.category_no, charge_year DESC, charge_month DESC, total_charged DESC;

SELECT m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.curr_balance, m2.prev_balance, (m1.curr_balance - m2.prev_balance) AS balance_change FROM member m1 JOIN member m2 ON m1.member_no = m2.member_no AND m1.region_no = m2.region_no JOIN charge c ON m1.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE m1.curr_balance > 3847.85 AND m2.prev_balance < 2975.2 AND c.charge_amt >= 585.12 GROUP BY m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.curr_balance, m2.prev_balance HAVING COUNT(c.charge_no) > 1 ORDER BY balance_change DESC;

SELECT p1.region_no, p1.provider_no, p1.provider_name, p2.provider_no AS other_provider_no, p2.provider_name AS other_provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c1.charge_no) AS charge_count_self, COUNT(DISTINCT c2.charge_no) AS charge_count_other, SUM(c1.charge_amt) AS total_charge_self, SUM(c2.charge_amt) AS total_charge_other FROM provider p1 JOIN provider p2 ON p1.region_no = p2.region_no AND p1.provider_no != p2.provider_no JOIN charge c1 ON p1.provider_no = c1.provider_no JOIN charge c2 ON p2.provider_no = c2.provider_no WHERE c1.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND c2.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p1.region_no, p1.provider_no, p1.provider_name, p2.provider_no, p2.provider_name HAVING SUM(c1.charge_amt) > 76876.25 AND SUM(c2.charge_amt) > 75268.02 ORDER BY total_charge_self DESC;

SELECT p1.region_no, p1.provider_no, p1.provider_name, p2.provider_no AS other_provider_no, p2.provider_name AS other_provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c1.charge_no) AS charge_count_self, COUNT(DISTINCT c2.charge_no) AS charge_count_other, SUM(c1.charge_amt) AS total_charge_self, SUM(c2.charge_amt) AS total_charge_other FROM provider p1 JOIN provider p2 ON p1.region_no = p2.region_no AND p1.provider_no != p2.provider_no JOIN charge c1 ON p1.provider_no = c1.provider_no JOIN charge c2 ON p2.provider_no = c2.provider_no WHERE c1.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND c2.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p1.region_no, p1.provider_no, p1.provider_name, p2.provider_no, p2.provider_name HAVING SUM(c1.charge_amt) > 89093.82 AND SUM(c2.charge_amt) > 52294.69 ORDER BY total_charge_self DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM region r INNER JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no INNER JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no INNER JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 774.1 ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) DESC) AS rank_by_net_balance FROM region r JOIN provider pr ON r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN charge ch ON pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no AND m.region_no = co.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND p.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 7427.86 AND m.curr_balance < -7541.66 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 76952.5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 46 ORDER BY r.region_name, rank_by_net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 588.58 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 3510.8 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 1030.64 ORDER BY member_count DESC, avg_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 420.03 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 2968.97 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 20044.35 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no) AS region_avg_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 823.47 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT pm.member_no FROM payment pm WHERE pm.payment_amt > 368.63 AND pm.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 34264.18 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) FROM member m WHERE m.region_no = r.region_no) AS member_count_in_region FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 967.27 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, r.region_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 12194.43 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1009.13 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 21632.09 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2013.57 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 37524.22 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 682.11 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 12637.3 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 641.98 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 116443.79 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 363.38 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 9647.33 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, p.provider_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(pm.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, SUM(st.statement_amt) AS total_statements, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN charge ch ON st.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON st.statement_no = pm.statement_no AND m.member_no = pm.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 578.81 AND st.statement_amt > 36050.76 AND pm.payment_amt > 4669.95 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND st.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, ch.charge_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 12539.69 AND AVG(pm.payment_amt) > 377.72 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SELECT AVG(sub_c.charge_amt) FROM charge sub_c WHERE sub_c.member_no = m.member_no AND sub_c.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS avg_recent_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND c.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 4088.16 AND s.statement_amt >= 6638.28 AND m.curr_balance <= 3305.57 AND cat.category_no IN (23, 5, 7) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 48636.96 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) >= 27 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amt, COUNT(DISTINCT c.category_no) AS distinct_categories, (SELECT MAX(sub_c.charge_dt) FROM charge sub_c WHERE sub_c.member_no = m.member_no AND sub_c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01') AS latest_charge_date FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no AND c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 54939.04 LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_amt > 74015.65 LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider prov ON c.provider_no = prov.provider_no AND prov.region_no = r.region_no WHERE r.region_no IN (SELECT sub_r.region_no FROM region sub_r WHERE sub_r.region_name LIKE 'A') AND m.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (m.curr_balance > 46449.75 OR m.prev_balance > 57747.86) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 305065.15 AND COUNT(p.payment_no) >= 89 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, total_charges DESC LIMIT 180;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charge ch WHERE ch.member_no = m.member_no AND ch.charge_amt > 8539.34) AS high_charge_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no AND s.statement_no = ch.statement_no WHERE m.curr_balance >= 81210.62 AND s.due_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 39320.36 ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amt FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE m.country = 'US' AND m.issue_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND m.prev_balance > 5090.31 AND s.statement_amt < 8260.15 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) > 44 AND AVG(m.prev_balance) < 1327.0 ORDER BY total_statement_amt DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.country, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SELECT AVG(sub_c.charge_amt) FROM charge sub_c WHERE sub_c.category_no = cat.category_no AND sub_c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND sub_c.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01') AS avg_category_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS latest_statement_date FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 471364.93 AND p.payment_amt > 628120.01 AND s.statement_amt > 376800.32 AND m.curr_balance < -376065.25 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.country, cat.category_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > SUM(p.payment_amt) AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) > 238.95 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, latest_statement_date DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, r.region_code, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, c.corp_code, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.member_code, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amt, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment_amt, (SELECT MAX(charge_amt) FROM charge WHERE member_no = m.member_no AND provider_no IN (SELECT provider_no FROM provider WHERE region_no = r.region_no)) AS max_charge_for_member_in_region, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(s.statement_amt) DESC) AS statement_amt_rank_in_region, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_amt_rank_global FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 31293.15 AND p.payment_amt < 45429.99 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, r.region_code, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, c.corp_code, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.member_code HAVING SUM(s.statement_amt) > 659794.73 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) >= 66 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_statement_amt DESC, total_payment_amt DESC;

SELECT r1.region_no, r1.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.member_no) AS members_in_region, COUNT(DISTINCT m2.member_no) AS members_in_same_state, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r1 JOIN region r2 ON r1.state_prov = r2.state_prov AND r1.region_no != r2.region_no JOIN member m1 ON r1.region_no = m1.region_no JOIN member m2 ON r2.region_no = m2.region_no AND m1.state_prov = m2.state_prov JOIN charge c ON m1.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m1.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON m1.member_no = s.member_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN corporation corp ON m1.corp_no = corp.corp_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 1433.33 AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_amt < 1831.67 GROUP BY r1.region_no, r1.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 42563.41 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT s.member_no, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement FROM statement s JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 4651.16 AND cat.category_no = 76 GROUP BY s.member_no HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 18 INTERSECT SELECT p.member_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment FROM payment p WHERE p.payment_amt > 3730.76 GROUP BY p.member_no HAVING COUNT(*) >= 6 ORDER BY total_statement DESC;

SELECT s.member_no, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment FROM statement s JOIN payment p ON s.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 4340.59 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY s.member_no ORDER BY total_statement DESC;

SELECT s.member_no, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement, m.corp_no, r.region_name FROM statement s JOIN member m ON s.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation c ON m.corp_no = c.corp_no JOIN region r ON c.region_no = r.region_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 7098.37 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.member_no IN (SELECT p.member_no FROM payment p WHERE p.payment_amt > 4141.37) GROUP BY s.member_no, m.corp_no, r.region_name ORDER BY total_statement DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT s.member_no, s.statement_dt, s.statement_amt, AVG(s.statement_amt) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.member_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt::DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3period FROM statement s WHERE s.statement_amt > 7247.29 AND s.statement_dt::DATE >= '2020-01-01'::DATE ORDER BY s.member_no, s.statement_dt;

WITH regional_charges AS ( SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND corp.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc ), member_analysis AS ( SELECT m.member_no, m.region_no, m.corp_no, m.curr_balance, m.prev_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS lifetime_charges, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment pm WHERE pm.member_no = m.member_no AND pm.payment_amt > 8393.58) AS large_payments_count FROM member m JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no WHERE m.issue_dt >= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.region_no, m.corp_no, m.curr_balance, m.prev_balance ), corp_performance AS ( SELECT corp.corp_no, corp.corp_name, r.region_no, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_balance, SUM(ma.lifetime_charges) AS corp_total_charges, (SELECT AVG(s.statement_amt) FROM statement s JOIN member m2 ON s.member_no = m2.member_no WHERE m2.corp_no = corp.corp_no AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01') AS avg_statement_amt FROM corporation corp JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN member_analysis ma ON m.member_no = ma.member_no WHERE corp.expr_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY corp.corp_no, corp.corp_name, r.region_no ) SELECT rc.region_no, rc.region_name, rc.category_no, rc.category_desc, rc.total_charges, rc.charge_count, rc.avg_charge_amt, cp.corp_no, cp.corp_name, cp.member_count, cp.total_balance, cp.corp_total_charges, cp.avg_statement_amt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member m2 JOIN charge ch2 ON m2.member_no = ch2.member_no WHERE m2.region_no = rc.region_no AND ch2.category_no = rc.category_no AND ch2.charge_amt > 3470.86) AS high_value_charges_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rc.region_no ORDER BY rc.total_charges DESC) AS region_category_rank, SUM(rc.total_charges) OVER (PARTITION BY rc.region_no) AS region_total_charges, rc.total_charges / NULLIF(SUM(rc.total_charges) OVER (PARTITION BY rc.region_no), 0) * 100 AS pct_of_region_charges FROM regional_charges rc JOIN corp_performance cp ON rc.region_no = cp.region_no JOIN category cat ON rc.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE rc.total_charges > 710638.83 AND cp.corp_total_charges > 1498005.13 GROUP BY rc.region_no, rc.region_name, rc.category_no, rc.category_desc, rc.total_charges, rc.charge_count, rc.avg_charge_amt, cp.corp_no, cp.corp_name, cp.member_count, cp.total_balance, cp.corp_total_charges, cp.avg_statement_amt HAVING COUNT(*) > 6 ORDER BY rc.total_charges DESC, region_category_rank ASC LIMIT 329;

SELECT c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, (SELECT MAX(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01') AS max_recent_payment FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7437.27 AND r.region_no = 12 GROUP BY c.category_desc, m.member_no HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) >= 19 ORDER BY avg_charge DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_amt >= 1099.08 ) AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 603259.53 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_amt >= 4611.47 ) AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 777396.42 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9185.09 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 23780.07 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1063.25 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no LEFT JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no LEFT JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no LEFT JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8879.53 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 874.79 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9610.32 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > (SELECT AVG(charge_amt) FROM charge WHERE charge_amt > 9626.19) ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt >= 83956.81 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) > 406 INTERSECT SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt >= 31156.91 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) > 752 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 77650.4 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2022-12-31' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 80242.06 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SELECT AVG(sub_ch.charge_amt) FROM charge sub_ch WHERE sub_ch.member_no = m.member_no AND sub_ch.charge_amt > 288.4 AND sub_ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01') AS avg_large_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND s.statement_dt BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '1990-01-01' WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8592.26 AND ch.charge_dt BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '1990-01-01' AND m.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND pv.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND corp.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.member_no, r.region_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 85555.73 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_member_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS unique_statements, SUM(CASE WHEN ch.charge_code = 'A' THEN ch.charge_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code_a_total, SUM(CASE WHEN ch.charge_code = 'B' THEN ch.charge_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code_b_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_rank, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_desc ORDER BY r.region_name) AS charge_diff_from_prev_region FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no AND ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no AND ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation cr ON m.corp_no = cr.corp_no AND m.corp_no = cr.corp_no JOIN region r ON cr.region_no = r.region_no AND cr.region_no = r.region_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON s.member_no = pm.member_no AND s.statement_no = pm.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5351.17 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 67550.49 AND m.curr_balance > 49965.76 AND s.statement_amt > 46718.5 GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 44663.24 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 724 UNION ALL SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_member_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS unique_statements, SUM(CASE WHEN ch.charge_code = 'C' THEN ch.charge_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code_c_total, SUM(CASE WHEN ch.charge_code = 'D' THEN ch.charge_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code_d_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_rank, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_desc ORDER BY r.region_name) AS charge_diff_from_prev_region FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no AND ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no AND ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation cr ON m.corp_no = cr.corp_no AND m.corp_no = cr.corp_no JOIN region r ON cr.region_no = r.region_no AND cr.region_no = r.region_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON s.member_no = pm.member_no AND s.statement_no = pm.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3583.32 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 10424.01 AND m.curr_balance > 10943.98 AND s.statement_amt > 5339.79 GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 48198.44 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 33 ORDER BY region_rank, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5449.4 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 1502.9 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 38302.62 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4726.05 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -1563.31 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 2697.87 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS unique_members, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no AND co.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND m.country = 'US' JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no AND ch.charge_dt BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt > '2019-01-01' WHERE (c.category_code = 'A' OR c.category_code = 'A') AND NOT (m.curr_balance < -490.2 OR m.prev_balance > 922.88) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 532630.35 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) <= 78 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2812.71 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 79241.17 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 31288.91 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS rank_by_charge FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 13579.42 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.statement_no) AS statements_with_payments, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name, c.category_desc ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS prev_category_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6710.05 AND s.statement_amt >= 44017.85 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 2717.33 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) > 83 ORDER BY r.region_name, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.member_no, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 16787.26 ORDER BY r.region_name, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, AVG(avg_statement_amt) AS avg_member_statement_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.member_no, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amt FROM statement s WHERE s.statement_dt >= ( SELECT MIN(s2.statement_dt) FROM statement s2 WHERE s2.statement_amt > 1056.86 ) GROUP BY s.member_no ) AS subq ON m.member_no = subq.member_no WHERE r.region_no = 9 AND m.issue_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 48715.26 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 8888.21 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM charge ch2 WHERE ch2.member_no = m.member_no AND ch2.charge_amt > 3757.44 AND ch2.charge_dt >= '2019-01-01' ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 46477.96 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 5 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.provider_no) AS unique_providers, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS balance_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 8008.4 AND m.curr_balance < -24206.93 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM charge c2 JOIN statement s2 ON c2.statement_no = s2.statement_no WHERE c2.member_no = m.member_no AND c2.charge_amt > 1344.52 AND s2.statement_amt > 18279.16 ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 31937.12 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) >= 29 AND (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) > 5861.61 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, balance_rank;

SELECT r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) AS statement_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS balance_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 9822.15 AND s.statement_amt > 21870.17 AND m.curr_balance > 8648.6 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 12069.61 AND (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) > 7586.55 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) > 4 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, balance_rank LIMIT 233;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_amt > 4240.27 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_payment_count FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) > 83 ORDER BY member_count DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 289636.92 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT charge_code) FROM charge ch WHERE ch.category_no = c.category_no AND ch.charge_amt > 1759.57) AS high_charge_codes_per_category FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 133072.13 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;
