SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, COUNT(DISTINCT p.provider_no) AS total_providers, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(py.payment_amt) AS total_payments, CASE WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) > SUM(py.payment_amt) THEN 'Deficit' WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) < SUM(py.payment_amt) THEN 'Surplus' ELSE 'Balanced' END AS financial_status, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_member_balance FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no AND p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN payment py ON m.member_no = py.member_no JOIN statement s ON py.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND py.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_amt > 54422.67 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 89372.28 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_payments_count, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amt FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 2385.22 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 15479.46 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.member_no) AS members_in_region, COUNT(DISTINCT m2.member_no) AS members_same_country, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN member m1 ON r.region_no = m1.region_no JOIN member m2 ON m1.country = m2.country JOIN statement s ON m1.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 33487.73 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 437770.33 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4398.65 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 87167.52 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, MIN(ch.charge_dt) AS earliest_charge_date, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2000-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 8255.28 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 9032.21 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM provider pr WHERE pr.region_no = r.region_no AND pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no AND pr.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 483828.41 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 465 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND co.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2351.59 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 1241.31 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 45027.39 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (ORDER BY r.region_no) AS prev_region_total FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 733475.57 AND ch.member_no IN ( SELECT m2.member_no FROM member m2 JOIN payment p2 ON m2.member_no = p2.member_no WHERE p2.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p2.payment_amt >= 476211.58 GROUP BY m2.member_no HAVING COUNT(p2.payment_no) > 18 ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 23020.45 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 157 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, r.region_no, c.category_desc;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 74077.55 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 102694.31 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_year, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('2020-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= TO_DATE('2020-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ch.charge_amt > 5350.82 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 38833.07 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 81 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_charge, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_charges FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9532.45 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, ch.charge_dt, ch.charge_amt ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no, ch.charge_dt;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM region r INNER JOIN provider pr ON r.region_no = pr.region_no INNER JOIN charge ch ON pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no INNER JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no INNER JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3674.51 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 45990.98 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE)) AS charge_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE)) AS charge_month, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_current_balance, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS rank_by_charge_in_region_category FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5022.98 AND CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' AND CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE) <= '2000-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -7358.96 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, charge_year, charge_month), (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), ()) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 43479.17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 789.27 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no, charge_year, charge_month, total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no AND r.region_no = co.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON ch.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND ch.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 798.06 AND ch.member_no IN ( SELECT m2.member_no FROM member m2 JOIN statement s2 ON m2.member_no = s2.member_no WHERE s2.statement_amt > 3806.38 AND m2.curr_balance < -9214.27 GROUP BY m2.member_no HAVING COUNT(s2.statement_no) > 5 ) AND r.region_no IN (6, 18, 23) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 46237.15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 36 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_no, category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT p.member_no) AS unique_members_paid FROM region r JOIN provider pr ON r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN charge ch ON pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON ch.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4928.37 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), () ) ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.state_prov, c.country, m.member_code, p.provider_name, cat.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date, MIN(pay.payment_dt) AS earliest_payment_date, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_prev_balance, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_curr_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.state_prov ORDER BY MAX(ch.charge_dt)) AS prev_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND m.member_no = pay.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 985.11 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_amt BETWEEN 7543.95 AND 3640.7 AND p.provider_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.state_prov, c.country, m.member_code, p.provider_name, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 79517.76 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 621 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, r.region_no, c.state_prov;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payments_received, (SUM(s.statement_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(pay.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_outstanding, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS provider_rank_in_region, SUM(SUM(c.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, cat.category_no) AS category_total_in_region FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge c ON p.provider_no = c.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN member m ON c.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no AND m.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no AND c.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND s.member_no = pay.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND c.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 401215.2 AND s.statement_amt > 445466.69 AND pay.payment_amt > 840564.18 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, p.provider_no, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 5201326.92 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) >= 845.78 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charge_amount DESC, provider_rank_in_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS distinct_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT chg.charge_no) AS distinct_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT cat.category_no) AS distinct_categories, COUNT(DISTINCT chg.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, SUM(chg.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, MAX(chg.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date, MIN(p.payment_dt) AS earliest_payment_date, SUM(CASE WHEN chg.charge_code = 'A' THEN chg.charge_amt ELSE 0 END) AS charge_code_a_total, SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_code = 'P' THEN p.payment_amt ELSE 0 END) AS payment_code_p_total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.prev_balance > m.curr_balance) AS members_balance_decreased, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(chg.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) DESC) AS global_statement_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN charge chg ON s.statement_no = chg.statement_no AND m.member_no = chg.member_no JOIN category cat ON chg.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider prov ON chg.provider_no = prov.provider_no AND r.region_no = prov.region_no WHERE chg.charge_amt > 2445.38 AND s.statement_amt >= 31450.42 AND p.payment_amt >= 1502.86 AND chg.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND m.issue_dt <= '1980-01-01' AND s.due_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(chg.charge_amt) > 43881.99 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) >= 303 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) > 145 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_charge_rank ASC, global_statement_rank ASC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT c.category_no) AS distinct_categories, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(SUM(c.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY MAX(c.charge_dt)) AS prev_member_charge_total FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 3044.72 AND p.payment_amt > 4675.99 AND s.statement_amt BETWEEN 42840.54 AND 86445.99 AND c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 25668.58 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.category_no) >= 2 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT c.category_no) AS distinct_categories, SUM(c.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(SUM(c.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY c.charge_dt) AS prev_charge_amt FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND m.member_no = c.member_no LEFT JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 1326.99 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.charge_dt HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 19500.3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.category_no) >= 3 ORDER BY r.region_no, net_balance DESC, charge_rank_in_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 4944.46 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 4636.7 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amt, COUNT(DISTINCT c.category_no) AS distinct_categories, (SELECT MAX(sub_c.charge_dt) FROM charge sub_c WHERE sub_c.member_no = m.member_no AND sub_c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01') AS latest_charge_date FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no AND c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 84736.7 LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_amt > 71240.23 LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider prov ON c.provider_no = prov.provider_no AND prov.region_no = r.region_no WHERE r.region_no IN (SELECT sub_r.region_no FROM region sub_r WHERE sub_r.region_name LIKE 'A') AND m.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (m.curr_balance > 70618.04 OR m.prev_balance > 67878.76) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 368489.93 AND COUNT(p.payment_no) >= 57 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, total_charges DESC LIMIT 998;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.country, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SELECT AVG(sub_c.charge_amt) FROM charge sub_c WHERE sub_c.category_no = cat.category_no AND sub_c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND sub_c.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01') AS avg_category_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS latest_statement_date FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 456596.93 AND p.payment_amt > 277911.64 AND s.statement_amt > 228264.34 AND m.curr_balance < -519813.1 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.country, cat.category_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > SUM(p.payment_amt) AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) > 468.31 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, latest_statement_date DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, s.statement_dt, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amt, AVG(SUM(s.statement_amt)) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3period FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 3413.21 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, s.statement_dt HAVING SUM(s.statement_amt) < 387606.23 ORDER BY r.region_no, s.statement_dt;

SELECT r1.region_no AS region1_id, r1.region_name AS region1_name, r2.region_no AS region2_id, r2.region_name AS region2_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch1.charge_amt) AS total_charges_region1, SUM(ch2.charge_amt) AS total_charges_region2, AVG(ch1.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_region1, AVG(ch2.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_region2, COUNT(DISTINCT ch1.member_no) AS unique_members_region1, COUNT(DISTINCT ch2.member_no) AS unique_members_region2, SUM(st1.statement_amt) AS total_statements_region1, SUM(st2.statement_amt) AS total_statements_region2, SUM(p1.payment_amt) AS total_payments_region1, SUM(p2.payment_amt) AS total_payments_region2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r1.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch1.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region1 FROM region r1 JOIN region r2 ON r1.region_no > r2.region_no JOIN provider pv1 ON r1.region_no = pv1.region_no JOIN provider pv2 ON r2.region_no = pv2.region_no JOIN charge ch1 ON pv1.provider_no = ch1.provider_no JOIN charge ch2 ON pv2.provider_no = ch2.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch1.category_no = c.category_no AND ch2.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m1 ON ch1.member_no = m1.member_no JOIN member m2 ON ch2.member_no = m2.member_no JOIN statement st1 ON ch1.statement_no = st1.statement_no JOIN statement st2 ON ch2.statement_no = st2.statement_no JOIN payment p1 ON st1.statement_no = p1.statement_no AND ch1.member_no = p1.member_no JOIN payment p2 ON st2.statement_no = p2.statement_no AND ch2.member_no = p2.member_no JOIN corporation corp1 ON m1.corp_no = corp1.corp_no JOIN corporation corp2 ON m2.corp_no = corp2.corp_no WHERE ch1.charge_amt > 7221.03 AND ch2.charge_amt > 8099.3 AND ch1.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch2.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND st1.statement_amt > 43666.74 AND st2.statement_amt > 49623.87 GROUP BY r1.region_no, r1.region_name, r2.region_no, r2.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch1.charge_amt) > 101748.38 AND SUM(ch2.charge_amt) > 999173.02 ORDER BY total_charges_region1 DESC, total_charges_region2 DESC;

SELECT s.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM statement s JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY s.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 6699.91 INTERSECT SELECT p.member_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM payment p WHERE p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY p.member_no HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 5580.79 ORDER BY member_no;

SELECT s.member_no, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment FROM statement s JOIN payment p ON s.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 8004.6 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY s.member_no ORDER BY total_statement DESC;

SELECT s.member_no, s.statement_dt, s.statement_amt, AVG(s.statement_amt) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.member_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3period, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(p.payment_no) AS payment_count FROM statement s JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND s.member_no = c.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND s.member_no = p.member_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 8204.7 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY s.member_no, s.statement_dt, s.statement_amt, s.statement_no ORDER BY s.member_no, s.statement_dt;

SELECT s.statement_no, s.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(SUM(c.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.member_no) AS avg_member_charges FROM statement s JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 2368.5 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY s.statement_no, s.member_no ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

WITH charge_summary AS ( SELECT c.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM charge c WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 5443.78 ) SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cs.total_charges, cs.charge_count, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN charge_summary cs ON m.member_no = cs.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cs.total_charges, cs.charge_count ORDER BY cs.total_charges DESC LIMIT 46;

WITH regional_charges AS ( SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND corp.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc ), member_analysis AS ( SELECT m.member_no, m.region_no, m.corp_no, m.curr_balance, m.prev_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS lifetime_charges, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment pm WHERE pm.member_no = m.member_no AND pm.payment_amt > 9333.56) AS large_payments_count FROM member m JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no WHERE m.issue_dt >= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.region_no, m.corp_no, m.curr_balance, m.prev_balance ), corp_performance AS ( SELECT corp.corp_no, corp.corp_name, r.region_no, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_balance, SUM(ma.lifetime_charges) AS corp_total_charges, (SELECT AVG(s.statement_amt) FROM statement s JOIN member m2 ON s.member_no = m2.member_no WHERE m2.corp_no = corp.corp_no AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01') AS avg_statement_amt FROM corporation corp JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN member_analysis ma ON m.member_no = ma.member_no WHERE corp.expr_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY corp.corp_no, corp.corp_name, r.region_no ) SELECT rc.region_no, rc.region_name, rc.category_no, rc.category_desc, rc.total_charges, rc.charge_count, rc.avg_charge_amt, cp.corp_no, cp.corp_name, cp.member_count, cp.total_balance, cp.corp_total_charges, cp.avg_statement_amt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member m2 JOIN charge ch2 ON m2.member_no = ch2.member_no WHERE m2.region_no = rc.region_no AND ch2.category_no = rc.category_no AND ch2.charge_amt > 1862.29) AS high_value_charges_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rc.region_no ORDER BY rc.total_charges DESC) AS region_category_rank, SUM(rc.total_charges) OVER (PARTITION BY rc.region_no) AS region_total_charges, rc.total_charges / NULLIF(SUM(rc.total_charges) OVER (PARTITION BY rc.region_no), 0) * 100 AS pct_of_region_charges FROM regional_charges rc JOIN corp_performance cp ON rc.region_no = cp.region_no JOIN category cat ON rc.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE rc.total_charges > 44617.18 AND cp.corp_total_charges > 1758719.46 GROUP BY rc.region_no, rc.region_name, rc.category_no, rc.category_desc, rc.total_charges, rc.charge_count, rc.avg_charge_amt, cp.corp_no, cp.corp_name, cp.member_count, cp.total_balance, cp.corp_total_charges, cp.avg_statement_amt HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY rc.total_charges DESC, region_category_rank ASC LIMIT 435;

SELECT c.category_code, p.provider_code, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS unique_statements FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1272.9 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_code, p.provider_code HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 123203.51 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_code, p.provider_code, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS unique_statements FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3796.14 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_code, p.provider_code HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 148379.08 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS members_charged, COALESCE(AVG(p.payment_amt), 0) AS avg_payment, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM category c LEFT JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN payment p ON ch.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no LEFT JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE (ch.charge_amt > 7874.59 OR ch.charge_amt IS NULL) GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) > 2798.88 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS unique_members, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS unique_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5882.18 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) > 175 ORDER BY avg_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment_amt, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, SUM(ch2.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt_self_join, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_member_balance, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member m2 WHERE m2.region_no = r.region_no AND m2.expr_dt >= '1995-01-01') AS active_members_in_region FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch2 ON ch.member_no = ch2.member_no AND ch.category_no = ch2.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6610.21 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 73344.74 GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 20890.38 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt >= 67339.36 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) > 389 INTERSECT SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt >= 8216.45 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) > 889 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 742.87 GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 4759.31 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON p.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9667.91 AND (s.statement_amt < 60.43 OR s.statement_amt IS NULL) AND NOT (m.country = 'USA' AND m.state_prov = 'CA') GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 48233.06 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.state_prov ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_state FROM charge ch JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE c.category_code LIKE 'A' AND m.state_prov LIKE 'AA' AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt < '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.state_prov HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 98062.25 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, pr.provider_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS unique_statements FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 9907.99 GROUP BY c.category_desc, pr.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 25605.21 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_member_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS unique_statements, SUM(CASE WHEN ch.charge_code = 'A' THEN ch.charge_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code_a_total, SUM(CASE WHEN ch.charge_code = 'B' THEN ch.charge_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code_b_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_rank, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_desc ORDER BY r.region_name) AS charge_diff_from_prev_region FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no AND ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no AND ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation cr ON m.corp_no = cr.corp_no AND m.corp_no = cr.corp_no JOIN region r ON cr.region_no = r.region_no AND cr.region_no = r.region_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON s.member_no = pm.member_no AND s.statement_no = pm.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7169.65 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 29228.62 AND m.curr_balance > 58247.38 AND s.statement_amt > 16297.86 GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 38704.41 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 759 UNION ALL SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_member_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS unique_statements, SUM(CASE WHEN ch.charge_code = 'C' THEN ch.charge_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code_c_total, SUM(CASE WHEN ch.charge_code = 'D' THEN ch.charge_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code_d_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_rank, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_desc ORDER BY r.region_name) AS charge_diff_from_prev_region FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no AND ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no AND ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation cr ON m.corp_no = cr.corp_no AND m.corp_no = cr.corp_no JOIN region r ON cr.region_no = r.region_no AND cr.region_no = r.region_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON s.member_no = pm.member_no AND s.statement_no = pm.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1488.82 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 97345.77 AND m.curr_balance > 33849.49 AND s.statement_amt > 27093.52 GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 70184.99 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 723 ORDER BY region_rank, total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.member_no IN (SELECT m.member_no FROM member m WHERE m.region_no = 64) GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 663250.92 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN payment p ON ch.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4520.52 AND p.payment_amt > 4030.2 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 741.01 INTERSECT SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN payment p ON ch.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2018-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2018-12-31' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) < 22721.55 ORDER BY avg_charge DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, MAX(ch.charge_amt) AS max_charge_amount, MIN(ch.charge_amt) AS min_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(DISTINCT p.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_current_balance, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_previous_balance, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(pm.payment_amt)) AS net_activity, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) DESC) AS charge_count_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (ORDER BY c.category_no) AS prev_category_total_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8289.67 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND p.provider_no IN (SELECT provider_no FROM provider WHERE region_no IN (SELECT region_no FROM region WHERE region_name LIKE 'A')) AND m.member_no IN (SELECT member_no FROM member WHERE curr_balance > 3230.93 AND prev_balance > 6356.32) AND co.corp_no IN (SELECT corp_no FROM corporation WHERE country = 'A') GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 838116.13 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 3286 AND AVG(ch.charge_amt) < 964.9 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, total_charges DESC, c.category_no ASC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt FROM category c LEFT JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) < 453.52 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, MAX(s.statement_amt) AS max_statement_amt, MIN(p.payment_amt) AS min_payment_amt, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_no) AS charges_per_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS category_rank FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN payment p ON s.member_no = p.member_no AND p.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND pr.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3243.53 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -56888.32 AND pr.provider_no > 7670 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 92744.84 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 209 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, category_rank;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_per_statement FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND s.due_dt < '1992-02-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 79360.8 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement FROM charge c JOIN member m ON c.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment p ON c.statement_no = p.statement_no AND c.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no AND c.member_no = s.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 92.55 AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 4896.89 ORDER BY total_payment DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement FROM member m JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 1160.87 GROUP BY m.member_no INTERSECT SELECT m.member_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 4636.88 GROUP BY m.member_no;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charges, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payments, COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance FROM member m LEFT JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM member WHERE curr_balance > 4692.47 ) AND (c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' OR c.charge_dt IS NULL) AND (p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' OR p.payment_dt IS NULL) GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) > -3938.23 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS charge_count FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 1711.15 AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname UNION ALL SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 5819.42 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS charge_count FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN provider p ON c.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1998-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment pm WHERE pm.member_no = m.member_no AND pm.payment_dt >= '1998-01-01') GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 93661.02 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.charge_dt, c.charge_amt, AVG(c.charge_amt) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY c.charge_dt::DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_charge FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 4680.93 AND c.charge_dt::DATE >= '2020-01-01'::DATE AND cat.category_no = 39 ORDER BY m.member_no, c.charge_dt;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM member m JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 588.59 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 11095.74 ORDER BY total_statement_amount DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt FROM member m LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_no IS NULL AND m.curr_balance > 2988.13 AND m.issue_dt >= '2020-01-01' ORDER BY m.member_no;

SELECT m.region_no, m.corp_no, c.category_no, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no, m.corp_no) AS avg_charge_per_corp, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_no) AS charge_count_per_category FROM member m JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN corporation cor ON m.corp_no = cor.corp_no AND m.region_no = cor.region_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 825.42 GROUP BY m.region_no, m.corp_no, c.category_no, ch.charge_amt ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.corp_no, COUNT(DISTINCT c1.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(c1.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p1.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM member m1 JOIN member m2 ON m1.region_no = m2.region_no AND m1.member_no <> m2.member_no JOIN charge c1 ON m1.member_no = c1.member_no JOIN payment p1 ON m1.member_no = p1.member_no WHERE m1.curr_balance > 2416.2 AND c1.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.corp_no HAVING SUM(c1.charge_amt) > 98937.29 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) DESC) AS rank_by_net_balance FROM region r JOIN provider pr ON r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN charge ch ON pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no AND m.region_no = co.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND p.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 9119.97 AND m.curr_balance < -2723.17 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 60997.45 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 2 ORDER BY r.region_name, rank_by_net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r INNER JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no INNER JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no INNER JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 22245.92 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 466.47 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT s.member_no FROM statement s WHERE s.statement_amt > 788.97 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 151.68 ORDER BY member_count DESC, avg_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 889.74 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT DISTINCT s.member_no FROM statement s WHERE s.statement_amt > 2347.0 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 66.79 ORDER BY member_count DESC, avg_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE (ch.charge_amt > 9072.67 OR p.payment_amt < 955.99) AND NOT (m.curr_balance <= 297.93 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01') AND (r.region_no = 6 OR c.category_no = 22) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 47222.52 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 19 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name) AS avg_charge_per_region FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1985.61 AND ch.charge_dt >= ( SELECT MAX(payment_dt) FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > ( SELECT AVG(payment_amt) FROM payment WHERE member_no IN (SELECT member_no FROM member WHERE region_no = r.region_no) ) ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 17935.24 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no AND co.corp_code = 'A' JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND m.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1995-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1995-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 15485.45 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5915.5 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc UNION ALL SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payment p JOIN member m ON p.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 9085.62 AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc ORDER BY region_name, category_desc;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4197.19 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 48415.79 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 316.87 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 12986.12 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 519.87 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 676206.45 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS prev_corp_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 924455.09 AND p.payment_amt < 908122.1 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 8473672.68 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 17 ORDER BY r.region_name, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, AVG(avg_statement_amt) AS avg_member_statement_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.member_no, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amt FROM statement s WHERE s.statement_dt >= ( SELECT MIN(s2.statement_dt) FROM statement s2 WHERE s2.statement_amt > 1894.28 ) GROUP BY s.member_no ) AS subq ON m.member_no = subq.member_no WHERE r.region_no = 5 AND m.issue_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 42173.96 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2586.43 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), ()) ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no;
