SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_member_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS members_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT p.member_no) AS members_paid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY c.category_no ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_charges_by_category FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND pr.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1802.75 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (c.category_desc LIKE '%Emergency%' OR pr.provider_name LIKE '%General%') AND r.region_name NOT LIKE '%Test%' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 84496.93 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 55 ORDER BY r.region_no, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.corp_no, corp.corp_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_no ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) DESC) AS category_charge_count_rank FROM region r JOIN provider pr ON r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN charge ch ON pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ( (ch.charge_amt > 1507.82 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01') OR (ch.charge_amt < 30.11 AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01') ) AND NOT (c.category_code = 'A' OR m.country = 'A') AND (pr.expr_dt IS NULL OR pr.expr_dt > '2000-01-01') AND (m.curr_balance BETWEEN -6553.25 AND 885.87 OR m.prev_balance NOT BETWEEN -8891.95 AND 3879.44) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.corp_no, corp.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 78637.26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 552 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, region_charge_rank ASC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT pay.statement_no) AS distinct_statements_paid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region_category, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY MAX(ch.charge_dt)) AS previous_member_charge_total FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND m.member_no = pay.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 859.99 AND s.statement_amt >= 10247.3 AND m.curr_balance < -5695.52 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (p.provider_code = 'A' OR p.provider_code IS NULL) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 44794.19 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 273.0 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no, charge_rank_in_region_category, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE (ch.charge_amt > 9255.18 OR p.payment_amt < 3514.19) AND (s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' OR s.due_dt <= '2020-01-01') AND NOT (m.curr_balance < 294.19 AND m.prev_balance > 153.62) AND (cat.category_no = 78 OR pr.provider_no = 24) AND (r.region_no = 13 OR c.corp_no = 4339) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 28194.14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 38 AND (SUM(p.payment_amt) < 8839.22 OR AVG(s.statement_amt) > 3099.28) ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank_in_corp FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 1161.57 AND s.statement_amt > 40426.37 AND p.payment_amt > 19672.0 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 43487.78 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 20018.96 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) > 98.2 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank_in_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS provider_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6727.59 AND s.statement_amt >= 3746.16 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 23869.54 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 59208.92 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 42 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS sum_current_balance, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_activity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 8319.54 AND s.statement_amt > 7158.14 AND p.payment_amt > 4654.57 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), (cat.category_no, cat.category_desc), () ) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 8039.06 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 98 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, m.member_no, cat.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, pv.provider_no, pv.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT st.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(st.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no AND st.statement_no = pm.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9082.82 AND st.statement_amt > 8945.02 AND pm.payment_amt > 3723.23 AND m.curr_balance > 59169.29 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND st.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND pm.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, pv.provider_no, pv.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 49503.51 AND SUM(pm.payment_amt) > 23416.49 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 39 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, pv.provider_no, pv.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT st.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(st.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no AND ch.statement_no = st.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no AND st.statement_no = pm.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5483.85 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND st.statement_amt > 18838.05 AND st.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 98198.7 AND pm.payment_amt > 3263.37 AND pm.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, pv.provider_no, pv.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 51378.64 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 59 AND SUM(pm.payment_amt) > 6647.2 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, charge_rank_by_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.charge_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS charge_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(c.charge_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS charge_month, COUNT(DISTINCT c.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(SUM(c.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, cat.category_no ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.charge_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(c.charge_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3month FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 6724.52 AND TO_DATE(c.charge_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.charge_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(c.charge_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 8437.47 ORDER BY r.region_no, cat.category_no, charge_year, charge_month;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payments_received, (SUM(s.statement_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(pay.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_outstanding, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS provider_rank_in_region, SUM(SUM(c.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, cat.category_no) AS category_total_in_region FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge c ON p.provider_no = c.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN member m ON c.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no AND m.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no AND c.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND s.member_no = pay.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND c.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 2869.87 AND s.statement_amt > 792707.21 AND pay.payment_amt > 948573.23 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, p.provider_no, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 5646915.35 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) >= 647.84 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charge_amount DESC, provider_rank_in_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.country, m.state_prov, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, m.country ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region_country FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8763.76 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND (p.payment_dt IS NULL OR p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01') AND m.curr_balance > 67319.89 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.country, m.state_prov, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 279918.1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 3 AND (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) > 30715.93 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charge_amount DESC, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, CASE WHEN SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) > 0 THEN 'Net Debt' WHEN SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) < 0 THEN 'Net Credit' ELSE 'Balanced' END AS member_financial_status FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 9907.25 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charge ch WHERE ch.member_no = m.member_no AND ch.charge_amt > 1606.84) AS high_charge_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no AND s.statement_no = ch.statement_no WHERE m.curr_balance >= 72473.48 AND s.due_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 38691.76 ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amt, (SELECT MAX(s.statement_amt) FROM statement s WHERE s.member_no = m.member_no AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '1992-01-01') AS max_statement_amt_per_member, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statement_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt BETWEEN '1992-01-01' AND '1992-01-01' LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND pr.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 246590.89 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, c.category_desc, m.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 94375157.44 AND AVG(ch.charge_amt) < 8676448.86 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC, region_no, m.state_prov, c.category_desc;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.country, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, m.state_prov) AS avg_charges_by_state, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS distinct_providers FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND (m.lastname LIKE 'A%' OR m.firstname LIKE 'A%') AND (c.category_desc LIKE '%Service%' OR c.category_code LIKE 'A') AND ch.charge_amt > 2243.64 AND s.statement_amt > 6312.36 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.country, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 27934.06 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 133.87 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, total_charges DESC;

SELECT s.statement_no, s.statement_dt, s.statement_amt, AVG(s.statement_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY s.member_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3_statements, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name FROM statement s JOIN member m ON s.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 4723.44 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY s.statement_no, s.statement_dt, s.statement_amt, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name ORDER BY s.member_no, s.statement_dt;

WITH charge_summary AS ( SELECT c.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM charge c WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY c.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 3570.84 ) SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cs.total_charges, cs.charge_count, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN charge_summary cs ON m.member_no = cs.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cs.total_charges, cs.charge_count ORDER BY cs.total_charges DESC LIMIT 27;

WITH regional_charges AS ( SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND corp.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc ), member_analysis AS ( SELECT m.member_no, m.region_no, m.corp_no, m.curr_balance, m.prev_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS lifetime_charges, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment pm WHERE pm.member_no = m.member_no AND pm.payment_amt > 7550.26) AS large_payments_count FROM member m JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no WHERE m.issue_dt >= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.region_no, m.corp_no, m.curr_balance, m.prev_balance ), corp_performance AS ( SELECT corp.corp_no, corp.corp_name, r.region_no, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_balance, SUM(ma.lifetime_charges) AS corp_total_charges, (SELECT AVG(s.statement_amt) FROM statement s JOIN member m2 ON s.member_no = m2.member_no WHERE m2.corp_no = corp.corp_no AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01') AS avg_statement_amt FROM corporation corp JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN member_analysis ma ON m.member_no = ma.member_no WHERE corp.expr_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY corp.corp_no, corp.corp_name, r.region_no ) SELECT rc.region_no, rc.region_name, rc.category_no, rc.category_desc, rc.total_charges, rc.charge_count, rc.avg_charge_amt, cp.corp_no, cp.corp_name, cp.member_count, cp.total_balance, cp.corp_total_charges, cp.avg_statement_amt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member m2 JOIN charge ch2 ON m2.member_no = ch2.member_no WHERE m2.region_no = rc.region_no AND ch2.category_no = rc.category_no AND ch2.charge_amt > 4856.08) AS high_value_charges_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rc.region_no ORDER BY rc.total_charges DESC) AS region_category_rank, SUM(rc.total_charges) OVER (PARTITION BY rc.region_no) AS region_total_charges, rc.total_charges / NULLIF(SUM(rc.total_charges) OVER (PARTITION BY rc.region_no), 0) * 100 AS pct_of_region_charges FROM regional_charges rc JOIN corp_performance cp ON rc.region_no = cp.region_no JOIN category cat ON rc.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE rc.total_charges > 382497.42 AND cp.corp_total_charges > 2670629.92 GROUP BY rc.region_no, rc.region_name, rc.category_no, rc.category_desc, rc.total_charges, rc.charge_count, rc.avg_charge_amt, cp.corp_no, cp.corp_name, cp.member_count, cp.total_balance, cp.corp_total_charges, cp.avg_statement_amt HAVING COUNT(*) > 7 ORDER BY rc.total_charges DESC, region_category_rank ASC LIMIT 779;

SELECT c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(*) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN region r ON co.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1766.79 AND m.curr_balance < 6040.09 GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 4884.72 AND COUNT(*) >= 8 ORDER BY total_charge DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5252.48 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 26234.53 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, ROUND(AVG(ch.charge_amt), 2) AS avg_charge_amt, COUNT(*) AS total_charges FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2021-01-01' AND r.region_name LIKE 'East%' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 48547.14 ORDER BY avg_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment_amt, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, SUM(ch2.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt_self_join, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_member_balance, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member m2 WHERE m2.region_no = r.region_no AND m2.expr_dt >= '1995-01-01') AS active_members_in_region FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch2 ON ch.member_no = ch2.member_no AND ch.category_no = ch2.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 536.9 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 48864.21 GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 17950.21 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9717.73 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 773.24 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 42582.39 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, p.provider_name, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3939.98 GROUP BY c.category_desc, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 499626.18 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND (ch.charge_amt > 2199.83 OR ch.charge_code = 'A') AND NOT (m.country = 'A') GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 352904.54 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM statement s WHERE s.member_no = ch.member_no AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' ) GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 96549.83 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND m.corp_no IN (SELECT corp_no FROM corporation WHERE state_prov = 'NY') GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 2716.53 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE c.category_desc LIKE '%' AND m.city LIKE '%' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5692.23 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 169790.36 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = ch.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS recent_payments_count FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND r.region_no = 777 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc, ch.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 9994.95 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 65531.18 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.charge_dt, c.charge_amt, s.statement_amt, p.payment_amt, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_desc, AVG(c.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY c.member_no) AS avg_member_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY p.member_no ORDER BY p.payment_dt) AS running_payment_total FROM charge c JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN payment p ON s.member_no = p.member_no JOIN member m ON c.member_no = m.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 75292.5 AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY c.charge_dt, c.charge_amt, s.statement_amt, p.payment_amt, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_desc, c.member_no, p.member_no, p.payment_dt HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > (SELECT AVG(charge_amt) FROM charge WHERE charge_dt >= '1992-01-01') ORDER BY c.charge_dt DESC, running_payment_total DESC;

SELECT c.region_no, c.corp_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member m WHERE m.corp_no = c.corp_no AND m.curr_balance > 524550.39) AS high_balance_members FROM corporation c JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND c.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.region_no, c.corp_no, c.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 553445.61 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 8445.31 INTERSECT SELECT m.member_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) < 29657.93 ORDER BY member_no;

SELECT m.member_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 6495.52 AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 7017.08 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.firstname, m.lastname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(p.payment_no) AS payment_count FROM member m JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.charge_dt = p.payment_dt WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4151.37 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 29446.77 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charges, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payments, COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance FROM member m LEFT JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM member WHERE curr_balance > 8074.7 ) AND (c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' OR c.charge_dt IS NULL) AND (p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' OR p.payment_dt IS NULL) GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) > 1727.27 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND m.member_no IN (SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 8322.47 AND payment_dt >= '1992-01-01') GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 24014.46 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 5229.12 AND p.payment_amt > 1756.83 AND c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 49428.84 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM member m JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 502.61 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 65 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance_change, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS region_net_rank FROM member m JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation cr ON m.corp_no = cr.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 157352.68 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name, r.region_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 148397.68 ORDER BY region_net_rank;

SELECT m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.curr_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM member m1 JOIN member m2 ON m1.region_no = m2.region_no AND m1.member_no != m2.member_no JOIN charge c ON m1.member_no = c.member_no WHERE m1.curr_balance > 8587.25 AND c.charge_amt BETWEEN 278.43 AND 1559.05 GROUP BY m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.curr_balance HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 4646.56 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.curr_balance, m2.prev_balance, (m1.curr_balance - m2.prev_balance) AS balance_change FROM member m1 JOIN member m2 ON m1.member_no = m2.member_no AND m1.region_no = m2.region_no AND m1.curr_balance > 1719.12 AND m2.prev_balance < 572.43 JOIN region r ON m1.region_no = r.region_no WHERE m1.curr_balance > m2.prev_balance AND r.region_no = 10 GROUP BY m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.curr_balance, m2.prev_balance HAVING AVG(m1.curr_balance) > 782.11 ORDER BY balance_change DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 544.16 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT DISTINCT s.member_no FROM statement s WHERE s.statement_amt > 4632.52 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 227.23 ORDER BY member_count DESC, avg_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9283.66 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 1634.38 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 20550.36 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name) AS avg_region_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3020.28 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 22010.47 ORDER BY r.region_name, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 8068.88 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 28057.91 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 660.82 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 16314.76 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4250.97 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 49934.96 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 4517.75 AND ch.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 4344.99 AND payment_dt >= '2019-01-01' ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 12401.81 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5798.1 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 48461.71 UNION ALL SELECT r.region_name, NULL AS category_desc, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 1920.2 GROUP BY r.region_name HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 55875.47 ORDER BY region_name, category_desc;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_amt > 8184.57 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM provider pr WHERE pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no AND pr.region_no = r.region_no AND pr.expr_dt >= ch.charge_dt ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 338683.38 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 1982.26 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > ( SELECT AVG(payment_amt) FROM payment WHERE payment_dt >= '2019-01-01' ) ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 12839.09 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS rank_by_charge FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 95997.77 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, p.provider_name, cat.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, (SELECT SUM(pm.payment_amt) FROM payment pm WHERE pm.member_no = m.member_no AND pm.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS recent_payments, (SELECT MAX(s.statement_amt) FROM statement s WHERE s.member_no = m.member_no AND s.statement_dt <= '1992-01-01') AS max_statement_amount, SUM(m.curr_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS running_balance_by_region FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no AND p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 21188.77 AND m.curr_balance < -17278.0 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, m.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 477534.43 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, m.country, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT st.statement_no) AS statement_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member m2 WHERE m2.region_no = r.region_no AND m2.country = m.country) AS member_count_in_region_country FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN charge ch ON st.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON st.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND st.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 953818.48 GROUP BY r.region_name, m.country, c.category_desc, r.region_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 346639.23 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.country, COUNT(DISTINCT c.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS latest_statement_date FROM member m JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider prov ON c.provider_no = prov.provider_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 5416.7 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM charge c2 WHERE c2.member_no = m.member_no AND c2.charge_code = 'A' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM statement s2 WHERE s2.member_no = m.member_no AND s2.due_dt >= '2020-01-01' ) GROUP BY r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.country, m.member_code, m.lastname, m.firstname, corp.corp_name, cat.category_desc, prov.provider_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 29912.98 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) >= 14 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, member_count DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, p.provider_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 280.46 AND ch.charge_amt > 5836.29 GROUP BY r.region_name, p.provider_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 72822.01 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, c.category_no, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_prev_balance, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS latest_statement_date, MIN(s.due_dt) AS earliest_due_date FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2000-01-01' AND s.statement_amt > 417698.21 GROUP BY r.region_no, c.category_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 7239235.95 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, c.category_no, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1877.16 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, c.category_no), (r.region_no), (c.category_no), () ) ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, c.category_no, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2864.22 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, c.category_no), (r.region_no), (c.category_no), () ) ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, 'charge' AS source_type, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS record_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_amount FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge c ON p.provider_no = c.provider_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 2390.91 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name UNION ALL SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, 'payment' AS source_type, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.payment_no) AS record_count, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_amount FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no WHERE pm.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND pm.payment_amt > 7911.86 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name ORDER BY region_no, source_type;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS active_members, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01' ) AND c.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING AVG(c.charge_amt) > 132.55 ORDER BY active_members DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 76432.15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 34 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1999-01-01') AS recent_payments FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1999-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 817047.95 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, SUM(nested.charge_amt) AS total_charge FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN (SELECT c.member_no, c.charge_amt FROM charge c WHERE c.charge_dt >= (SELECT MIN(p.payment_dt) FROM payment p WHERE p.payment_amt > 7092.14) AND c.charge_amt > 655.0) nested ON m.member_no = nested.member_no WHERE r.region_no = 60 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(nested.charge_amt) > 85248.14 ORDER BY total_charge DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 97573.36 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no) AS avg_charges_per_region FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9199.91 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 40243.98 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1981.74 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 32831.96 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.country, m.state_prov, pr.provider_name, co.corp_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, m.country ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region_country, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no) AS avg_category_charge_per_region, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) FILTER (WHERE ch.charge_amt > 35696.37) AS high_charge_members, MAX(SUM(p.payment_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY m.corp_no) AS max_payment_by_corporation FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no AND m.region_no = co.region_no JOIN provider pr ON r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no AND pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.country, m.state_prov, pr.provider_name, co.corp_name, c.category_no, m.corp_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 50972.68 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) > 33 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;
