SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_charge_total, AVG(p.payment_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY m.corp_no, m.region_no) AS avg_payment_by_corp_region, COUNT(ch.charge_no) OVER (PARTITION BY ch.provider_no, ch.category_no) AS charge_count_by_provider_category, SUM(m.prev_balance + m.curr_balance) AS total_member_balance, MAX(s.due_dt) AS latest_due_date, MIN(p.payment_dt) AS earliest_payment_date FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND c.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND ch.category_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 33336.45 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -5071.19 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, ch.provider_no, ch.category_no, m.corp_no, m.region_no, ch.charge_amt, ch.charge_no, p.payment_amt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 89234.51 AND COUNT(p.payment_no) >= 33 ORDER BY total_member_balance DESC, running_charge_total ASC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_charge_total, AVG(p.payment_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY m.corp_no, m.region_no) AS avg_payment_by_corp_region, COUNT(ch.charge_no) OVER (PARTITION BY ch.provider_no, ch.category_no) AS charge_count_by_provider_category, SUM(m.prev_balance + m.curr_balance) AS total_member_balance, MAX(s.due_dt) AS latest_due_date, MIN(p.payment_dt) AS earliest_payment_date FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND c.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND ch.category_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 52652.38 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -8619.96 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, ch.provider_no, ch.category_no, m.corp_no, m.region_no, ch.charge_amt, ch.charge_no, p.payment_amt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 4013.77 AND COUNT(p.payment_no) >= 44 ORDER BY total_member_balance DESC, running_charge_total ASC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) DESC) AS balance_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 6039.65 AND s.statement_amt > 7938.21 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc HAVING (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) > 9956.74 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, balance_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.state_prov, c.country, m.member_code, p.provider_name, cat.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date, MIN(pay.payment_dt) AS earliest_payment_date, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_prev_balance, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_curr_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.state_prov ORDER BY MAX(ch.charge_dt)) AS prev_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND m.member_no = pay.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4609.49 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_amt BETWEEN 9027.29 AND 11320.85 AND p.provider_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.state_prov, c.country, m.member_code, p.provider_name, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 62996.87 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 1 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, r.region_no, c.state_prov;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.corp_no, c.corp_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, DATE_TRUNC('month', ch.charge_dt::DATE) AS charge_month, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(st.statement_amt) AS total_statements, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_curr_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS charged_members, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.member_no) AS paying_members, COUNT(DISTINCT st.member_no) AS statement_members, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.corp_no ORDER BY SUM(pm.payment_amt) DESC) AS corp_payment_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no AND ch.statement_no = pm.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no AND ch.statement_no = st.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt::DATE >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt::DATE <= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 4393.6 AND p.provider_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.corp_no, c.corp_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, DATE_TRUNC('month', ch.charge_dt::DATE) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 262291.19 AND SUM(pm.payment_amt) > 355739.56 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 234 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_payment) FROM (SELECT MAX(p.payment_amt) AS max_payment FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY p.member_no) sub) AS max_payment_last_period FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 23448.13 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 508.08 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 8406.47 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT c.category_no) AS distinct_categories, SUM(c.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(SUM(c.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY c.charge_dt) AS prev_charge_amt FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND m.member_no = c.member_no LEFT JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 5987.14 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.charge_dt HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 16383.11 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.category_no) >= 6 ORDER BY r.region_no, net_balance DESC, charge_rank_in_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.provider_no) AS unique_providers, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM charge WHERE charge_amt > 7172.41 GROUP BY member_no HAVING COUNT(*) > 28 ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 37241.04 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) >= 46 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_no, member_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amt FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE m.country = 'US' AND m.issue_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND m.prev_balance > 9509.16 AND s.statement_amt < 6745.38 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) > 93 AND AVG(m.prev_balance) < 2286.2 ORDER BY total_statement_amt DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT s.member_no FROM statement s WHERE s.statement_amt > 20582.15 ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 585955.06 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, r.country, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amt, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, MAX(s.statement_amt) AS max_statement_amt FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 39590.43 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, r.country, c.category_no, c.category_desc, ch.charge_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 1240146.32 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no, ch.charge_dt;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, r.country, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amt, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, MAX(s.statement_amt) AS max_statement_amt FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 570118.45 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, r.country, c.category_no, c.category_desc, ch.charge_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 3075492.75 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no, ch.charge_dt;

SELECT c.category_desc, COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS members_charged, COALESCE(AVG(p.payment_amt), 0) AS avg_payment, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM category c LEFT JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN payment p ON ch.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no LEFT JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE (ch.charge_amt > 3331.95 OR ch.charge_amt IS NULL) GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) > 10757.32 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS distinct_providers FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5078.97 GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) > 88 ORDER BY distinct_members DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, ROUND(AVG(ch.charge_amt), 2) AS avg_charge_amt, COUNT(*) AS total_charges FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2021-01-01' AND r.region_name LIKE 'East%' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 71800.76 ORDER BY avg_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2069.82 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc UNION ALL SELECT p.provider_name, SUM(py.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM provider p JOIN payment py ON p.provider_no = py.member_no WHERE py.payment_amt > 2745.03 AND py.payment_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.provider_name ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (p.region_no = 55 OR p.state_prov = 'A') AND NOT (ch.charge_code = 'A') GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 340532.17 AND COUNT(*) >= 7143 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, p.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8197.93 AND (ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' OR ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01') AND NOT (m.country = 'A') GROUP BY c.category_desc, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) < 887170.38 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 4455.57 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 68.44 INTERSECT SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt <= '2021-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt < 5027.21 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 34.63 ORDER BY category_no;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count FROM category c LEFT JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no LEFT JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND m.region_no = 1 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 9154.75 ORDER BY avg_charge DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_amt || '|' || ch.charge_code) AS distinct_charge_combinations, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2633.98 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charge DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 650.83 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 21196.42 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = ch.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS recent_payments_count FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND r.region_no = 865 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc, ch.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 43104.81 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 2850.74 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement FROM member m JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 3512.99 GROUP BY m.member_no INTERSECT SELECT m.member_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 5352.02 GROUP BY m.member_no;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charges FROM member m LEFT JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) > 12186.61 INTERSECT SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payments FROM member m LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) > 54699.87 ORDER BY member_no;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(c.charge_no) AS charge_count, COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charges FROM member m LEFT JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_no IS NULL AND m.curr_balance > 46.48 AND m.issue_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING COUNT(c.charge_no) = 0 ORDER BY m.member_no;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1998-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1998-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) > 2830.27 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance FROM member m JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.category_desc LIKE '%Medical%' AND m.state_prov = 'CA' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 9966.96 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, m.lastname, m.firstname;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM member m JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3619.93 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 77 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.region_no, m.corp_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(SUM(c.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no) AS avg_region_charges, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY m.corp_no) AS member_count_per_corp FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 9219.01 GROUP BY m.region_no, m.corp_no, m.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 39286.18 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.region_no, m.state_prov, m.country, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON p.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.statement_dt::DATE) = 5 GROUP BY m.region_no, m.state_prov, m.country HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 96490.69 ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 555.37 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 3003.94 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 47819.92 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 7975.67 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 21998.25 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 3876.01 AND AVG(p.payment_amt) < 232.18 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 859.81 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 22320.48 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_desc ORDER BY m.lastname, m.firstname) AS running_total_charges_by_category FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 7645.92 AND s.statement_amt > 8273.19 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ch.charge_dt::date) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.statement_dt::date)) BETWEEN -4 AND 1 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 17243.19 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, r.region_name, c.category_desc;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_desc ORDER BY m.lastname, m.firstname) AS running_total_charges_by_category FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 8422.4 AND s.statement_amt > 29582.49 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ch.charge_dt::date) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.statement_dt::date)) BETWEEN -4 AND 1 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 24587.0 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, r.region_name, c.category_desc;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payment, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_current_balance, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_previous_balance, SUM(m.curr_balance - m.prev_balance) AS balance_change FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON s.statement_no = pm.statement_no AND m.member_no = pm.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 40128.88 AND s.statement_amt > 81770.05 AND m.curr_balance > 78299.45 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND pm.payment_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name), (r.region_name, c.category_desc), (r.region_name, p.provider_name), (c.category_desc, p.provider_name), (r.region_name), (c.category_desc), (p.provider_name), ()) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 618620.59 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 110.3 ORDER BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name;

SELECT r.region_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt, COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_payments_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p2.payment_amt), 0) FROM payment p2 WHERE p2.member_no = m.member_no AND p2.payment_dt BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2023-12-31') AS payment_sum_in_period, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(SUM(c.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS prev_member_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no JOIN provider pv ON c.provider_no = pv.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 42411.83 AND s.statement_amt > 29843.23 AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 909410.64 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) > 6 ORDER BY r.region_name, total_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_amt > 5437.34 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_payment_count FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) > 69 ORDER BY member_count DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 94886.33 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_amt > 1632.08) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 87799.4 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_charge, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND co.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 977.53 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, ch.charge_dt, ch.charge_amt ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_desc, ch.charge_dt;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 48223.36 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN ch.charge_code = 'A' THEN ch.charge_amt ELSE 0 END) AS charge_code_a_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN pm.payment_code = 'P' THEN pm.payment_amt ELSE 0 END) AS payment_code_p_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt)) AS category_charge_percentile FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON s.statement_no = pm.statement_no AND m.member_no = pm.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2000-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 6558.94 AND m.curr_balance < 29374.97 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 447775.14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 26 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3743.37 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), ()) ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 840.62 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 242641.0 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT p.member_no) AS unique_members_paid FROM region r JOIN provider pr ON r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN charge ch ON pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON ch.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6863.65 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), () ) ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT p.statement_no) AS distinct_statements_paid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_charges_by_category FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6188.92 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -58071.4 AND s.statement_amt > 51588.79 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 23644.67 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) > 75 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) < 29355.32 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, s.statement_dt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS daily_charge_total, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS 6 PRECEDING) AS moving_avg_7day_charges FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE s.statement_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 8438.01 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, s.statement_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 10483.66 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no, s.statement_dt;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount FROM region r INNER JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND s.due_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 86412.14 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 95585.76 ORDER BY member_count DESC, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS current_balance_sum, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS previous_balance_sum, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region FROM region r LEFT JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no LEFT JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8227.39 AND s.statement_amt BETWEEN 15149.83 AND 59026.68 AND p.payment_amt >= 3517.23 AND m.curr_balance < 60919.13 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 2465.81 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 79 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) BETWEEN 45533.76 AND 114038.21 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, charge_rank_by_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region FROM region r LEFT JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no LEFT JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 7788.68 AND s.statement_amt > 15372.64 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 22713.11 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 34 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) > 14244.08 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, charge_rank_by_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS provider_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 452.8 AND s.statement_amt > 31302.73 AND m.curr_balance > 2042.46 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 15971.18 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) > 9 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) > 8666.42 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7459.87 AND p.payment_amt > 1878.4 AND s.statement_amt BETWEEN 5120.43 AND 8051.32 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 42726.44 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 1 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank LIMIT 87;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, pv.provider_no, pv.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT st.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(st.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no AND st.statement_no = pm.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 106.98 AND st.statement_amt > 12757.26 AND pm.payment_amt > 2720.97 AND m.curr_balance > 28739.3 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND st.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND pm.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, pv.provider_no, pv.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 86485.19 AND SUM(pm.payment_amt) > 3588.04 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 27 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payments_received, (SUM(s.statement_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(pay.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_outstanding, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS provider_rank_in_region, SUM(SUM(c.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, cat.category_no) AS category_total_in_region FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge c ON p.provider_no = c.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN member m ON c.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no AND m.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no AND c.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND s.member_no = pay.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND c.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 360354.18 AND s.statement_amt > 501549.37 AND pay.payment_amt > 872544.57 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, p.provider_no, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 1915832.23 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) >= 408.86 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charge_amount DESC, provider_rank_in_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SELECT AVG(sub_c.charge_amt) FROM charge sub_c WHERE sub_c.member_no = m.member_no AND sub_c.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS avg_recent_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND c.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 2811.85 AND s.statement_amt >= 5343.06 AND m.curr_balance <= 3754.12 AND cat.category_no IN (22, 31, 16) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 19700.56 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) >= 65 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE (c.charge_amt > 4946.82 OR p.payment_amt < 1450.69) AND NOT (m.state_prov = 'A' AND r.region_name LIKE 'A%') AND c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.country, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, m.state_prov) AS avg_charges_by_state, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS distinct_providers FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND (m.lastname LIKE 'A%' OR m.firstname LIKE 'A%') AND (c.category_desc LIKE '%Service%' OR c.category_code LIKE 'A') AND ch.charge_amt > 5675.51 AND s.statement_amt > 18608.59 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.country, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 90578.31 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 36826.04 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, total_charges DESC;

SELECT s.statement_no, s.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, m.curr_balance, r.region_name, cor.corp_name FROM statement s JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND s.member_no = c.member_no JOIN member m ON s.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation cor ON m.corp_no = cor.corp_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND s.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY s.statement_no, s.member_no, m.curr_balance, r.region_name, cor.corp_name HAVING (SUM(c.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) > 19500.51 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt FROM category c LEFT JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9669.82 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 18574.09 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC;
