SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND ch.member_no IN (SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 1181.77 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no LEFT JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no LEFT JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no LEFT JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1137.45 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 768.18 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (p.region_no = 31 OR p.state_prov = 'A') AND NOT (ch.charge_code = 'A') GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 303374.39 AND COUNT(*) >= 75644 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 42322.59 AND ch.member_no IN (SELECT member_no FROM statement WHERE statement_amt > 10774.4) GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 237298.3 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 95976.87 AND c.category_no IN (SELECT category_no FROM charge WHERE charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY category_no HAVING COUNT(*) > 557) GROUP BY c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 112.19 GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 9671.99 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, p.provider_name, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3033.26 GROUP BY c.category_desc, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 366053.68 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE c.category_desc LIKE 'A%' GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name ORDER BY avg_charge DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN region r ON ch.provider_no IN (SELECT pv.provider_no FROM provider pv WHERE pv.region_no = r.region_no) JOIN payment p ON ch.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 70174.15 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 497030.49 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, cor.corp_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_prev_balance, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_curr_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_activity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (ORDER BY r.region_name, c.category_desc) AS prev_region_category_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN region r ON pr.region_no = r.region_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation cor ON m.corp_no = cor.corp_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 843656.89 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND cor.corp_name LIKE 'A' AND pr.provider_name LIKE 'A' GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name, cor.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 2102921.8 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 3582 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_charge_rank, net_activity;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 992.57 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 20.79 INTERSECT SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt <= '2021-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt < 3124.45 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 70.17 ORDER BY category_no;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, MAX(ch.charge_amt) AS max_charge_amount, MIN(ch.charge_amt) AS min_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(DISTINCT p.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_current_balance, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_previous_balance, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(pm.payment_amt)) AS net_activity, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) DESC) AS charge_count_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (ORDER BY c.category_no) AS prev_category_total_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6651.47 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND p.provider_no IN (SELECT provider_no FROM provider WHERE region_no IN (SELECT region_no FROM region WHERE region_name LIKE 'A')) AND m.member_no IN (SELECT member_no FROM member WHERE curr_balance > -8936.18 AND prev_balance > -2529.63) AND co.corp_no IN (SELECT corp_no FROM corporation WHERE country = 'A') GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 128882.38 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 2542 AND AVG(ch.charge_amt) < 2370.16 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, total_charges DESC, c.category_no ASC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 1739.06 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 53261.33 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc UNION ALL SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_prev_balance, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member m JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE m.issue_dt >= '2018-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name;

SELECT c.charge_amt, c.charge_code, s.statement_code, m.member_code, p.provider_code, cat.category_code, SUM(c.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY s.statement_code ORDER BY c.charge_dt ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 6479.69) AS sub1) AS high_pay_member_count FROM charge c JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN member m ON c.member_no = m.member_no JOIN provider p ON c.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 4590.03 AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.charge_amt, c.charge_code, s.statement_code, m.member_code, p.provider_code, cat.category_code, c.charge_dt HAVING COUNT(c.charge_no) > 4.67 ORDER BY running_total DESC;

SELECT c.member_no, c.lastname, c.firstname, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_charge) FROM ( SELECT AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, MAX(ch.charge_amt) AS max_charge FROM charge ch WHERE ch.member_no = c.member_no AND ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY ch.category_no ) sub ) AS peak_charge FROM member c WHERE c.region_no = 8 GROUP BY c.member_no, c.lastname, c.firstname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charge ch2 WHERE ch2.member_no = c.member_no AND ch2.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY ch2.provider_no)) > 5 ORDER BY peak_charge DESC;

SELECT l.member_no, l.curr_balance AS curr_balance, r.prev_balance AS prev_balance, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM member l JOIN member r ON l.member_no = r.member_no AND l.curr_balance > r.prev_balance JOIN payment p ON l.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_amt >= 7197.58 GROUP BY l.member_no, l.curr_balance, r.prev_balance HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 1226.95 ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 3336.69 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.firstname, m.lastname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(p.payment_no) AS payment_count FROM member m JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.charge_dt = p.payment_dt WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2658.78 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 4357.89 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 8250.73 AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 36452.44 INTERSECT SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 2961.49 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 46024.07 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(c.charge_no) AS charge_count, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 65115.39 AND COUNT(c.charge_no) < 96 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND c.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 7241.73 AND p.payment_amt > 5250.01 AND s.statement_amt > 8544.46 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) > 3919.52 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no AND m.member_no::integer = c.member_no::integer JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND m.member_no::integer = p.member_no::integer JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND m.member_no::integer = s.member_no::integer WHERE c.charge_amt > 2624.69 AND p.payment_amt > 4235.45 AND s.statement_amt > 7605.6 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 41380.27 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 34795.26 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charge ch WHERE ch.member_no = m.member_no AND ch.charge_amt > 1469.88) AS high_charge_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider p ON c.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 2292.56 AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 5876.88 ORDER BY total_charges DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS payment_count_since_date, (SELECT SUM(c.charge_amt) FROM charge c WHERE c.member_no = m.member_no AND c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS total_charges_since_date FROM member m WHERE m.curr_balance > 9534.35 AND m.country = 'A' ORDER BY m.curr_balance DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_payment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charge ch WHERE ch.member_no = m.member_no AND ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements FROM member m LEFT JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 1893.79 AND m.expr_dt >= '2024-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 2928.73 OR SUM(ch.charge_amt) IS NULL ORDER BY m.curr_balance DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt FROM member m LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_no IS NULL AND m.curr_balance > 4440.66 AND m.issue_dt >= '2020-01-01' ORDER BY m.member_no;

SELECT m.region_no, m.state_prov, m.country, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON p.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.statement_dt::DATE) = 6 GROUP BY m.region_no, m.state_prov, m.country HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 59590.6 ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_name AS region, c.category_desc AS category, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM region r JOIN provider pv ON r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN charge ch ON pv.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 70654.9 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 838842.72 UNION ALL SELECT r.region_name AS region, 'All Categories' AS category, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 21089.94 GROUP BY r.region_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 248674.69 ORDER BY region, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM region r INNER JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no INNER JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no INNER JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 483.29 ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_charge FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3778.41 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, c.category_no, ch.charge_dt, ch.charge_amt ORDER BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, ch.charge_dt;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 942.93 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 1963.99 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 471.45 ORDER BY member_count DESC, avg_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE (ch.charge_amt > 9283.19 OR p.payment_amt < 992.9) AND NOT (m.curr_balance <= 4741.97 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01') AND (r.region_no = 10 OR c.category_no = 24) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 30680.25 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 29 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5404.09 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 2736.7 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 8698.6 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no) AS region_avg_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 1289.4 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT pm.member_no FROM payment pm WHERE pm.payment_amt > 118.31 AND pm.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 42894.44 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3434.58 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 2524.4 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 322.09 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 92748.2 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 5557.98 AND AVG(p.payment_amt) < 104.0 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 295.68 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 39742.27 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 699.42 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 7987.56 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_rank FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 144554.98 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.member_no, SUM(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no) AS region_category_total, AVG(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no) AS region_avg_charge FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3029.25 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, ch.charge_amt ORDER BY region_category_total DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.state_prov, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amt, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT p.member_no) AS unique_members_paid, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.provider_no) AS unique_providers, MAX(m.curr_balance) AS max_current_balance, MIN(m.prev_balance) AS min_previous_balance, SUM(m.curr_balance - m.prev_balance) AS net_balance_change, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r INNER JOIN corporation cor ON r.region_no = cor.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON cor.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 8895.14 AND p.payment_amt < 6248.01 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.state_prov HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 38173.44 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 675.11 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments ASC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name, c.category_desc) AS avg_category_charge_per_region, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON ch.member_no = pm.member_no AND ch.statement_no = pm.statement_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2023-12-31' AND ch.charge_amt > 5394.79 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 3048.99 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no) AS avg_statement_by_region_corp, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 163574.08 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, r.region_no, c.corp_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 348472.7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 8 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, c.category_no, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_curr_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_activity, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(s.statement_amt) DESC) AS statement_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE (ch.charge_amt > 4669.61 OR p.payment_amt > 3071.07) AND (s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' OR s.due_dt >= '2020-01-01') AND NOT (m.country = 'USA' AND m.state_prov IN ('CA', 'NY')) AND (ch.charge_code = 'A' OR ch.charge_code = 'B' OR ch.charge_code = 'C') AND (pr.provider_code = 'X' OR pr.provider_code = 'Y') AND (c.category_code = 'Z' OR c.category_code = 'W') GROUP BY r.region_no, c.category_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 24922.08 AND (SUM(p.payment_amt) > 43463.15 OR AVG(m.prev_balance) < -5775.11) AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 645 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments ASC;

SELECT r.region_no, c.category_no, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2418.2 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, c.category_no), (r.region_no), (c.category_no), () ) ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, 'charge' AS source_type, COUNT(DISTINCT c.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_amount FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 35.88 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name UNION ALL SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, 'payment' AS source_type, COUNT(DISTINCT p.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_amount FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 9709.06 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name ORDER BY region_no, source_type;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS distinct_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS distinct_payments, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM region r JOIN provider pr ON r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN charge c ON pr.provider_no = c.provider_no JOIN payment p ON c.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 78327.76 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m2.member_no) FROM member m2 WHERE m2.region_no = r.region_no AND m2.prev_balance > 3227.79) AS high_balance_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge c ON p.provider_no = c.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN member m ON c.member_no = m.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 2458.31 AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 21410.47 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS distinct_charges, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt >= 7211.76 AND p.payment_amt <= 2917.8 AND c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 21468.85 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, (SELECT AVG(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS avg_recent_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 266.43 AND s.statement_amt >= 3570.8 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 10 ORDER BY member_count DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 86355.05 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 8 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amt FROM region r LEFT JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no LEFT JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' OR s.statement_dt IS NULL GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) < 764 ORDER BY total_statement_amt DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01') AS recent_payments FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 718795.39 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_amt > 3103.01 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' ) AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 9735.79 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 16375.54 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 41553.16 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(st.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount FROM region r JOIN provider pr ON r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN charge ch ON pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no LEFT JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no AND st.statement_dt >= '1995-01-01' WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1995-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 407.99 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 56432.89 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN ch.charge_code = 'A' THEN ch.charge_amt ELSE 0 END) AS charge_code_a_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN pm.payment_code = 'P' THEN pm.payment_amt ELSE 0 END) AS payment_code_p_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt)) AS category_charge_percentile FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON s.statement_no = pm.statement_no AND m.member_no = pm.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2000-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 5372.97 AND m.curr_balance < 28649.58 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 119043.69 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 37 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_per_category, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges_per_region_category, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members_charged, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_current_balance_in_region, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments_in_region, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements_in_region, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_charge_payment_diff, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_category_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3888.74 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -3137.13 AND p.payment_amt > 1765.74 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 25991.6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 81.06 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges_per_region_category DESC, region_category_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no || '|' || ch.statement_no) AS distinct_member_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS distinct_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4102.17 AND s.statement_amt >= 57705.33 AND m.curr_balance < 36026.63 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 426206.91 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) >= 29 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT p.member_no) AS unique_members_paid FROM region r JOIN provider pr ON r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN charge ch ON pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON ch.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1412.4 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), () ) ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.corp_no, corp.corp_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, SUM(m.prev_balance + m.curr_balance) AS total_member_balance FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 77252.96 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.corp_no, corp.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 65070.65 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 260 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, region_no, category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no) AS avg_net_balance_by_region_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) DESC) AS member_balance_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 89780.43 AND s.statement_amt > 22795.22 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) > -82989.4 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charges, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payments, COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.statement_no) AS statements_with_payments FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' WHERE m.curr_balance > 7945.45 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname), (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name), (r.region_no, r.region_name), () ) HAVING (GROUPING(r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname) = 0 AND COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) > 1795.7) OR GROUPING(r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname) != 0 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, m.member_no;
