SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT pmt.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(pmt.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT st.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(st.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(pmt.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region FROM region r INNER JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON st.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment pmt ON st.statement_no = pmt.statement_no AND m.member_no = pmt.member_no LEFT JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no LEFT JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4558.59 AND st.statement_amt > 8548.29 AND pmt.payment_amt > 3671.79 AND m.curr_balance > 3239.54 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND st.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND pmt.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, p.provider_no, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 80622.14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 43 AND SUM(pmt.payment_amt) > 1086.67 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, charge_rank_by_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt) AS prev_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON m.member_no = pay.member_no AND s.statement_no = pay.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4160.44 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_amt >= 25036.49 AND m.curr_balance <= 58968.95 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, ch.charge_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 6137.12 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 14 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(st.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(m.curr_balance, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.corp_no ORDER BY MAX(st.statement_dt)) AS prev_corp_member_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN charge ch ON st.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON st.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND st.statement_dt <= '1995-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3542.23 AND p.payment_amt > 753.76 AND st.statement_amt > 16325.67 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 14057.64 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 10483.6 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank_in_region, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.prev_balance, m.curr_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no ORDER BY m.member_no) AS prev_member_charge, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no) AS members_per_corporation, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no) AS region_total_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 8828.62 AND p.payment_amt > 7851.98 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.prev_balance, m.curr_balance HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 35402.46 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 43862.15 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank_in_region, c.corp_no, m.member_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.corp_no, c.corp_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members_charged, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND (s.due_dt <= '2020-01-01' OR s.due_dt IS NULL) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.corp_no, c.corp_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 62749.54 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_no, corp_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.corp_no, c.corp_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, CASE WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 326884.33 THEN 'High Charge' WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) BETWEEN 9397.6 AND 3991.28 THEN 'Medium Charge' ELSE 'Low Charge' END AS charge_category, CASE WHEN AVG(s.statement_amt) - SUM(pay.payment_amt) > 3340.78 THEN 'High Outstanding' WHEN AVG(s.statement_amt) - SUM(pay.payment_amt) BETWEEN 161.48 AND 225.96 THEN 'Medium Outstanding' ELSE 'Low Outstanding' END AS outstanding_category, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS total_statements, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pay.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank_global FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND m.member_no = pay.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 2765.86 AND s.statement_amt > 3857.66 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.corp_no, c.corp_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 27336.45 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) > 27 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank_in_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS distinct_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT chg.charge_no) AS distinct_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT cat.category_no) AS distinct_categories, COUNT(DISTINCT chg.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, SUM(chg.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, MAX(chg.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date, MIN(p.payment_dt) AS earliest_payment_date, SUM(CASE WHEN chg.charge_code = 'A' THEN chg.charge_amt ELSE 0 END) AS charge_code_a_total, SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_code = 'P' THEN p.payment_amt ELSE 0 END) AS payment_code_p_total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.prev_balance > m.curr_balance) AS members_balance_decreased, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(chg.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) DESC) AS global_statement_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN charge chg ON s.statement_no = chg.statement_no AND m.member_no = chg.member_no JOIN category cat ON chg.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider prov ON chg.provider_no = prov.provider_no AND r.region_no = prov.region_no WHERE chg.charge_amt > 6464.88 AND s.statement_amt >= 27914.66 AND p.payment_amt >= 13747.43 AND chg.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND m.issue_dt <= '1980-01-01' AND s.due_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(chg.charge_amt) > 89774.57 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) >= 149 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) > 190 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_charge_rank ASC, global_statement_rank ASC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SELECT AVG(sub_c.charge_amt) FROM charge sub_c WHERE sub_c.member_no = m.member_no AND sub_c.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS avg_recent_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND c.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 3434.28 AND s.statement_amt >= 259.85 AND m.curr_balance <= 471.02 AND cat.category_no IN (34, 15, 2) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 37619.24 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) >= 86 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT c.category_no) AS distinct_categories, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(SUM(c.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY MAX(c.charge_dt)) AS prev_member_charge_total FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 7575.9 AND p.payment_amt > 4083.18 AND s.statement_amt BETWEEN 8203.18 AND 48941.28 AND c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 86878.53 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.category_no) >= 36 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, AVG(COALESCE(s.statement_amt, 0)) AS avg_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pv ON c.provider_no = pv.provider_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (pv.region_no = 27 OR pv.region_no IS NULL) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 199082.59 UNION ALL SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, NULL::integer AS member_no, NULL::character varying AS lastname, NULL::character varying AS firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, 0::numeric AS total_payments, 0::bigint AS statement_count, 0::numeric AS avg_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pv ON c.provider_no = pv.provider_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND pv.provider_no IN (SELECT provider_no FROM provider WHERE region_no = 58) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) > 577 ORDER BY region_no, charge_rank_in_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, AVG(SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no) AS region_avg_net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS balance_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation cor ON r.region_no = cor.region_no JOIN member m ON cor.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 549160.16 AND c.charge_amt > 24589.15 AND p.payment_amt > 63032.89 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 806075.79 ORDER BY r.region_no, balance_rank_in_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS balance_rank_in_region FROM member m JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 205.58 AND p.payment_amt > 830.84 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) > 27450.08 ORDER BY r.region_no, balance_rank_in_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS balance_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 1853.97 AND m.curr_balance < 4147.4 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 32390.94 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 9 ORDER BY r.region_no, balance_rank;

SELECT r1.region_no, r1.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.member_no) AS members_in_region, COUNT(DISTINCT m2.member_no) AS members_in_same_state, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r1 JOIN region r2 ON r1.state_prov = r2.state_prov AND r1.region_no != r2.region_no JOIN member m1 ON r1.region_no = m1.region_no JOIN member m2 ON r2.region_no = m2.region_no AND m1.state_prov = m2.state_prov JOIN charge c ON m1.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m1.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON m1.member_no = s.member_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN corporation corp ON m1.corp_no = corp.corp_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 794.19 AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_amt < 1124.5 GROUP BY r1.region_no, r1.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 35837.99 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT s.member_no, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement FROM statement s JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 1557.47 AND cat.category_no = 83 GROUP BY s.member_no HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 25 INTERSECT SELECT p.member_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment FROM payment p WHERE p.payment_amt > 2428.48 GROUP BY p.member_no HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY total_statement DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance FROM category c LEFT JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no LEFT JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 202.81 GROUP BY c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS latest_statement FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND (s.due_dt < '2023-01-01' OR s.statement_dt < '2022-01-01') AND ch.charge_amt > 2873.35 GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 46536.86 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1995-01-01') AS recent_payments FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 457.77 AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 6096.24 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 9189.45 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 55037.37 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation cor ON r.region_no = cor.region_no JOIN member m ON cor.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= (SELECT MIN(payment_dt) FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 5356.86) AND ch.charge_dt <= (SELECT MAX(payment_dt) FROM payment WHERE payment_amt < 3908.24) AND ch.charge_amt > (SELECT AVG(charge_amt) FROM charge WHERE charge_code = 'A') GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 223882.22 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6923.5 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc UNION ALL SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payment p JOIN member m ON p.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 3122.04 AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc ORDER BY region_name, category_desc;

SELECT r.region_name, m.country, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT st.statement_no) AS statement_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member m2 WHERE m2.region_no = r.region_no AND m2.country = m.country) AS member_count_in_region_country FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN charge ch ON st.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON st.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND st.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 787156.7 GROUP BY r.region_name, m.country, c.category_desc, r.region_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 130355.61 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charge ch WHERE ch.member_no = m.member_no AND ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS recent_charges_count, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS recent_payments_sum FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN corporation c ON m.corp_no = c.corp_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 29810.38 AND m.expr_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance ORDER BY m.curr_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, c.category_no, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 272.46 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, c.category_no), (r.region_no), (c.category_no), () ) ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, COUNT(DISTINCT c.member_no) AS distinct_members, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 10126.83 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 5029.4 AND c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, (SELECT AVG(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01') AS avg_member_payment FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 468.34 AND c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 59527.25 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) FROM member m WHERE m.region_no = r.region_no AND m.expr_dt >= '1995-01-01' ) AS active_members_in_region FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1995-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 230988.02 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM region r JOIN provider pr ON r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN charge ch ON pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON ch.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2023-12-31' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 945303.76 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member m2 WHERE m2.region_no = r.region_no AND m2.expr_dt >= '2020-01-01') AS active_members_in_region FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 2234.24 AND m.curr_balance < -1604.19 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 28982.29 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_name, p.provider_name, cat.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(m.prev_balance + m.curr_balance) AS total_member_balance, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY c.corp_no) AS prev_corp_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON s.statement_no = pm.statement_no AND m.member_no = pm.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7358.29 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_amt > 23331.16 AND p.provider_no > 6597 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 464232.58 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 245 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 1482.8 AND s.statement_amt > 48323.73 AND m.curr_balance > 87539.26 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 28712.49 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 70 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) > 12056.85 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 37497.61 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SELECT AVG(sub_ch.charge_amt) FROM charge sub_ch JOIN statement sub_s ON sub_ch.statement_no = sub_s.statement_no WHERE sub_s.member_no = m.member_no AND sub_ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.category_no) AS distinct_categories, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS latest_statement_date, MIN(s.due_dt) AS earliest_due_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment sub_p WHERE sub_p.member_no = m.member_no AND sub_p.payment_dt BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31') AS payments_in_range, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank_global FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2538.73 AND s.statement_amt >= 39128.32 AND cat.category_code IN ('A', 'B') AND pr.provider_code = 'P' AND s.statement_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 59088.07 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) >= 31 AND AVG(p.payment_amt) BETWEEN 3284.69 AND 7614.61 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments ASC, latest_statement_date DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no) AS avg_charges_per_region, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3633.87 AND p.payment_amt > 3688.28 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > SUM(p.payment_amt) AND SUM(s.statement_amt) > 816.89 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank_in_region, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_curr_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT p.statement_no) AS distinct_statements_paid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank_global FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ( (ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' OR p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' OR s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01') AND (ch.charge_amt > 768736.36 OR p.payment_amt > 955953.84 OR s.statement_amt > 405493.11) AND NOT (m.country = 'USA' AND m.state_prov IN ('CA','NY')) AND (m.expr_dt > '2024-01-01' OR m.expr_dt IS NULL) AND (c.expr_dt > '2024-01-01' OR c.expr_dt IS NULL) AND (r.region_no IN (56, 59, 78) OR c.corp_no BETWEEN 6688 AND 5960) ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 71867.81 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 71552.38 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 88 AND (AVG(m.prev_balance) - AVG(m.curr_balance)) > 89111.12 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments ASC, region_no, corp_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, pv.provider_no, pv.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT st.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(st.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no AND st.statement_no = pm.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2501.95 AND st.statement_amt > 19021.33 AND pm.payment_amt > 3006.9 AND m.curr_balance > 62327.98 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, pv.provider_no, pv.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 77227.98 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 17 AND SUM(pm.payment_amt) > 44933.77 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.corp_no, c.corp_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, DATE_TRUNC('month', ch.charge_dt::DATE) AS charge_month, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(st.statement_amt) AS total_statements, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_curr_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS charged_members, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.member_no) AS paying_members, COUNT(DISTINCT st.member_no) AS statement_members, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.corp_no ORDER BY SUM(pm.payment_amt) DESC) AS corp_payment_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no AND ch.statement_no = pm.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no AND ch.statement_no = st.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt::DATE >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt::DATE <= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 4022.44 AND p.provider_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.corp_no, c.corp_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, DATE_TRUNC('month', ch.charge_dt::DATE) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 221158.84 AND SUM(pm.payment_amt) > 344869.23 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 541 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, CASE WHEN SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) > 0 THEN 'Net Debt' WHEN SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) < 0 THEN 'Net Credit' ELSE 'Balanced' END AS member_financial_status FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 3189.71 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, m.prev_balance, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS distinct_charges, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01') AS recent_payments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM statement s WHERE s.member_no = m.member_no AND s.statement_amt > 34056.43) AS high_statements, MAX(c.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date, MIN(c.charge_dt) AS earliest_charge_date, pv.provider_name, cat.category_desc, corp.corp_name FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN provider pv ON c.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN statement st ON c.statement_no = st.statement_no AND m.member_no = st.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND c.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 2908.72 AND c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -82275.03 AND m.prev_balance > 50509.69 AND pv.provider_code = 'A' AND cat.category_code = 'A' AND corp.corp_code = 'A' AND r.region_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, m.prev_balance, pv.provider_name, cat.category_desc, corp.corp_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 85519.34 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) >= 299 AND AVG(c.charge_amt) BETWEEN 228.5 AND 600.94 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, m.member_no ASC;

WITH regional_charges AS ( SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND corp.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc ), member_analysis AS ( SELECT m.member_no, m.region_no, m.corp_no, m.curr_balance, m.prev_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS lifetime_charges, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment pm WHERE pm.member_no = m.member_no AND pm.payment_amt > 7227.9) AS large_payments_count FROM member m JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no WHERE m.issue_dt >= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.region_no, m.corp_no, m.curr_balance, m.prev_balance ), corp_performance AS ( SELECT corp.corp_no, corp.corp_name, r.region_no, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_balance, SUM(ma.lifetime_charges) AS corp_total_charges, (SELECT AVG(s.statement_amt) FROM statement s JOIN member m2 ON s.member_no = m2.member_no WHERE m2.corp_no = corp.corp_no AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01') AS avg_statement_amt FROM corporation corp JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN member_analysis ma ON m.member_no = ma.member_no WHERE corp.expr_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY corp.corp_no, corp.corp_name, r.region_no ) SELECT rc.region_no, rc.region_name, rc.category_no, rc.category_desc, rc.total_charges, rc.charge_count, rc.avg_charge_amt, cp.corp_no, cp.corp_name, cp.member_count, cp.total_balance, cp.corp_total_charges, cp.avg_statement_amt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member m2 JOIN charge ch2 ON m2.member_no = ch2.member_no WHERE m2.region_no = rc.region_no AND ch2.category_no = rc.category_no AND ch2.charge_amt > 545.83) AS high_value_charges_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rc.region_no ORDER BY rc.total_charges DESC) AS region_category_rank, SUM(rc.total_charges) OVER (PARTITION BY rc.region_no) AS region_total_charges, rc.total_charges / NULLIF(SUM(rc.total_charges) OVER (PARTITION BY rc.region_no), 0) * 100 AS pct_of_region_charges FROM regional_charges rc JOIN corp_performance cp ON rc.region_no = cp.region_no JOIN category cat ON rc.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE rc.total_charges > 127169.78 AND cp.corp_total_charges > 453612.56 GROUP BY rc.region_no, rc.region_name, rc.category_no, rc.category_desc, rc.total_charges, rc.charge_count, rc.avg_charge_amt, cp.corp_no, cp.corp_name, cp.member_count, cp.total_balance, cp.corp_total_charges, cp.avg_statement_amt HAVING COUNT(*) > 7 ORDER BY rc.total_charges DESC, region_category_rank ASC LIMIT 746;

SELECT c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS member_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c LEFT JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 282.49 ORDER BY member_count DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND ch.member_no IN (SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 56752.05 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 9755.03 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment py WHERE py.member_no = m.member_no AND py.payment_dt >= '2000-01-01' ) GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 18763.51 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, MAX(s.statement_amt) AS max_statement_amt, MIN(p.payment_amt) AS min_payment_amt, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_no) AS charges_per_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS category_rank FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN payment p ON s.member_no = p.member_no AND p.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND pr.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1752.52 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -73582.26 AND pr.provider_no > 8695 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 71489.17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 527 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, category_rank;

SELECT c.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM charge c JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 7542.08 AND p.payment_amt > 4894.89 GROUP BY c.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 2487.04 INTERSECT SELECT c.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM charge c JOIN member m ON c.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 8370.34 AND r.region_no = 3 GROUP BY c.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 19202.57;

SELECT c.member_no, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount FROM member c JOIN statement s ON c.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 48.15 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.member_no ORDER BY total_statement_amount DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COALESCE(SUM(s.statement_amt), 0) AS total_statement, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payment, (COALESCE(SUM(s.statement_amt), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance FROM member m LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND s.statement_dt >= '2023-01-01' LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01' WHERE m.issue_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING (COALESCE(SUM(s.statement_amt), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) > 7414.61 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(c.charge_no) AS charge_count, COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charges FROM member m LEFT JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 3004.68 AND (c.charge_dt IS NULL OR c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01') GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING COUNT(c.charge_no) < 9 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS charge_count FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 9322.58 AND c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charge ch WHERE ch.member_no = m.member_no AND ch.charge_amt > 2346.38) AS high_charge_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider p ON c.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 2294.91 AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 4164.71 ORDER BY total_charges DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3861.83 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 54778.43 ORDER BY avg_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amt, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amt, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, MIN(ch.charge_dt) AS earliest_charge, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_category_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 2961.24 AND s.statement_amt > 39381.12 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 21475.89 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 571 AND AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 1779.97 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC, region_category_rank, charge_count DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, MIN(ch.charge_dt) AS earliest_charge_date, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3115.41 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2000-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -4444.89 AND m.prev_balance > 5873.7 AND co.corp_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 25741.34 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7398.01 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 24380.61 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.member_no, SUM(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no) AS region_category_total, AVG(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no) AS region_avg_charge FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9826.14 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, ch.charge_amt ORDER BY region_category_total DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM region r LEFT JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no AND c.corp_code = 'A' LEFT JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND m.member_code = 'A' LEFT JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no AND ch.charge_amt > 8813.87 WHERE r.region_no IN (9) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 11922.28 OR SUM(ch.charge_amt) IS NULL ORDER BY member_count DESC, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS charge_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN provider pv ON c.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 4146.21 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM charge WHERE charge_dt >= '2019-01-01' AND charge_amt > 3809.39 AND provider_no IN ( SELECT provider_no FROM provider WHERE region_no = 6 AND expr_dt >= '2022-01-01' ) ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 12017.91 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) >= 72 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.country, COUNT(DISTINCT c.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS latest_statement_date FROM member m JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider prov ON c.provider_no = prov.provider_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 7822.62 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM charge c2 WHERE c2.member_no = m.member_no AND c2.charge_code = 'A' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM statement s2 WHERE s2.member_no = m.member_no AND s2.due_dt >= '2020-01-01' ) GROUP BY r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.country, m.member_code, m.lastname, m.firstname, corp.corp_name, cat.category_desc, prov.provider_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 7509.01 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) >= 91 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, member_count DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, (SELECT AVG(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS avg_recent_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 178.67 AND s.statement_amt >= 3606.24 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 5 ORDER BY member_count DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON p.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 5693.95 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 274847.27 ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, COUNT(DISTINCT p.provider_no) AS total_providers, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(py.payment_amt) AS total_payments, CASE WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) > SUM(py.payment_amt) THEN 'Deficit' WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) < SUM(py.payment_amt) THEN 'Surplus' ELSE 'Balanced' END AS financial_status, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_member_balance FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no AND p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN payment py ON m.member_no = py.member_no JOIN statement s ON py.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND py.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_amt > 23749.4 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 536484.07 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6815.59 AND s.statement_amt < 4800.91 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 20711.1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 39 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, member_count DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment, MAX(s.statement_amt) AS max_statement, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN provider pv ON r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN charge ch ON pv.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation cp ON m.corp_no = cp.corp_no AND m.region_no = cp.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 8085.48 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 947410.69 UNION ALL SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, 'ALL_CATEGORIES' AS category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment, MAX(s.statement_amt) AS max_statement, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 5794.79 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 942124.02 ORDER BY region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, COUNT(*) AS total_charges_count FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND m.member_no = pay.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 6323.63 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 2097.38 AND payment_dt BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-01-01' ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 836336.01 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 93 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_no, category_desc;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, SUM(m.prev_balance + m.curr_balance) AS total_member_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 237220.55 AND s.statement_amt >= 412139.87 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 6568840.77 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 5348 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, SUM(m.prev_balance + m.curr_balance) AS total_member_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 38082.01 AND s.statement_amt >= 482307.97 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 1078224.39 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 4819 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, MIN(s.due_dt) AS earliest_due_date, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS latest_statement_date, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_prev_balance, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_curr_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) FILTER (WHERE s.statement_amt > 781.4) AS high_statement_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) FILTER (WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01') AS recent_charges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM provider pr WHERE pr.region_no = r.region_no AND pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no AND pr.expr_dt > '2025-01-01' ) AND ch.charge_amt >= 600.78 AND s.due_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 94070.43 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 60 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_no, category_no;
