SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(*) AS total_charges FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2914.62 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5938.28 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 12608.94 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2483.26 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), () ) ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_member_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS charged_members_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.member_no) AS paying_members_count FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7507.23 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (p.payment_dt IS NULL OR p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01') AND m.curr_balance < -6570.04 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 47190.18 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) > 599 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, region_no, category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r INNER JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no INNER JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no INNER JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no INNER JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 9656.26 AND s.statement_amt > 37977.94 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 30731.34 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 3 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank ASC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS unique_providers, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE (ch.charge_amt > 9231.77 OR s.statement_amt < 346.47) AND (m.curr_balance >= 7498.81 OR m.prev_balance <= 4467.78) AND NOT (ch.charge_dt < '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt > '2020-01-01') AND (cat.category_no IN (19, 18, 3) OR pv.provider_no BETWEEN 412 AND 911) AND (s.due_dt >= '2020-01-01' OR m.issue_dt <= '2010-01-01') GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 30815.8 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 12 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) BETWEEN 526.89 AND 3654.26 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank ASC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no) AS avg_net_balance_per_corp, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS region_net_balance_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2023-12-31' AND ch.charge_amt > 2431.17 AND (s.statement_dt >= '2019-01-01' OR s.statement_dt IS NULL) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) > 14249.48 ORDER BY r.region_no, region_net_balance_rank, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1391.38 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_amt >= 4124.46 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 11786.22 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS provider_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8985.67 AND s.statement_amt >= 25000.81 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 68559.35 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 36961.58 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 20 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, pv.provider_no, pv.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT st.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(st.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no AND ch.statement_no = st.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no AND st.statement_no = pm.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5201.47 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND st.statement_amt > 46183.38 AND st.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 66909.48 AND pm.payment_amt > 3475.78 AND pm.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, pv.provider_no, pv.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 87849.89 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 29 AND SUM(pm.payment_amt) > 3799.2 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, charge_rank_by_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.country AS member_country, p.country AS provider_country, cat.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_curr_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no AND m.country = r.country JOIN corporation c ON m.corp_no = c.corp_no AND m.country = c.country JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND p.country = r.country JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND s.member_no = m.member_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND pay.payment_dt BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '1990-01-01' WHERE ch.charge_amt > 499730.05 AND m.curr_balance < 895143.35 AND c.corp_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.country, p.country, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 4020444.76 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 698 UNION ALL SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, NULL AS member_country, p.country AS provider_country, cat.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, 0 AS total_payments, 0 AS avg_prev_balance, 0 AS avg_curr_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no AND p.country = r.country JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 992034.52 AND p.provider_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, p.country, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 8694516.2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 398 ORDER BY region_charge_rank, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT c.category_no) AS distinct_categories, SUM(c.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(SUM(c.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY c.charge_dt) AS prev_charge_amt FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND m.member_no = c.member_no LEFT JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 2236.04 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.charge_dt HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 35173.73 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.category_no) >= 4 ORDER BY r.region_no, net_balance DESC, charge_rank_in_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, CASE WHEN SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) > 0 THEN 'Net Debt' WHEN SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) < 0 THEN 'Net Credit' ELSE 'Balanced' END AS member_financial_status FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 8928.14 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS balance_rank_in_region FROM member m JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 4530.31 AND p.payment_amt > 1702.69 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) > 33873.16 ORDER BY r.region_no, balance_rank_in_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov AS member_state, m.country AS member_country, c.corp_name, p.provider_name, cat.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT py.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(py.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_current_balance, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_previous_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, m.state_prov ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS prev_charge_amount_by_state FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment py ON s.statement_no = py.statement_no AND m.member_no = py.member_no WHERE ( (ch.charge_amt > 37938.23 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01') OR (s.statement_amt BETWEEN 21272.77 AND 182433.11) OR (m.curr_balance < -3025.9 AND m.prev_balance > 65.07) ) AND NOT (p.provider_code = 'A' OR cat.category_code = 'A') AND (m.country = 'US' OR c.country = 'US') AND (ch.charge_code IN ('A', 'B') OR s.statement_code = 'A') GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.country, c.corp_name, p.provider_name, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 52153.65 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 145 AND (AVG(ch.charge_amt) < 32942.8 OR SUM(py.payment_amt) > 250246.58) ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, total_current_balance ASC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amt FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE m.country = 'US' AND m.issue_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND m.prev_balance > 6454.73 AND s.statement_amt < 3515.44 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) > 63 AND AVG(m.prev_balance) < 2072.2 ORDER BY total_statement_amt DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, s.statement_dt, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amt, AVG(SUM(s.statement_amt)) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3period FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 6175.81 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, s.statement_dt HAVING SUM(s.statement_amt) < 257443.7 ORDER BY r.region_no, s.statement_dt;

SELECT s.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM statement s JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY s.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 1020.88 INTERSECT SELECT p.member_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM payment p WHERE p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY p.member_no HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 5195.02 ORDER BY member_no;

SELECT c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS member_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c LEFT JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 70.93 ORDER BY member_count DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance FROM category c LEFT JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no LEFT JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 9251.9 GROUP BY c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND ch.member_no IN (SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 95955.67 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, r.region_name, pr.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS distinct_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT m.corp_no) AS distinct_corporations, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN region r ON co.region_no = r.region_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON ch.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9575.1 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 3698.04 AND pr.expr_dt >= '1995-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc, r.region_name, pr.provider_name, r.region_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 99603.99 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) > 96 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT c.charge_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount FROM charge c JOIN payment p ON c.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 8451.42 AND p.payment_amt > 2857.83 GROUP BY c.charge_no ORDER BY total_payment_amount DESC;

SELECT c.region_no, m.state_prov, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS average_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date FROM charge ch JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN member m ON s.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation c ON m.corp_no = c.corp_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN region r ON c.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 26833.66 AND p.payment_amt < 46715.27 AND s.statement_amt >= 74257.05 GROUP BY c.region_no, m.state_prov ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charge c WHERE c.member_no = m.member_no AND c.charge_amt > 947.89) AS high_charge_count, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_payments FROM member m WHERE m.region_no = 6 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM corporation corp WHERE corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND corp.region_no = m.region_no ) ORDER BY high_charge_count DESC, recent_payments DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) AS statement_count FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider p ON c.provider_no = p.provider_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment pmt WHERE pmt.member_no = m.member_no AND pmt.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' ) GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 5670.83 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND c.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 3152.75 AND p.payment_amt > 1758.22 AND s.statement_amt > 1696.17 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) > -4592.23 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_name AS region, c.category_desc AS category, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM region r JOIN provider pv ON r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN charge ch ON pv.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 52178.21 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 413734.87 UNION ALL SELECT r.region_name AS region, 'All Categories' AS category, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 92816.23 GROUP BY r.region_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 931143.91 ORDER BY region, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_amt > 7669.74 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM provider pr WHERE pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no AND pr.region_no = r.region_no AND pr.expr_dt >= ch.charge_dt ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 428715.68 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_curr_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation cor ON r.region_no = cor.region_no AND r.region_no IS NOT NULL AND cor.region_no IS NOT NULL JOIN member m ON cor.corp_no = m.corp_no AND cor.corp_no IS NOT NULL AND m.corp_no IS NOT NULL JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no AND m.member_no IS NOT NULL AND ch.member_no IS NOT NULL JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no AND ch.category_no IS NOT NULL AND c.category_no IS NOT NULL JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND m.member_no IS NOT NULL AND p.member_no IS NOT NULL JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND m.member_no IS NOT NULL AND s.member_no IS NOT NULL JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND ch.provider_no IS NOT NULL AND pr.provider_no IS NOT NULL WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1416.59 AND s.statement_amt > 28851.16 AND p.payment_amt > 4323.61 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname), (r.region_name, c.category_desc), (r.region_name), ()) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > SUM(p.payment_amt) AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) > 49.51 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, p.provider_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(pm.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, SUM(st.statement_amt) AS total_statements, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN charge ch ON st.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON st.statement_no = pm.statement_no AND m.member_no = pm.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7987.88 AND st.statement_amt > 21820.9 AND pm.payment_amt > 1379.99 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND st.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, ch.charge_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 1466.32 AND AVG(pm.payment_amt) > 32.3 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, p.provider_name, cat.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS num_statements, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(pay.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, AVG(SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(pay.payment_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name) AS avg_region_net_balance FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge c ON p.provider_no = c.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN member m ON c.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no AND m.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no AND c.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND s.member_no = pay.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 6994.71 GROUP BY r.region_name, p.provider_name, cat.category_desc, r.region_no, p.provider_no, cat.category_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 175049.58 AND (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(pay.payment_amt)) > 73137.8 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, r.region_name, p.provider_name;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_balance, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 6537.05 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 6459.23 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT p.member_no FROM payment p WHERE p.payment_amt > 985.75 AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pr.provider_no) FROM provider pr WHERE pr.region_no = r.region_no AND pr.expr_dt >= '2020-01-01') AS active_providers, (SELECT SUM(ch.charge_amt) FROM charge ch JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.member_no IN (SELECT m2.member_no FROM member m2 WHERE m2.region_no = r.region_no) AND cat.category_code = 'A') AS category_specific_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 462.23 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 942110.97 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 834 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_payments_count, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amt FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 3503.5 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 30156.95 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no) AS avg_charges_per_region FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2543.26 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 8378.62 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_per_category, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges_per_region_category, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members_charged, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_current_balance_in_region, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments_in_region, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements_in_region, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_charge_payment_diff, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_category_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9234.1 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -3009.96 AND p.payment_amt > 1351.89 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 57912.58 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 24.98 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges_per_region_category DESC, region_category_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 1889.41 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), () ) ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.state_prov, m.country, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amt, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date, MIN(p.payment_dt) AS earliest_payment_date, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank_global FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 29355.9 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_amt > 36156.09 AND s.due_dt <= '1995-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -41191.28 AND ch.charge_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.state_prov, m.country HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 374515.8 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 331 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, net_balance ASC LIMIT 657;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS unique_providers, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 1518.28 AND s.statement_amt > 43010.48 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 15326.03 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 9 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 25770.87 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS provider_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1098.95 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_amt < 12146.8 AND p.payment_amt > 1284.16 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 37734.54 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 18 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (m.curr_balance + SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS projected_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM statement s WHERE s.member_no = m.member_no AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS recent_statements, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (m.curr_balance + SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS balance_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3575.99 AND p.payment_amt > 6828.08 AND pr.region_no = r.region_no GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) > 3095.37 ORDER BY r.region_no, balance_rank_in_region, projected_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_code, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, AVG(COALESCE(m.prev_balance, 0)) AS avg_prev_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT c.provider_no) AS distinct_providers FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND c.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 41600.3 AND m.curr_balance < 81714.81 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_code HAVING (SUM(c.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) > 2099.62 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, r.region_no, m.member_code;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 305.11 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 6053.43 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charge, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_curr_balance, SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_activity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 2822.39 AND p.payment_amt > 1247.18 AND s.statement_amt > 8403.06 AND m.curr_balance > 9124.67 AND pr.region_no = r.region_no GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 9735.83 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 26877.84 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) > 830 ORDER BY total_charge DESC, member_count DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS members_charged, COALESCE(AVG(p.payment_amt), 0) AS avg_payment, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM category c LEFT JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN payment p ON ch.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no LEFT JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE (ch.charge_amt > 9287.31 OR ch.charge_amt IS NULL) GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) > 42837.08 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7401.45 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 73234.63 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_desc ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON p.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND (m.curr_balance > 5784.5 OR m.prev_balance < -2865.03) AND NOT (s.statement_code = 'A') GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 22672.83 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_desc ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON p.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND (m.curr_balance > 8297.45 OR m.prev_balance < -4813.94) AND NOT (s.statement_code = 'A') GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 6507.58 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c LEFT JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no AND ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' LEFT JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no AND m.curr_balance > 2283.56 WHERE c.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 852 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE r.region_name LIKE 'North%' AND ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 41573.49 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8322.3 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc UNION ALL SELECT p.provider_name, SUM(py.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM provider p JOIN payment py ON p.provider_no = py.member_no WHERE py.payment_amt > 4698.72 AND py.payment_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.provider_name ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON p.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7472.58 AND (s.statement_amt < 4285.41 OR s.statement_amt IS NULL) AND NOT (m.country = 'USA' AND m.state_prov = 'CA') GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 11924.86 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, m.region_no, m.corp_no, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no ORDER BY c.category_no ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_charges_by_region FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1468.02 AND p.payment_amt > 4918.93 AND s.statement_amt > 6881.77 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 72777.39 AND m.prev_balance > 69907.83 GROUP BY c.category_desc, m.region_no, m.corp_no, c.category_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 1131.1 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, p.provider_name, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count, ( SELECT MAX(pm.payment_amt) FROM payment pm WHERE pm.member_no = ch.member_no AND pm.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' ) AS max_payment_for_member FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt >= 8486.9 GROUP BY c.category_desc, p.provider_name, ch.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 22258.65 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, p.provider_name, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 5499.92 GROUP BY c.category_desc, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 325487.09 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 627.35 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 44171.41 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, r.region_name, pr.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS distinct_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT m.corp_no) AS distinct_corporations, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN region r ON co.region_no = r.region_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON ch.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9534.45 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 1026.54 AND pr.expr_dt >= '1995-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc, r.region_name, pr.provider_name, r.region_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 34469.88 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) > 25 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT c.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement FROM charge c JOIN member m ON c.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment p ON c.statement_no = p.statement_no AND c.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no AND c.member_no = s.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 862.59 AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 1363.41 ORDER BY total_payment DESC;

SELECT c.region_no, m.state_prov, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS average_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date FROM charge ch JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN member m ON s.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation c ON m.corp_no = c.corp_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN region r ON c.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 67005.35 AND p.payment_amt < 19797.44 AND s.statement_amt >= 43323.94 GROUP BY c.region_no, m.state_prov ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(c.charge_no) AS charge_count FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 1143.76 AND c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 48744.75 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS total_charges, COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charge_amount, COALESCE(AVG(c.charge_amt), 0) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payment_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS total_statements, COALESCE(SUM(s.statement_amt), 0) AS total_statement_amount, r.region_name, cor.corp_name, prov.provider_name, cat.category_desc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) DESC) AS charge_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) DESC) AS charge_count_rank, LAG(COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0), 1) OVER (ORDER BY m.member_no) AS prev_member_total_charge FROM member m LEFT JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no AND c.charge_amt > 5946.75 LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_amt > 6326.22 LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND s.statement_amt > 3197.63 LEFT JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no LEFT JOIN corporation cor ON m.corp_no = cor.corp_no LEFT JOIN provider prov ON c.provider_no = prov.provider_no LEFT JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE m.issue_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (m.country = 'USA' OR m.country IS NULL) GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name, cor.corp_name, prov.provider_name, cat.category_desc, m.issue_dt, m.country HAVING COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) > 18409.89 OR COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) > 47342.23 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (SUM(c.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) DESC) AS balance_rank FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING (SUM(c.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) > 12325.92 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.city, m.state_prov, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SELECT AVG(sub_avg.avg_charge) FROM ( SELECT AVG(c_inner.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM charge c_inner WHERE c_inner.member_no = m.member_no GROUP BY c_inner.provider_no ) AS sub_avg ) AS avg_charge_per_provider FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.city, m.state_prov HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 84664.07 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charge c WHERE c.member_no = m.member_no AND c.charge_amt > 815.23) AS high_charge_count FROM member m JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 337.68 AND m.issue_dt >= '2020-01-01' ORDER BY high_charge_count DESC, m.curr_balance DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement FROM member m JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 8685.07 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance HAVING AVG(s.statement_amt) > 4568.4 ORDER BY m.curr_balance DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance_change, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS region_net_rank FROM member m JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation cr ON m.corp_no = cr.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 146275.89 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name, r.region_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 106077.61 ORDER BY region_net_rank;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_dt, s.statement_amt FROM member m LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_no IS NULL AND m.curr_balance > 1780.12 ORDER BY m.member_no;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amt, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amt, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, MIN(ch.charge_dt) AS earliest_charge, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_category_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 691.22 AND s.statement_amt > 8559.27 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 919552.24 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 951 AND AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 1819.21 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC, region_category_rank, charge_count DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3557.8 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.member_no IN (SELECT s.member_no FROM statement s WHERE s.statement_amt > 38087.15 AND s.due_dt >= '1990-01-01') GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 78155.14 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 4842.16 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 33683.12 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 34617.53 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, m.country, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.country ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 6466.56 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, m.country ORDER BY m.country, payment_rank;

SELECT r.region_name, m.country, m.state_prov, m.city, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, m.country, m.state_prov) AS region_state_member_count FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 1861.72 AND p.payment_amt > 1368.66 AND s.statement_amt > 4229.37 GROUP BY r.region_name, m.country, m.state_prov, m.city, c.category_desc, r.region_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 47277.7 AND AVG(p.payment_amt) < 601.8 INTERSECT SELECT r.region_name, m.country, m.state_prov, m.city, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, m.country, m.state_prov) AS region_state_member_count FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no
