'2021-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2021-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2021-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 8135.76 AND p.payment_amt > 1465.92 AND s.statement_amt > 9763.74 GROUP BY r.region_name, m.country, m.state_prov, m.city, c.category_desc, r.region_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 54583.48 AND AVG(p.payment_amt) < 661.29 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS charge_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN provider pv ON c.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 3256.91 AND m.curr_balance < 4485.79 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM charge c2 JOIN statement s2 ON c2.statement_no = s2.statement_no WHERE c2.member_no = m.member_no AND c2.charge_amt > 2330.95 AND s2.statement_dt BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 31938.95 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) >= 74 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category ca ON ch.category_no = ca.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt BETWEEN 1004.91 AND 2397.82 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 563 ORDER BY avg_charge DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, COUNT(DISTINCT c.member_no) AS distinct_members, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 70231.04 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, (SELECT AVG(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01') AS avg_payment_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 141.2 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) >= 3 ORDER BY member_count DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01') AND c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 2576.62 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 878068.32 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 1971.39 AND s.statement_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT p.member_no FROM payment p WHERE p.payment_amt > 748.24 ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(s.statement_amt) > 125455.99 ORDER BY total_statement_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01') AS recent_payments FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 694028.37 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 6666.94 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM provider pr WHERE pr.region_no = r.region_no AND pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no AND pr.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 233543.57 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 542 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 75232.7 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 281986.23 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_year, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('2020-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= TO_DATE('2020-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ch.charge_amt > 4009.73 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 14226.5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 92 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) FROM member m WHERE m.region_no = r.region_no AND m.expr_dt >= '1995-01-01' ) AS active_members_in_region FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1995-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 879408.28 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1281.22 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 48718.1 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5668.19 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 36.14 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, SUM(st.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, AVG(st.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(pm.payment_amt) AS avg_payment_amount, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_prev_balance, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_curr_balance, (SUM(st.statement_amt) - SUM(pm.payment_amt)) AS net_outstanding, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(st.statement_amt) DESC) AS statement_rank_overall FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN payment pm ON st.member_no = pm.member_no AND st.statement_no = pm.statement_no JOIN charge ch ON st.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 932.72 AND st.statement_amt > 21992.95 AND pm.payment_amt > 4427.96 AND m.curr_balance < 80065.89 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND st.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND pm.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND r.region_no IN (8, 5, 10) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 13813.92 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 38 AND AVG(st.statement_amt) > 9134.74 AND SUM(pm.payment_amt) < 19922.54 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, net_outstanding DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_prev_balance, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_curr_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS latest_statement_date FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 686921.76 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT m2.member_no FROM member m2 JOIN statement s2 ON m2.member_no = s2.member_no JOIN charge ch2 ON s2.statement_no = ch2.statement_no WHERE ch2.charge_amt > 600512.63 GROUP BY m2.member_no HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ch2.category_no) >= 48 ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 3361059.33 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 978 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, unique_members DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 255.61 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 49056.05 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8774.98 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 26646.33 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3127.92 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), () ) ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_member_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS charged_members_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.member_no) AS paying_members_count FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5822.15 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (p.payment_dt IS NULL OR p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01') AND m.curr_balance < -5539.31 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 62024.6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) > 960 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, region_no, category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.state_prov, m.country, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amt, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date, MIN(p.payment_dt) AS earliest_payment_date, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank_global FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 95322.24 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_amt > 35424.42 AND s.due_dt <= '1995-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -36043.49 AND ch.charge_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.state_prov, m.country HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 590153.7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 118 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, net_balance ASC LIMIT 866;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charges, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payments, COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.statement_no) AS statements_with_payments FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' WHERE m.curr_balance > 8396.38 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname), (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name), (r.region_no, r.region_name), () ) HAVING (GROUPING(r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname) = 0 AND COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) > 610.57) OR GROUPING(r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname) != 0 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, m.member_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, MAX(ch.charge_amt) AS max_charge_amount, MIN(p.payment_amt) AS min_payment_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region FROM region r INNER JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 4810.24 AND p.payment_amt < 1015.39 AND s.statement_amt BETWEEN 7999.19 AND 13005.04 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 20490.51 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 35 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) > 4953.36 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, charge_rank_by_region LIMIT 318;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS current_balance_sum, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS previous_balance_sum, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region FROM region r LEFT JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no LEFT JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 876.58 AND s.statement_amt BETWEEN 44397.08 AND 189865.1 AND p.payment_amt >= 2165.46 AND m.curr_balance < 63953.76 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 59748.44 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 79 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) BETWEEN 35731.15 AND 78630.34 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, charge_rank_by_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, MAX(ch.charge_amt) AS max_charge_amount, MIN(p.payment_amt) AS min_payment_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 6709.14 AND p.payment_amt < 2160.99 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 36988.47 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 5 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) BETWEEN 3424.51 AND 15892.03 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 24007.93 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_charge_rank ASC LIMIT 924;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.statement_no) AS statements_with_payments, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS balance_rank_in_corp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS global_balance_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND (p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' OR p.payment_dt IS NULL) AND ch.charge_amt > 802.47 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 45760.51 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS provider_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6746.67 AND s.statement_amt >= 14778.68 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 82778.96 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 65459.6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 12 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(st.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(m.curr_balance, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.corp_no ORDER BY MAX(st.statement_dt)) AS prev_corp_member_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN charge ch ON st.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON st.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND st.statement_dt <= '1995-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 7095.48 AND p.payment_amt > 2130.68 AND st.statement_amt > 11918.44 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 1935.07 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 36173.99 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank_in_region, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, s.due_dt, ch.charge_no, ch.charge_amt, ch.charge_dt, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, p.payment_no, p.payment_amt, p.payment_dt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt) AS running_member_charges, COUNT(p.payment_no) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no, s.statement_no) AS payments_per_statement, AVG(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY cat.category_no, r.region_no) AS avg_category_charge_by_region, CASE WHEN s.statement_amt > 22066.91 AND s.due_dt < '2020-01-01' THEN 'High Amount Past Due' WHEN s.statement_amt BETWEEN 1612.55 AND 2189.35 AND s.due_dt >= '2020-01-01' THEN 'Medium Amount On Time' WHEN s.statement_amt < 891.35 THEN 'Low Amount' ELSE 'Standard' END AS statement_risk_category, CASE WHEN m.curr_balance - m.prev_balance > 9454.19 THEN 'Balance Increased' WHEN m.curr_balance - m.prev_balance < -8340.98 THEN 'Balance Decreased' ELSE 'Balance Stable' END AS member_balance_trend, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS distinct_charges, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS latest_statement_date FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE s.statement_dt >= '2019-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt >= '2019-01-01' AND (m.curr_balance > 39265.31 OR m.prev_balance > 47243.99) AND ch.charge_amt > 1262.79 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, s.due_dt, ch.charge_no, ch.charge_amt, ch.charge_dt, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, p.payment_no, p.payment_amt, p.payment_dt, m.curr_balance, m.prev_balance HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 17653.33 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 63 ORDER BY total_payments DESC, avg_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.charge_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS charge_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(c.charge_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS charge_month, COUNT(DISTINCT c.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(SUM(c.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, cat.category_no ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.charge_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(c.charge_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3month FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 4093.93 AND TO_DATE(c.charge_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.charge_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(c.charge_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 4228.4 ORDER BY r.region_no, cat.category_no, charge_year, charge_month;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.corp_no, c.corp_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(DISTINCT p.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS distinct_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT py.payment_no) AS distinct_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(py.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, AVG(py.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date, MIN(py.payment_dt) AS earliest_payment_date FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN payment py ON s.statement_no = py.statement_no AND m.member_no = py.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 356.18 AND py.payment_amt > 726.33 AND s.statement_amt > 4169.91 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND py.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.corp_no, c.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 33179.01 AND SUM(py.payment_amt) > 10372.51 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC, distinct_members DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.corp_no, c.corp_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, CASE WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 935302.27 THEN 'High Charge' WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) BETWEEN 5989.9 AND 1349.19 THEN 'Medium Charge' ELSE 'Low Charge' END AS charge_category, CASE WHEN AVG(s.statement_amt) - SUM(pay.payment_amt) > 2731.66 THEN 'High Outstanding' WHEN AVG(s.statement_amt) - SUM(pay.payment_amt) BETWEEN 375.48 AND 409.89 THEN 'Medium Outstanding' ELSE 'Low Outstanding' END AS outstanding_category, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS total_statements, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pay.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank_global FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND m.member_no = pay.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 5970.34 AND s.statement_amt > 6252.81 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.corp_no, c.corp_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 9337.66 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) > 53 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank_in_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SELECT AVG(sub_c.charge_amt) FROM charge sub_c WHERE sub_c.member_no = m.member_no AND sub_c.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS avg_recent_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND c.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 2871.79 AND s.statement_amt >= 5060.08 AND m.curr_balance <= 2929.88 AND cat.category_no IN (47, 5, 28) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 39680.15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) >= 100 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, m.prev_balance, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS distinct_charges, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01') AS recent_payments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM statement s WHERE s.member_no = m.member_no AND s.statement_amt > 71012.26) AS high_statements, MAX(c.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date, MIN(c.charge_dt) AS earliest_charge_date, pv.provider_name, cat.category_desc, corp.corp_name FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN provider pv ON c.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN statement st ON c.statement_no = st.statement_no AND m.member_no = st.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND c.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 6099.52 AND c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -69471.62 AND m.prev_balance > 63507.09 AND pv.provider_code = 'A' AND cat.category_code = 'A' AND corp.corp_code = 'A' AND r.region_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, m.prev_balance, pv.provider_name, cat.category_desc, corp.corp_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 801973.89 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) >= 341 AND AVG(c.charge_amt) BETWEEN 259.74 AND 4980.29 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, m.member_no ASC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charge, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_curr_balance, SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_activity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 8210.29 AND p.payment_amt > 3119.99 AND s.statement_amt > 1076.95 AND m.curr_balance > 8122.57 AND pr.region_no = r.region_no GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 50150.72 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 66500.56 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) > 861 ORDER BY total_charge DESC, member_count DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.country, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, m.state_prov) AS avg_charges_by_state, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS distinct_providers FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND (m.lastname LIKE 'A%' OR m.firstname LIKE 'A%') AND (c.category_desc LIKE '%Service%' OR c.category_code LIKE 'A') AND ch.charge_amt > 4030.34 AND s.statement_amt > 23000.72 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.country, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 36291.16 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 47347.38 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, r.country, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amt, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, MAX(s.statement_amt) AS max_statement_amt FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 340798.31 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, r.country, c.category_no, c.category_desc, ch.charge_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 233826.45 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no, ch.charge_dt;

SELECT s.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM statement s JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 9719.17 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY s.member_no ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT s.statement_no, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_amt, SUM(p.payment_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY s.member_no ORDER BY p.payment_dt) AS running_payment_total, COUNT(p.payment_no) OVER (PARTITION BY s.member_no ORDER BY p.payment_dt) AS payment_count, AVG(s.statement_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no) AS avg_statement_by_region FROM statement s JOIN member m ON s.member_no = m.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 1506.97 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY s.statement_no, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_amt, m.region_no, p.payment_dt, p.payment_amt, p.payment_no ORDER BY m.member_no, p.payment_dt;

SELECT c.category_desc, m.region_no, m.corp_no, p.region_no, p.provider_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge, AVG(pay.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, MAX(s.statement_amt) AS max_statement_amt, MIN(s.due_dt) AS earliest_due_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_desc ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(pay.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no, m.corp_no) AS member_count_per_corp FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment pay ON m.member_no = pay.member_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND pay.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN corporation cor ON m.corp_no = cor.corp_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no AND p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.statement_dt::DATE) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ch.charge_dt::DATE) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.statement_dt::DATE) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ch.charge_dt::DATE) + 1 GROUP BY c.category_desc, m.region_no, m.corp_no, p.region_no, p.provider_name, r.region_name, cor.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 648930.81 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 96 ORDER BY total_charge DESC, avg_payment ASC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND m.corp_no IN (SELECT corp_no FROM corporation WHERE state_prov = 'NY') GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 39472.2 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.charge_amt, c.charge_code, s.statement_code, m.member_code, p.provider_code, cat.category_code, SUM(c.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY s.statement_code ORDER BY c.charge_dt ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 274.22) AS sub1) AS high_pay_member_count FROM charge c JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN member m ON c.member_no = m.member_no JOIN provider p ON c.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 807.04 AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.charge_amt, c.charge_code, s.statement_code, m.member_code, p.provider_code, cat.category_code, c.charge_dt HAVING COUNT(c.charge_no) > 3.44 ORDER BY running_total DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 9579.84 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE m.member_no IN ( SELECT s.member_no FROM statement s WHERE s.statement_amt > 5845.38 AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' ) AND c.charge_amt > 683.14 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 34654.22 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_amt > 1687.71) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 13643.02 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN ch.charge_code = 'A' THEN ch.charge_amt ELSE 0 END) AS charge_code_a_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN pm.payment_code = 'P' THEN pm.payment_amt ELSE 0 END) AS payment_code_p_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt)) AS category_charge_percentile FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON s.statement_no = pm.statement_no AND m.member_no = pm.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2000-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 1535.48 AND m.curr_balance < 44864.97 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 109238.98 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 91 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE)) AS charge_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE)) AS charge_month, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_current_balance, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS rank_by_charge_in_region_category FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9646.26 AND CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' AND CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE) <= '2000-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -2852.32 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, charge_year, charge_month), (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), ()) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 11625.39 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 212.38 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no, charge_year, charge_month, total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS provider_count FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7901.07 AND s.statement_amt >= 39278.27 AND p.payment_amt <= 81935.21 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 339239.43 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 62 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7160.56 AND s.statement_amt >= 42515.16 AND p.payment_amt > 4714.47 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 6807.5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 13 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov AS member_state, m.country AS member_country, c.corp_name, p.provider_name, cat.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT py.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(py.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_current_balance, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_previous_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, m.state_prov ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS prev_charge_amount_by_state FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment py ON s.statement_no = py.statement_no AND m.member_no = py.member_no WHERE ( (ch.charge_amt > 76712.14 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01') OR (s.statement_amt BETWEEN 72452.48 AND 113301.41) OR (m.curr_balance < -9965.05 AND m.prev_balance > 5023.99) ) AND NOT (p.provider_code = 'A' OR cat.category_code = 'A') AND (m.country = 'US' OR c.country = 'US') AND (ch.charge_code IN ('A', 'B') OR s.statement_code = 'A') GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.country, c.corp_name, p.provider_name, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 405794.28 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 877 AND (AVG(ch.charge_amt) < 8456.34 OR SUM(py.payment_amt) > 285471.35) ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, total_current_balance ASC;

SELECT c.category_code, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_code ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.provider_name) AS provider_total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON s.statement_no = pm.statement_no AND s.member_no = pm.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 88836.67 AND s.due_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_code, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 42630.08 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 66 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, provider_name, lastname;

SELECT c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE r.region_name LIKE '%North%' AND ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM member m WHERE m.member_no = ch.member_no AND m.curr_balance > 3140.77 ) AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 52749.45 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN region r ON co.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 183.27 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(*) > 162 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 554.98 GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 3108.85 AND COUNT(*) >= 36 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS latest_statement FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND (s.due_dt < '2023-01-01' OR s.statement_dt < '2022-01-01') AND ch.charge_amt > 9870.91 GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 14217.36 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, cor.corp_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_prev_balance, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_curr_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_activity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (ORDER BY r.region_name, c.category_desc) AS prev_region_category_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN region r ON pr.region_no = r.region_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation cor ON m.corp_no = cor.corp_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 429041.21 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND cor.corp_name LIKE 'A' AND pr.provider_name LIKE 'A' GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name, cor.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 7075422.58 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 9667 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_charge_rank, net_activity;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count FROM category c LEFT JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no LEFT JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND m.region_no = 10 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 5682.15 ORDER BY avg_charge DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, r.region_no, r.region_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no) AS avg_net_per_member_group, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, (SELECT AVG(sub_ch.charge_amt) FROM charge sub_ch WHERE sub_ch.category_no = c.category_no AND sub_ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01') AS avg_category_charge_since_date FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND s.statement_amt > 49772.51 JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND pr.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no AND co.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '1990-01-01' AND m.expr_dt > '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3714.58 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.category_no, c.category_desc, r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), () ) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 750738.08 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 760 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no, total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.region_no, c.region_name, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_current_balance FROM region c JOIN member m ON c.region_no = m.region_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 94867.15 GROUP BY c.region_no, c.region_name ORDER BY total_current_balance DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 3956.02 AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 24557.77 INTERSECT SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 1837.44 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 12755.84 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1998-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1998-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) > 9550.4 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance FROM member m JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.category_desc LIKE '%Medical%' AND m.state_prov = 'CA' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 4618.56 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, m.lastname, m.firstname;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.city, m.state_prov, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SELECT AVG(sub_avg.avg_charge) FROM ( SELECT AVG(c_inner.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM charge c_inner WHERE c_inner.member_no = m.member_no GROUP BY c_inner.provider_no ) AS sub_avg ) AS avg_charge_per_provider FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.city, m.state_prov HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 27853.15 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charge ch WHERE ch.member_no = m.member_no AND ch.charge_amt > 4769.92) AS high_charge_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider p ON c.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 5964.51 AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 42620.6 ORDER BY total_charges DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_dt, s.statement_amt FROM member m LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_no IS NULL AND m.curr_balance > 3204.44 ORDER BY m.member_no;

SELECT m.region_no, m.corp_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(SUM(c.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no) AS avg_region_charges, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY m.corp_no) AS member_count_per_corp FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 8487.28 GROUP BY m.region_no, m.corp_no, m.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 9965.17 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.curr_balance, m2.prev_balance, (m1.curr_balance - m2.prev_balance) AS balance_change FROM member m1 JOIN member m2 ON m1.member_no = m2.member_no AND m1.region_no = m2.region_no JOIN charge c ON m1.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE m1.curr_balance > 9338.01 AND m2.prev_balance < 2636.06 AND c.charge_amt >= 450.24 GROUP BY m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.curr_balance, m2.prev_balance HAVING COUNT(c.charge_no) > 20 ORDER BY balance_change DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8156.52 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 2828.3 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 6086.49 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3561.74 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -6609.48 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 40005.55 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1279.33 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((r.region_name, c.category_desc), (r.region_name), ()) ORDER BY r.region_name NULLS FIRST, c.category_desc NULLS FIRST;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 48759.12 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 90.05 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 6656.26 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, AVG(pay.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, MAX(s.statement_amt) AS max_statement, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_prev_balance, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_curr_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name, c.category_desc) AS region_category_total FROM region r INNER JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no INNER JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no INNER JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no INNER JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND m.member_no = pay.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1291.94 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND p.provider_name IS NOT NULL AND m.curr_balance > 50104.63 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 57421.89 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 42 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_name, category_desc;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.member_no, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 29942.01 ORDER BY r.region_name, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no) AS avg_statement_by_region_corp, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 424989.45 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, r.region_no, c.corp_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 770454.5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 22 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, m.country, m.state_prov, m.city, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 5160.79 AND p.payment_amt > 4644.73 AND s.statement_amt > 10093.79 GROUP BY r.region_name, m.country, m.state_prov, m.city, c.category_desc, r.region_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 22242.33 AND AVG(p.payment_amt) < 992.65 INTERSECT SELECT r.region_name, m.country, m.state_prov, m.city, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, m.country, m.state_prov) AS region_state_member_count FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2021-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2021-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2021-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2021-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 5715.73 AND p.payment_amt > 5564.56 AND s.statement_amt > 10449.32 GROUP BY r.region_name, m.country, m.state_prov, m.city, c.category_desc, r.region_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 6075.3 AND AVG(p.payment_amt) < 299.96 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) DESC) AS balance_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt) AS prev_charge_sum FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 683661.0 AND s.statement_amt > 937779.8 GROUP BY r.region_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc, m.member_no, ch.charge_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 182604.28 ORDER BY r.region_name, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, c.category_no, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5236.09 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, c.category_no), (r.region_no), (c.category_no), () ) ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, c.corp_no, cat.category_no, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_year, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6606.35 AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2020-01-01' AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 772.66 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, c.corp_no, cat.category_no, statement_year), (r.region_no, c.corp_no, cat.category_no), (r.region_no, c.corp_no), (r.region_no), () ) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 3252.66 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, cat.category_no, statement_year;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.statement_no) AS statements_with_payments, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date, MIN(p.payment_dt) AS earliest_payment_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS net_balance_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4193.25 AND (p.payment_amt IS NULL OR p.payment_amt > 1032.16) AND (s.statement_amt IS NULL OR s.statement_amt >= 3127.73) AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (p.payment_dt IS NULL OR p.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01') AND cat.category_code = 'A' AND pr.provider_code = 'A' AND m.curr_balance BETWEEN -112.9 AND -8651.95 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 28484.6 AND (SUM(p.payment_amt) IS NULL OR SUM(p.payment_amt) < 7818.89) AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 48 ORDER BY r.region_no, net_balance DESC, total_charges DESC;
