SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.statement_no) AS statements_with_payments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charge ch2 WHERE ch2.member_no = m.member_no AND ch2.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_charge_count, (SELECT SUM(ch3.charge_amt) FROM charge ch3 WHERE ch3.member_no = m.member_no AND ch3.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_charge_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment p2 WHERE p2.member_no = m.member_no AND p2.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_payment_count, (SELECT SUM(p3.payment_amt) FROM payment p3 WHERE p3.member_no = m.member_no AND p3.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_payment_total, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS last_statement_date, MIN(s.due_dt) AS earliest_due_date FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 497.92 AND s.statement_amt > 48530.52 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND cat.category_code = 'A' AND pr.provider_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 119242.82 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 305756.98 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) > 12 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.statement_no) > 94 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC LIMIT 574;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amt, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charge ch2 WHERE ch2.member_no = m.member_no AND ch2.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch2.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01') AS recent_charge_count FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9328.38 AND s.due_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -98042.49 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 66720.04 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) >= 76 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank_in_region, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS provider_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9585.58 AND s.statement_amt >= 1997.59 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 82390.58 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 40519.91 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 92 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, pv.provider_no, pv.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT st.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(st.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no AND st.statement_no = pm.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 779.53 AND st.statement_amt > 31424.78 AND pm.payment_amt > 833.03 AND m.curr_balance > 74509.33 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND st.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND pm.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, pv.provider_no, pv.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 6266.23 AND SUM(pm.payment_amt) > 11674.97 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 10 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (m.curr_balance + SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS projected_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM statement s WHERE s.member_no = m.member_no AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS recent_statements, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (m.curr_balance + SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS balance_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3943.87 AND p.payment_amt > 6674.78 AND pr.region_no = r.region_no GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) > 352.87 ORDER BY r.region_no, balance_rank_in_region, projected_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.prev_balance, m.curr_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no ORDER BY m.member_no) AS prev_member_charge, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no) AS members_per_corporation, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no) AS region_total_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 2351.62 AND p.payment_amt > 9849.05 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.prev_balance, m.curr_balance HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 38799.74 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 11099.94 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank_in_region, c.corp_no, m.member_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) FILTER (WHERE ch.charge_code = 'A') AS charge_code_A_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, LAG(SUM(pay.payment_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY MAX(s.statement_dt)) AS prev_member_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND m.member_no = pay.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3962.25 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND p.provider_no > 88195 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 6590.54 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) >= 59 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 42292.19 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank_in_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT s.member_no FROM statement s WHERE s.statement_amt > 58904.38 ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 863926.11 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charges, COALESCE(SUM(pm.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payments, COALESCE(AVG(s.statement_amt), 0) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS active_members, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) DESC) AS provider_rank_in_region FROM region r INNER JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no INNER JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no INNER JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.member_no = s.member_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON s.statement_no = pm.statement_no AND s.member_no = pm.member_no INNER JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no LEFT JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no AND m.region_no = co.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND (pm.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' OR pm.payment_dt IS NULL) AND s.due_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 187.61 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) > 90683.63 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 34 ORDER BY r.region_no, provider_rank_in_region, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, s.statement_dt, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, AVG(SUM(s.statement_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3period FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 2425.72 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, s.statement_dt ORDER BY r.region_no, s.statement_dt;

SELECT s.statement_no, s.member_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, c.charge_amt, cat.category_desc FROM statement s JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE s.statement_no IN ( SELECT statement_no FROM charge WHERE charge_amt > 2395.96 ) AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY s.statement_no, s.member_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, c.charge_amt, cat.category_desc ORDER BY s.statement_amt DESC;

SELECT s.statement_no, s.statement_dt, s.statement_amt, AVG(s.statement_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY s.member_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3_statements, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name FROM statement s JOIN member m ON s.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 4179.59 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY s.statement_no, s.statement_dt, s.statement_amt, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name ORDER BY s.member_no, s.statement_dt;

WITH charge_summary AS ( SELECT c.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM charge c WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY c.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 8058.84 ) SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cs.total_charges, cs.charge_count, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN charge_summary cs ON m.member_no = cs.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cs.total_charges, cs.charge_count ORDER BY cs.total_charges DESC LIMIT 33;

SELECT c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS member_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c LEFT JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 336.22 ORDER BY member_count DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_desc ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON p.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND (m.curr_balance > 7229.3 OR m.prev_balance < -897.63) AND NOT (s.statement_code = 'A') GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 67930.72 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8727.97 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7978.86 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 249075.88 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 802.94 GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 7043.09 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, p.provider_name, r.region_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.country, m.state_prov, m.city, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(py.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(st.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT py.statement_no) AS statements_with_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(py.payment_amt) AS net_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(py.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_dense_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.country, m.state_prov ORDER BY m.city) AS prev_city_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN statement st ON ch.statement_no = st.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment py ON ch.member_no = py.member_no AND ch.statement_no = py.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7834.22 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND st.statement_amt > 43370.85 AND py.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -32819.23 GROUP BY c.category_desc, p.provider_name, r.region_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.country, m.state_prov, m.city HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 58657.83 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) > 4 ORDER BY net_amount DESC, charge_rank_by_region;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count FROM category c LEFT JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no LEFT JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND m.region_no = 9 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 5299.08 ORDER BY avg_charge DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS unique_providers, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9161.19 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_per_statement FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND s.due_dt < '1992-02-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 47187.57 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, CASE WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 39043.75 THEN 'High' WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) BETWEEN 3785.97 AND 3815.7 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS charge_category FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE r.region_no = 9 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 3956.94 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, c.category_code, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4439.44 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -4589.35 AND r.region_no = 8 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc, c.category_code HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 441.07 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, c.category_code, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_dt, MIN(ch.charge_dt) AS earliest_charge_dt FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN region r ON co.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8338.01 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -9170.59 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc, c.category_code HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 76958.68 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 602 UNION ALL SELECT p.provider_no, p.provider_name, p.provider_code, SUM(ch2.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch2.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch2.member_no) AS unique_members, MAX(ch2.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_dt, MIN(ch2.charge_dt) AS earliest_charge_dt FROM provider p JOIN charge ch2 ON p.provider_no = ch2.provider_no JOIN member m2 ON ch2.member_no = m2.member_no JOIN corporation co2 ON m2.corp_no = co2.corp_no JOIN region r2 ON co2.region_no = r2.region_no WHERE ch2.charge_amt > 2130.18 AND ch2.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch2.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND m2.curr_balance < -1702.94 GROUP BY p.provider_no, p.provider_name, p.provider_code HAVING SUM(ch2.charge_amt) > 61791.81 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch2.member_no) >= 423 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(c.charge_no) AS charge_count FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 7342.43 AND c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 45359.36 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, COUNT(s.statement_no) AS statement_count FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 9550.4 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 17640.48 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_payments_count FROM member m JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN statement st ON ch.statement_no = st.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 290.34 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 7502.46 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, sub.max_charge, sub.total_paid FROM member m JOIN ( SELECT c.member_no, MAX(c.charge_amt) AS max_charge, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_paid FROM charge c LEFT JOIN payment p ON c.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= ( SELECT MIN(s.statement_dt) FROM statement s WHERE s.member_no = c.member_no AND s.statement_amt > 7578.2 ) WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.member_no ) sub ON m.member_no = sub.member_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 1572.1 ORDER BY sub.total_paid DESC, m.member_no;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM member m JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 5505.88 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 97 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.region_no, m.state_prov, m.country, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON p.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.statement_dt::DATE) = 10 GROUP BY m.region_no, m.state_prov, m.country HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 87571.36 ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.corp_no, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amt, AVG(m2.curr_balance) AS avg_other_member_balance FROM member m1 JOIN payment p ON m1.member_no = p.member_no JOIN member m2 ON m1.region_no = m2.region_no AND m1.corp_no = m2.corp_no AND m1.member_no != m2.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 14408.14 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.corp_no HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 88069.07 ORDER BY total_payment_amt DESC;

SELECT m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.curr_balance, m2.prev_balance, (m1.curr_balance - m2.prev_balance) AS balance_change FROM member m1 JOIN member m2 ON m1.member_no = m2.member_no AND m1.region_no = m2.region_no JOIN charge c ON m1.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE m1.curr_balance > 7847.34 AND m2.prev_balance < 424.19 AND c.charge_amt >= 822.8 GROUP BY m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.curr_balance, m2.prev_balance HAVING COUNT(c.charge_no) > 9 ORDER BY balance_change DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS unique_providers, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no || '-' || ch.charge_no) AS unique_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_current_balance, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_desc ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) DESC) AS member_rank FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN region r ON co.region_no = r.region_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND s.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 7799.74 AND s.statement_amt > 12982.71 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 900155.75 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 207.51 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, unique_members DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 978.73 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT s.member_no FROM statement s WHERE s.statement_amt > 960.53 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 463.86 ORDER BY member_count DESC, avg_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 893.85 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 385.97 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 1071.46 ORDER BY member_count DESC, avg_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt < '2020-01-02' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 32400.91 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt < '2020-01-02' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 36177.77 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 4492.18 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 97325.48 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_member_balance FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 605.73 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT p.member_no FROM payment p WHERE p.payment_amt >= 128.72 AND p.payment_dt IN ( SELECT s.statement_dt FROM statement s WHERE s.statement_amt > 1000.27 ) ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 8198.88 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.statement_no) AS statements_with_payments, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name, c.category_desc ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS prev_category_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3932.94 AND s.statement_amt >= 18389.68 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 95385.81 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) > 96 ORDER BY r.region_name, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, p.provider_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(pm.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, SUM(st.statement_amt) AS total_statements, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN charge ch ON st.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON st.statement_no = pm.statement_no AND m.member_no = pm.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9985.23 AND st.statement_amt > 11160.15 AND pm.payment_amt > 1617.55 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND st.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, ch.charge_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 4928.98 AND AVG(pm.payment_amt) > 454.85 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_current_balance, SUM(py.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name, c.category_desc) AS region_category_total FROM region r INNER JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment py ON m.member_no = py.member_no AND s.statement_no = py.statement_no INNER JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no INNER JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no INNER JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3998.88 AND m.curr_balance < 93306.78 AND s.statement_amt > 27114.71 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 95766.09 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 48 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9886.57 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM statement WHERE statement_amt > ( SELECT AVG(statement_amt) FROM statement WHERE statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' ) ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 45826.97 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, cat.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_month, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name, c.corp_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_corp FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON s.statement_no = pm.statement_no AND m.member_no = pm.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2442.22 AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('1990-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(s.due_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= TO_DATE('1990-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND m.curr_balance < -63404.23 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_name, c.corp_name, cat.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))), (r.region_name, c.corp_name, cat.category_desc, p.provider_name), (r.region_name, c.corp_name, cat.category_desc), (r.region_name, c.corp_name), (r.region_name), () ) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 38338.0 ORDER BY r.region_name, c.corp_name, total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, p.provider_name, cat.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, (SELECT SUM(pm.payment_amt) FROM payment pm WHERE pm.member_no = m.member_no AND pm.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS recent_payments, (SELECT MAX(s.statement_amt) FROM statement s WHERE s.member_no = m.member_no AND s.statement_dt <= '1992-01-01') AS max_statement_amount, SUM(m.curr_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS running_balance_by_region FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no AND p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 6614.65 AND m.curr_balance < -52682.24 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, m.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 170192.53 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;
