SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(st.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amt, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_no ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank_in_category, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no) AS region_category_total_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN payment p ON st.member_no = p.member_no AND st.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN charge ch ON st.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND st.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 138.55 AND m.prev_balance < -8493.37 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 7793.04 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) > 59 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank_in_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_corp FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2020-12-31' AND cat.category_code = 'A' AND pv.provider_code = 'P' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 154114.06 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 34 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 402452.5 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SELECT AVG(sub_ch.charge_amt) FROM charge sub_ch JOIN statement sub_s ON sub_ch.statement_no = sub_s.statement_no WHERE sub_s.member_no = m.member_no AND sub_ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.category_no) AS distinct_categories, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS latest_statement_date, MIN(s.due_dt) AS earliest_due_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment sub_p WHERE sub_p.member_no = m.member_no AND sub_p.payment_dt BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31') AS payments_in_range, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank_global FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6784.2 AND s.statement_amt >= 3927.28 AND cat.category_code IN ('A', 'B') AND pr.provider_code = 'P' AND s.statement_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 12311.65 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) >= 20 AND AVG(p.payment_amt) BETWEEN 19.96 AND 17581.59 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments ASC, latest_statement_date DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS provider_count FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1671.08 AND s.statement_amt >= 37716.4 AND p.payment_amt <= 44070.52 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 57542.27 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 54 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8471.41 AND p.payment_amt > 1821.7 AND s.statement_amt BETWEEN 3340.24 AND 47484.56 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 32664.34 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 5 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank LIMIT 34;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no) AS avg_charges_per_region, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 1792.72 AND p.payment_amt > 4012.98 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > SUM(p.payment_amt) AND SUM(s.statement_amt) > 22060.84 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank_in_region, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS sum_current_balance, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_activity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3685.65 AND s.statement_amt > 9364.08 AND p.payment_amt > 7707.32 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), (cat.category_no, cat.category_desc), () ) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 64071.85 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 65 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, m.member_no, cat.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt) AS prev_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON m.member_no = pay.member_no AND s.statement_no = pay.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4466.74 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_amt >= 42117.59 AND m.curr_balance <= -9191.1 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, ch.charge_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 8936.3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 4 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, s.due_dt, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, ch.charge_code, ch.charge_amt, ch.charge_dt, p.payment_amt, p.payment_dt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt) AS running_region_corp_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no) AS avg_member_payment, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY cat.category_no) AS total_category_charges, SUM(s.statement_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no) AS total_region_statement, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no) - SUM(p.payment_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no)) AS net_region_corp_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 331.06 AND s.statement_amt > 25251.28 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, s.due_dt, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, ch.charge_code, ch.charge_amt, ch.charge_dt, p.payment_amt, p.payment_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 79152.18 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) >= 90 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, m.member_no, s.statement_no, ch.charge_dt;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) AS distinct_statements_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT p.statement_no) AS distinct_statements_paid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(SUM(c.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY m.member_no) AS prev_member_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation cor ON r.region_no = cor.region_no AND cor.expr_dt >= '2000-01-01' JOIN member m ON cor.corp_no = m.corp_no AND m.expr_dt >= '2000-01-01' JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no AND c.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no AND cat.category_code = 'A' JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no AND s.due_dt >= '2000-01-01' LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' WHERE c.charge_amt > 5904.37 AND s.statement_amt < 59648.47 AND m.curr_balance IS NOT NULL AND cor.corp_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 98816.57 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) >= 84 UNION ALL SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, p.provider_no AS member_no, p.provider_name AS lastname, '' AS firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, 0 AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) AS distinct_statements_charged, 0 AS distinct_statements_paid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(SUM(c.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY p.provider_no) AS prev_member_charge FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no AND p.expr_dt >= '2000-01-01' JOIN charge c ON p.provider_no = c.provider_no AND c.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no AND cat.category_code = 'A' JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no AND s.due_dt >= '2000-01-01' WHERE c.charge_amt > 1547.0 AND s.statement_amt < 85356.3 AND p.provider_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 76863.87 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) >= 8 ORDER BY region_no, charge_rank_in_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, AVG(SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no) AS region_avg_net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS balance_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation cor ON r.region_no = cor.region_no JOIN member m ON cor.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 119579.95 AND c.charge_amt > 31004.23 AND p.payment_amt > 48001.55 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 642507.45 ORDER BY r.region_no, balance_rank_in_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, r.country, m.corp_no, c.corp_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(st.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no AND ch.statement_no = st.statement_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND st.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 79492.68 AND st.statement_amt >= 48701.02 AND p.payment_amt <= 70774.92 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM category cat WHERE cat.category_no = ch.category_no AND cat.category_code = 'A' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM member m2 WHERE m2.corp_no = m.corp_no AND m2.region_no = m.region_no AND m2.curr_balance < -8914.02 ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, r.country, m.corp_no, c.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 149806.66 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 30 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_members ASC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, s.statement_dt, SUM(s.statement_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_statement_amt, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_count_statements FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_amt >= 69276.18 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, s.statement_dt, s.statement_amt ORDER BY r.region_no, s.statement_dt;

SELECT s.member_no, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment FROM statement s JOIN payment p ON s.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 1049.55 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY s.member_no ORDER BY total_statement DESC;

WITH charge_summary AS ( SELECT c.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM charge c WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY c.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 4620.97 ) SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cs.total_charges, cs.charge_count, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN charge_summary cs ON m.member_no = cs.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cs.total_charges, cs.charge_count ORDER BY cs.total_charges DESC LIMIT 56;

SELECT c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch1.member_no) AS members_with_charges, SUM(ch1.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch2.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_same_category FROM category c JOIN charge ch1 ON c.category_no = ch1.category_no JOIN charge ch2 ON ch1.category_no = ch2.category_no AND ch1.statement_no = ch2.statement_no AND ch1.charge_no <> ch2.charge_no WHERE ch1.charge_amt > 9511.35 AND ch2.charge_amt > 8787.53 GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ch1.member_no) > 362 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt FROM category c LEFT JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1715.1 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 5517.0 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2789.89 AND ch.charge_amt < 1815.36 AND m.curr_balance > 8118.05 GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) > 40.79 ORDER BY total_charge DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5856.46 AND s.statement_amt < 7881.15 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 3593.34 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 492.88 GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 6225.63 AND COUNT(*) >= 24 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 91040.47 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7955.58 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND r.region_name = 'North America' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) < 43362.1 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt >= 1227.53 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 218.49 INTERSECT SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN payment p ON ch.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE p.payment_amt >= 5680.73 AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc ORDER BY category_no;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt >= 8427.83 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 676.29 INTERSECT SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN payment p ON ch.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE p.payment_amt >= 7021.53 AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc ORDER BY category_no;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3906.78 AND m.curr_balance < 7858.7 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 8009.36 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, r.region_no, r.region_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 9333.9 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((c.category_no, c.category_desc, r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), ()) ORDER BY c.category_no, r.region_no;

SELECT c1.member_no, c1.category_no, SUM(c1.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM charge c1 JOIN category cat ON c1.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c1.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND c1.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY c1.member_no, c1.category_no HAVING SUM(c1.charge_amt) > 103972.71 INTERSECT SELECT p1.member_no, c2.category_no, SUM(c2.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM payment p1 JOIN statement s ON p1.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN charge c2 ON s.member_no = c2.member_no WHERE p1.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND p1.payment_dt <= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY p1.member_no, c2.category_no HAVING SUM(c2.charge_amt) > 945592.59 ORDER BY member_no, category_no;

SELECT m.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 730.88 INTERSECT SELECT m.member_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) < 27679.29 ORDER BY member_no;

SELECT m.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, COUNT(s.statement_no) AS statement_count FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 8711.17 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 15739.62 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charges FROM member m LEFT JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) > 65584.37 INTERSECT SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payments FROM member m LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) > 50789.8 ORDER BY member_no;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE m.member_no IN ( SELECT s.member_no FROM statement s WHERE s.statement_amt > 9420.87 AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' ) AND c.charge_amt > 25.87 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 28290.97 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT c.category_no) AS distinct_categories, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 43714.23 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.category_no) >= 5 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS charge_count FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN provider p ON c.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1998-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment pm WHERE pm.member_no = m.member_no AND pm.payment_dt >= '1998-01-01') GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 3090.73 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND c.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 3028.08 AND p.payment_amt > 1956.1 AND s.statement_amt > 3107.85 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) > 2286.25 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.city, m.state_prov, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(p.payment_no) AS payment_count FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.member_no IN (SELECT s.member_no FROM statement s WHERE s.statement_amt > 36521.36) GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.city, m.state_prov ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.curr_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM member m1 JOIN member m2 ON m1.region_no = m2.region_no AND m1.member_no != m2.member_no JOIN charge c ON m1.member_no = c.member_no WHERE m1.curr_balance > 1869.14 AND c.charge_amt BETWEEN 260.53 AND 1532.08 GROUP BY m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.curr_balance HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 1682.81 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.curr_balance, m2.prev_balance, (m1.curr_balance - m2.prev_balance) AS balance_change FROM member m1 JOIN member m2 ON m1.member_no = m2.member_no AND m1.region_no = m2.region_no JOIN charge c ON m1.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE m1.curr_balance > 1355.95 AND m2.prev_balance < 4990.71 AND c.charge_amt >= 226.85 GROUP BY m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.curr_balance, m2.prev_balance HAVING COUNT(c.charge_no) > 31 ORDER BY balance_change DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2024-12-31' AND ch.charge_amt > 2605.45 AND m.curr_balance > 44833.12 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 814789.5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 59.87 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_name, category_desc;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 9238.75 AND ch.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 2971.35 AND payment_dt >= '2019-01-01' ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 33022.53 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 207.76 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 907919.7 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT p.member_no) AS distinct_members_paid, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name, c.category_desc ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN provider pr ON r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN charge ch ON pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2165.05 AND p.payment_amt > 5647.55 AND s.statement_amt > 9476.78 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, r.region_no, c.category_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 939828.35 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 950814.18 ORDER BY total_charges DESC LIMIT 200;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS prev_corp_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 550758.78 AND p.payment_amt < 468827.0 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 7556746.01 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 76 ORDER BY r.region_name, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 2260.29 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM member WHERE curr_balance > 2669.28 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 33252.83 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 749.76 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM member WHERE curr_balance > 4380.71 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 32551.32 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) DESC) AS balance_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt) AS prev_charge_sum FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 465541.57 AND s.statement_amt > 477982.35 GROUP BY r.region_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc, m.member_no, ch.charge_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 14263.87 ORDER BY r.region_name, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, c.charge_amt, cat.category_desc, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01') AS payment_count FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 52205.3 GROUP BY r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, c.charge_amt, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 3703.12 ORDER BY m.curr_balance DESC, payment_count ASC;

SELECT r.region_name, m1.member_no AS member1_no, m1.lastname AS member1_lastname, m2.member_no AS member2_no, m2.lastname AS member2_lastname, c1.category_desc AS category1_desc, c2.category_desc AS category2_desc, SUM(ch1.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt_member1, SUM(ch2.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt_member2, AVG(p1.payment_amt) AS avg_payment_amt_member1, AVG(p2.payment_amt) AS avg_payment_amt_member2, COUNT(DISTINCT s1.statement_no) AS statement_count_member1, COUNT(DISTINCT s2.statement_no) AS statement_count_member2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch1.charge_amt) + SUM(ch2.charge_amt) DESC) AS total_charge_rank, LAG(SUM(ch1.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, m1.member_no ORDER BY ch1.charge_dt) AS prev_charge_member1 FROM region r JOIN member m1 ON r.region_no = m1.region_no JOIN member m2 ON m1.region_no = m2.region_no AND m1.member_no < m2.member_no JOIN charge ch1 ON m1.member_no = ch1.member_no JOIN charge ch2 ON m2.member_no = ch2.member_no JOIN category c1 ON ch1.category_no = c1.category_no JOIN category c2 ON ch2.category_no = c2.category_no JOIN payment p1 ON m1.member_no = p1.member_no JOIN payment p2 ON m2.member_no = p2.member_no JOIN statement s1 ON m1.member_no = s1.member_no JOIN statement s2 ON m2.member_no = s2.member_no JOIN provider pr1 ON ch1.provider_no = pr1.provider_no JOIN provider pr2 ON ch2.provider_no = pr2.provider_no JOIN corporation co1 ON m1.corp_no = co1.corp_no JOIN corporation co2 ON m2.corp_no = co2.corp_no WHERE ch1.charge_amt > 6945.2 AND ch2.charge_amt > 4346.91 AND s1.statement_amt >= 5982.24 AND s2.statement_amt <= 26286.48 AND p1.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p2.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, r.region_no, m1.member_no, m1.lastname, m2.member_no, m2.lastname, c1.category_desc, c2.category_desc, ch1.charge_dt HAVING SUM(ch1.charge_amt) > 9262.38 AND SUM(ch2.charge_amt) < 9820.89 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s1.statement_no) > 46 ORDER BY total_charge_rank, r.region_no, total_charge_amt_member1 DESC, total_charge_amt_member2 DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, p.provider_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 5459.04 AND ch.charge_amt > 9083.16 GROUP BY r.region_name, p.provider_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 16626.97 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, c.category_no, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3276.53 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, c.category_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 40044.6 AND COUNT(*) >= 63 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS active_members, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01' ) AND c.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING AVG(c.charge_amt) > 313.17 ORDER BY active_members DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 16663.64 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, MAX(s.statement_amt) AS max_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_rank_by_charges FROM region r LEFT JOIN corporation cor ON r.region_no = cor.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON cor.corp_no = m.corp_no OR (m.corp_no IS NULL AND cor.corp_no IS NULL AND r.region_no = m.region_no) LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no INNER JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no INNER JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no LEFT JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 3651.15 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 49578.51 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 484.46 AND s.statement_amt < 18845.56 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 99336.67 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 37 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, member_count DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 514.25 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 2702.22 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM region r INNER JOIN provider pr ON r.region_no = pr.region_no INNER JOIN charge ch ON pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no INNER JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no INNER JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 800.23 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 28277.02 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS distinct_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amt, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amt, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8873.63 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 958548.17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 138 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_prev_balance, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_curr_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS latest_statement_date FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 50684.29 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT m2.member_no FROM member m2 JOIN statement s2 ON m2.member_no = s2.member_no JOIN charge ch2 ON s2.statement_no = ch2.statement_no WHERE ch2.charge_amt > 401434.66 GROUP BY m2.member_no HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ch2.category_no) >= 8 ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 3126164.35 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 221 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, unique_members DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6400.49 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.prev_balance < -2260.47 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), () ) ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no, total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 5754.08 AND r.region_no BETWEEN 12 AND 89 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 783340.31 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 349 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 8044.4 AND s.statement_amt > 40596.48 AND m.curr_balance > 63193.23 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 33008.61 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 90 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) > 35706.76 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 61872.34 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, pv.provider_no, pv.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT st.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(st.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no AND st.statement_no = pm.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 215.51 AND st.statement_amt > 49457.05 AND pm.payment_amt > 2217.05 AND m.curr_balance > 65634.28 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, pv.provider_no, pv.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 6163.79 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 9 AND SUM(pm.payment_amt) > 25828.68 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.prev_balance, m.curr_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no ORDER BY m.member_no) AS prev_member_charge, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no) AS members_per_corporation, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no) AS region_total_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 9353.93 AND p.payment_amt > 4970.33 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.prev_balance, m.curr_balance HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 46804.47 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 19418.51 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank_in_region, c.corp_no, m.member_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, s.due_dt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SELECT AVG(sub_s.statement_amt) FROM statement sub_s WHERE sub_s.member_no = m.member_no AND sub_s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND sub_s.statement_dt <= '1990-01-01') AS avg_statement_amt_member, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.category_no) AS distinct_categories_charged FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 444739.31 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND pv.region_no = r.region_no GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, s.due_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 3448271.6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.category_no) >= 90 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank_in_region, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.corp_no, c.corp_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, DATE_TRUNC('month', ch.charge_dt::DATE) AS charge_month, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(st.statement_amt) AS total_statements, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_curr_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS charged_members, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.member_no) AS paying_members, COUNT(DISTINCT st.member_no) AS statement_members, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.corp_no ORDER BY SUM(pm.payment_amt) DESC) AS corp_payment_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no AND ch.statement_no = pm.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no AND ch.statement_no = st.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt::DATE >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt::DATE <= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 2826.23 AND p.provider_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.corp_no, c.corp_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, DATE_TRUNC('month', ch.charge_dt::DATE) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 699452.18 AND SUM(pm.payment_amt) > 310048.21 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 683 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT s.statement_no, s.member_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, c.charge_amt, cat.category_desc FROM statement s JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE s.statement_no IN ( SELECT statement_no FROM charge WHERE charge_amt > 4952.58 ) AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY s.statement_no, s.member_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, c.charge_amt, cat.category_desc ORDER BY s.statement_amt DESC;

WITH charge_summary AS ( SELECT c.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM charge c WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY c.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 1009.04 ) SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cs.total_charges, cs.charge_count, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN charge_summary cs ON m.member_no = cs.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cs.total_charges, cs.charge_count ORDER BY cs.total_charges DESC LIMIT 86;

SELECT c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch1.member_no) AS members_with_charges, SUM(ch1.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch2.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_same_category FROM category c JOIN charge ch1 ON c.category_no = ch1.category_no JOIN charge ch2 ON ch1.category_no = ch2.category_no AND ch1.statement_no = ch2.statement_no AND ch1.charge_no <> ch2.charge_no WHERE ch1.charge_amt > 4540.64 AND ch2.charge_amt > 8209.49 GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ch1.member_no) > 921 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt FROM category c LEFT JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 963.26 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 27109.7 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance FROM category c LEFT JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no LEFT JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 3747.77 GROUP BY c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8539.92 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = ch.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01') GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 64657.98 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1480.17 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND r.region_name = 'North America' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) < 29193.06 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_member_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS unique_statements, SUM(CASE WHEN ch.charge_code = 'A' THEN ch.charge_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code_a_total, SUM(CASE WHEN ch.charge_code = 'B' THEN ch.charge_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code_b_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_rank, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_desc ORDER BY r.region_name) AS charge_diff_from_prev_region FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no AND ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no AND ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation cr ON m.corp_no = cr.corp_no AND m.corp_no = cr.corp_no JOIN region r ON cr.region_no = r.region_no AND cr.region_no = r.region_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON s.member_no = pm.member_no AND s.statement_no = pm.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7623.53 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 50666.82 AND m.curr_balance > 52874.7 AND s.statement_amt > 36955.56 GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 37865.55 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 389 UNION ALL SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_member_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS unique_statements, SUM(CASE WHEN ch.charge_code = 'C' THEN ch.charge_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code_c_total, SUM(CASE WHEN ch.charge_code = 'D' THEN ch.charge_amt ELSE 0 END) AS code_d_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_rank, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_desc ORDER BY r.region_name) AS charge_diff_from_prev_region FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no AND ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no AND ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation cr ON m.corp_no = cr.corp_no AND m.corp_no = cr.corp_no JOIN region r ON cr.region_no = r.region_no AND cr.region_no = r.region_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON s.member_no = pm.member_no AND s.statement_no = pm.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9849.52 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 91304.41 AND m.curr_balance > 3279.51 AND s.statement_amt > 9386.79 GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 69303.63 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 696 ORDER BY region_rank, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 367.75 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 3539.06 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 532.58 ORDER BY member_count DESC, avg_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_curr_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation cor ON r.region_no = cor.region_no AND r.region_no IS NOT NULL AND cor.region_no IS NOT NULL JOIN member m ON cor.corp_no = m.corp_no AND cor.corp_no IS NOT NULL AND m.corp_no IS NOT NULL JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no AND m.member_no IS NOT NULL AND ch.member_no IS NOT NULL JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no AND ch.category_no IS NOT NULL AND c.category_no IS NOT NULL JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND m.member_no IS NOT NULL AND p.member_no IS NOT NULL JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND m.member_no IS NOT NULL AND s.member_no IS NOT NULL JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND ch.provider_no IS NOT NULL AND pr.provider_no IS NOT NULL WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6608.82 AND s.statement_amt > 33027.63 AND p.payment_amt > 3931.83 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname), (r.region_name, c.category_desc), (r.region_name), ()) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > SUM(p.payment_amt) AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) > 97.1 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS prev_corp_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 974242.92 AND p.payment_amt < 598683.28 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 444735.83 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 10 ORDER BY r.region_name, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, c.corp_no, m.member_no, cat.category_no, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_month, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.provider_no) AS unique_providers FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8319.17 AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2020-01-01' AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2022-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 134.85 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, c.corp_no, m.member_no, cat.category_no, statement_year, statement_month), (r.region_no, c.corp_no, cat.category_no, statement_year, statement_month), (r.region_no, cat.category_no, statement_year, statement_month), (r.region_no, statement_year, statement_month), (statement_year, statement_month), () ) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 13219.71 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, m.member_no, cat.category_no, statement_year DESC, statement_month DESC;
