SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(st.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.statement_no) AS statements_with_payments, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region_category, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY MIN(ch.charge_dt)) AS prev_member_charge_total FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN charge ch ON st.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN payment p ON st.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5522.3 AND st.statement_amt > 821.0 AND p.payment_amt > 4364.21 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND st.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 84315.42 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 14735.24 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) > 99 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 4002.28 AND s.statement_amt > 45815.35 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 39596.04 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 14 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 8820.26 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no) AS avg_net_balance_per_corp, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS region_net_balance_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2023-12-31' AND ch.charge_amt > 5475.39 AND (s.statement_dt >= '2019-01-01' OR s.statement_dt IS NULL) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) > 23427.47 ORDER BY r.region_no, region_net_balance_rank, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.statement_no) AS statements_with_payments, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date, MIN(p.payment_dt) AS earliest_payment_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS net_balance_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5311.17 AND (p.payment_amt IS NULL OR p.payment_amt > 264.65) AND (s.statement_amt IS NULL OR s.statement_amt >= 11052.07) AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (p.payment_dt IS NULL OR p.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01') AND cat.category_code = 'A' AND pr.provider_code = 'A' AND m.curr_balance BETWEEN 5669.31 AND -1290.67 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 18309.03 AND (SUM(p.payment_amt) IS NULL OR SUM(p.payment_amt) < 5836.32) AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 66 ORDER BY r.region_no, net_balance DESC, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 792.62 AND s.statement_amt >= 4215.74 AND p.payment_amt > 3750.72 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 27962.9 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 33 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_avg_payments, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.corp_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_statements_per_corp, SUM(m.curr_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS region_moving_balance, MAX(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS neighbor_max_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 58290.81 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 21662.54 AND ch.charge_amt > 19985.6 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, m.curr_balance, ch.charge_amt, p.payment_amt, ch.charge_dt, p.payment_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 7099.52 AND AVG(p.payment_amt) < 46918.36 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, m.member_no, s.statement_dt DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_no ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 9259.69 AND p.payment_amt > 3077.17 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 20078.87 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) > 6 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank, payment_rank;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE (ch.charge_amt > 769.8 OR p.payment_amt < 291.52) AND NOT (m.curr_balance <= 235.34 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01') AND (r.region_no = 5 OR c.category_no = 29) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 45239.73 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 88 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 253.34 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((r.region_name, c.category_desc), (r.region_name), ()) ORDER BY r.region_name NULLS FIRST, c.category_desc NULLS FIRST;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2954.41 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 74912.76 UNION ALL SELECT r.region_name, NULL AS category_desc, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 6454.16 GROUP BY r.region_name HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 98136.27 ORDER BY region_name, category_desc;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9362.27 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM statement WHERE statement_amt > ( SELECT AVG(statement_amt) FROM statement WHERE statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' ) ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 6357.54 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, cat.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_month, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name, c.corp_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_corp FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON s.statement_no = pm.statement_no AND m.member_no = pm.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 537.58 AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('1990-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(s.due_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= TO_DATE('1990-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND m.curr_balance < -69251.68 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_name, c.corp_name, cat.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))), (r.region_name, c.corp_name, cat.category_desc, p.provider_name), (r.region_name, c.corp_name, cat.category_desc), (r.region_name, c.corp_name), (r.region_name), () ) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 43893.89 ORDER BY r.region_name, c.corp_name, total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 2654.53 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM member WHERE curr_balance > 4678.81 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 19902.89 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8039.28 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_current_balance, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 7884.13 AND m.curr_balance < 2021.78 AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 75501.6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 38.94 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, region_no, category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 1730.31 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 5593.96 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, s.statement_dt, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, AVG(SUM(s.statement_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3period FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 1811.99 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, s.statement_dt ORDER BY r.region_no, s.statement_dt;

WITH charge_summary AS ( SELECT c.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM charge c WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 2395.32 ) SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cs.total_charges, cs.charge_count, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN charge_summary cs ON m.member_no = cs.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cs.total_charges, cs.charge_count ORDER BY cs.total_charges DESC LIMIT 13;

SELECT c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(*) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN region r ON co.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9875.17 AND m.curr_balance < 219.89 GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 4089.01 AND COUNT(*) >= 8 ORDER BY total_charge DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS distinct_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT st.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT py.payment_no) AS distinct_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_code || p.provider_code) AS distinct_charge_provider_codes, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(st.statement_amt) AS total_statements, SUM(py.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN payment py ON m.member_no = py.member_no JOIN corporation cp ON m.corp_no = cp.corp_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 202283.15 AND st.statement_amt > 543122.11 AND py.payment_amt > 374997.48 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND st.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND py.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_no HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 62 AND COUNT(DISTINCT st.statement_no) > 16 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_statements DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN payment p ON ch.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 12405.02 AND p.payment_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no AND m.member_no::integer = c.member_no::integer JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND m.member_no::integer = p.member_no::integer JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND m.member_no::integer = s.member_no::integer WHERE c.charge_amt > 4229.97 AND p.payment_amt > 6105.76 AND s.statement_amt > 7256.22 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 27251.24 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 5726.71 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charge c WHERE c.member_no = m.member_no AND c.charge_amt > 664.7) AS high_charge_count FROM member m JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 2272.16 AND m.issue_dt >= '2020-01-01' ORDER BY high_charge_count DESC, m.curr_balance DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS payment_count_since_date, (SELECT SUM(c.charge_amt) FROM charge c WHERE c.member_no = m.member_no AND c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS total_charges_since_date FROM member m WHERE m.curr_balance > 1397.16 AND m.country = 'A' ORDER BY m.curr_balance DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_dt, s.statement_amt FROM member m LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_no IS NULL AND m.curr_balance > 8714.88 ORDER BY m.member_no;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_payments FROM region r JOIN provider pr ON r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN charge ch ON pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no LEFT JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 6100.92 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 28327.17 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_payments FROM region r JOIN provider pr ON r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN charge ch ON pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no LEFT JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 9659.89 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 40071.13 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 364.9 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 2356.94 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 698.15 ORDER BY member_count DESC, avg_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE (ch.charge_amt > 346.08 OR ch.charge_amt < 401.35) AND NOT (m.curr_balance <= 820.6 AND m.prev_balance >= 933.45) AND (ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' OR p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01') GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 1022.14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) < 57 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_member_balance FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 351.08 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT p.member_no FROM payment p WHERE p.payment_amt >= 360.83 AND p.payment_dt IN ( SELECT s.statement_dt FROM statement s WHERE s.statement_amt > 253.47 ) ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 6475.18 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, p.provider_name, m.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charge, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_prev_balance, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_curr_balance, SUM(py.payment_amt) AS total_payment, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge c ON p.provider_no = c.provider_no JOIN member m ON c.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no AND m.region_no = co.region_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment py ON m.member_no = py.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND (cat.category_desc LIKE '%Service%' OR p.provider_name LIKE '%Medical%') AND co.country = 'US' GROUP BY r.region_name, p.provider_name, m.lastname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 2227.87 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) >= 44 ORDER BY total_charge DESC, charge_count DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, c.category_no, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_curr_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_activity, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(s.statement_amt) DESC) AS statement_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE (ch.charge_amt > 4096.08 OR p.payment_amt > 4665.64) AND (s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' OR s.due_dt >= '2020-01-01') AND NOT (m.country = 'USA' AND m.state_prov IN ('CA', 'NY')) AND (ch.charge_code = 'A' OR ch.charge_code = 'B' OR ch.charge_code = 'C') AND (pr.provider_code = 'X' OR pr.provider_code = 'Y') AND (c.category_code = 'Z' OR c.category_code = 'W') GROUP BY r.region_no, c.category_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 51611.59 AND (SUM(p.payment_amt) > 3436.87 OR AVG(m.prev_balance) < -896.58) AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 777 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments ASC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3566.4 AND s.statement_amt > 34034.38 AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 70850.61 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 13 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 43294.91 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) > 14476.93 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amt, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 48197.07 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 7 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, pv.provider_no, pv.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT st.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(st.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no AND ch.statement_no = st.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no AND st.statement_no = pm.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4546.57 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND st.statement_amt > 43142.78 AND st.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 31052.69 AND pm.payment_amt > 3920.6 AND pm.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, pv.provider_no, pv.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 95679.07 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 43 AND SUM(pm.payment_amt) > 6912.9 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, charge_rank_by_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.state_prov, c.country, m.member_code, p.provider_name, cat.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date, MIN(pay.payment_dt) AS earliest_payment_date, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_prev_balance, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_curr_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.state_prov ORDER BY MAX(ch.charge_dt)) AS prev_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND m.member_no = pay.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4752.68 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_amt BETWEEN 9306.84 AND 49817.7 AND p.provider_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.state_prov, c.country, m.member_code, p.provider_name, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 35893.75 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 859 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, r.region_no, c.state_prov;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.country, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amt FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 4902.53 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.country UNION ALL SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, p.country, COUNT(DISTINCT p.provider_no) AS provider_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge c ON p.provider_no = c.provider_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 3304.7 AND c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, p.country ORDER BY region_no, country;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 323.49 AND c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 3449.06 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_no ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 6824.95 AND p.payment_amt > 2978.99 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 49594.86 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) > 6 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank, payment_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, m.prev_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance_change FROM region r INNER JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no AND c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' WHERE m.curr_balance > 2014.14 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, m.prev_balance HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) > 80 OR COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) > 0 ORDER BY net_balance_change DESC, r.region_no, m.member_no;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5713.1 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8958.27 AND (m.curr_balance < -3463.33 OR m.prev_balance IS NOT NULL) AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 44799.08 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.member_no, c.lastname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_count FROM member c JOIN charge ch ON c.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no JOIN region r ON pv.region_no = r.region_no JOIN payment p ON c.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON p.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY c.member_no, c.lastname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 363621.52 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 53 INTERSECT SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, AVG(p2.payment_amt) AS avg_payment2, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statements_count2 FROM member m JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN payment p2 ON s.statement_no = p2.statement_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r2 ON corp.region_no = r2.region_no WHERE s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p2.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND corp.corp_code = 'A' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.statement_amt) > 245676.17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) >= 3 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(c.charge_no) AS charge_count, COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charges FROM member m LEFT JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 7242.77 AND (c.charge_dt IS NULL OR c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01') GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING COUNT(c.charge_no) < 10 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT c.category_no) AS distinct_categories, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 23028.63 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.category_no) >= 5 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance FROM member m JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.category_desc LIKE '%Medical%' AND m.state_prov = 'CA' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 2729.68 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, m.lastname, m.firstname;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, sub.max_charge, sub.total_paid FROM member m JOIN ( SELECT c.member_no, MAX(c.charge_amt) AS max_charge, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_paid FROM charge c LEFT JOIN payment p ON c.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= ( SELECT MIN(s.statement_dt) FROM statement s WHERE s.member_no = c.member_no AND s.statement_amt > 1251.55 ) WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.member_no ) sub ON m.member_no = sub.member_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 3481.55 ORDER BY sub.total_paid DESC, m.member_no;

SELECT m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.curr_balance, m2.prev_balance, (m1.curr_balance - m2.prev_balance) AS balance_change FROM member m1 JOIN member m2 ON m1.member_no = m2.member_no AND m1.region_no = m2.region_no AND m1.curr_balance > 8040.87 AND m2.prev_balance < 3121.37 JOIN region r ON m1.region_no = r.region_no WHERE m1.curr_balance > m2.prev_balance AND r.region_no = 7 GROUP BY m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.curr_balance, m2.prev_balance HAVING AVG(m1.curr_balance) > 256.65 ORDER BY balance_change DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 83.56 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT s.member_no FROM statement s WHERE s.statement_amt > 3550.49 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 180.02 ORDER BY member_count DESC, avg_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 6302.64 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > ( SELECT AVG(payment_amt) FROM payment WHERE payment_dt >= '2019-01-01' ) ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 38056.43 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4797.71 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 82437.68 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation cor ON r.region_no = cor.region_no JOIN member m ON cor.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE (ch.charge_amt > 4621.1 OR s.statement_amt < 2549.53) AND NOT (c.category_code = 'A' AND ch.charge_dt < '1990-01-01') GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 233.49 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 19786.14 ORDER BY total_payment DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.provider_no) AS provider_count, CORR(ch.charge_amt, p.payment_amt) AS charge_payment_correlation FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 9952.35 AND s.statement_amt > 18065.16 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 657759.11 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 8 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, member_count DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS distinct_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS distinct_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, COUNT(DISTINCT co.corp_no) AS distinct_corporations, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_curr_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4400.92 AND p.payment_amt > 2472.42 AND s.statement_amt > 1875.88 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 7120581.83 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 1543816.56 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 44244.56 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2090.98 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), ()) ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = ch.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01') AS member_total_payments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM statement s WHERE s.member_no = ch.member_no AND s.statement_amt > 5508.61) AS high_statement_count, MAX(m.curr_balance) AS max_current_balance, MIN(m.prev_balance) AS min_previous_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN statement st ON ch.statement_no = st.statement_no AND m.member_no = st.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 137.33 AND m.curr_balance < -5680.81 AND pr.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, ch.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 30721.59 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 64 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_no, category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, s.statement_dt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS daily_charge_total, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS 6 PRECEDING) AS moving_avg_7day_charges FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE s.statement_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 9358.31 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, s.statement_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 19114.05 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no, s.statement_dt;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 1937.76 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 78 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region FROM region r LEFT JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no LEFT JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3178.29 AND s.statement_amt > 28886.66 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 22118.64 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 52 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) > 4777.39 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, charge_rank_by_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 5584.26 AND s.statement_amt > 43413.13 AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 7903.63 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 48 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 26123.64 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) > 4991.8 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank_in_corp FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3117.51 AND s.statement_amt > 9734.1 AND p.payment_amt > 34464.08 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 26787.76 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 30422.27 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) > 42.9 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank_in_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS provider_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3303.36 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_amt < 29234.15 AND p.payment_amt > 998.31 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 49182.97 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 6 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amt, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 20300.68 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 4 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_code, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, AVG(COALESCE(m.prev_balance, 0)) AS avg_prev_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT c.provider_no) AS distinct_providers FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND c.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 80369.74 AND m.curr_balance < 42112.82 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_code HAVING (SUM(c.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) > 3324.76 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, r.region_no, m.member_code;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_payment) FROM (SELECT MAX(p.payment_amt) AS max_payment FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY p.member_no) sub) AS max_payment_last_period FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 55574.04 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 4493.68 AND c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 28711.66 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 604.4 AND c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 893.36 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) DESC) AS balance_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2023-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 4732.07 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 35604.88 ORDER BY r.region_no, balance_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amt, (SELECT MAX(s.statement_amt) FROM statement s WHERE s.member_no = m.member_no AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '1992-01-01') AS max_statement_amt_per_member, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statement_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt BETWEEN '1992-01-01' AND '1992-01-01' LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND pr.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 727376.69 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, c.category_desc, m.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 91279817.72 AND AVG(ch.charge_amt) < 8589946.36 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC, region_no, m.state_prov, c.category_desc;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, r.region_code, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, c.corp_code, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.member_code, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amt, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment_amt, (SELECT MAX(charge_amt) FROM charge WHERE member_no = m.member_no AND provider_no IN (SELECT provider_no FROM provider WHERE region_no = r.region_no)) AS max_charge_for_member_in_region, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(s.statement_amt) DESC) AS statement_amt_rank_in_region, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_amt_rank_global FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 97143.72 AND p.payment_amt < 32842.82 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, r.region_code, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, c.corp_code, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.member_code HAVING SUM(s.statement_amt) > 509060.85 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) >= 47 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_statement_amt DESC, total_payment_amt DESC;

SELECT s.statement_no, s.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, m.curr_balance, r.region_name, cor.corp_name FROM statement s JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND s.member_no = c.member_no JOIN member m ON s.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation cor ON m.corp_no = cor.corp_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND s.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY s.statement_no, s.member_no, m.curr_balance, r.region_name, cor.corp_name HAVING (SUM(c.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) > 16927.78 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT c.category_code, p.provider_code, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS unique_statements FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2965.62 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_code, p.provider_code HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 352434.38 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(*) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN region r ON co.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1115.35 AND m.curr_balance < 5244.58 GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 4741.61 AND COUNT(*) >= 33 ORDER BY total_charge DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND ch.member_no IN (SELECT member_no FROM member WHERE region_no = 1) GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 82041.42 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7318.82 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 508235.47 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.member_no IN (SELECT m.member_no FROM member m WHERE m.region_no = 31) GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 837636.74 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt) AS running_total FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6939.76 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc, ch.charge_dt, ch.charge_amt ORDER BY c.category_no, ch.charge_dt;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 88723.32 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COALESCE(SUM(s.statement_amt), 0) AS total_statement, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payment, (COALESCE(SUM(s.statement_amt), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance FROM member m LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND s.statement_dt >= '2023-01-01' LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01' WHERE m.issue_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING (COALESCE(SUM(s.statement_amt), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) > 2657.46 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charge c WHERE c.member_no = m.member_no AND c.charge_amt > 654.15) AS high_charge_count FROM member m JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 3366.99 AND m.issue_dt >= '2020-01-01' ORDER BY high_charge_count DESC, m.curr_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, MIN(ch.charge_dt) AS earliest_charge_date, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9963.83 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2000-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -2720.45 AND m.prev_balance > 561.52 AND co.corp_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 92155.66 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 99.61 AND ch.charge_amt < 2011.2 AND m.curr_balance > 243.36 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 67107.52 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2122.51 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 29529.52 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 15.25 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 61560.85 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6458.11 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((r.region_name, c.category_desc), (r.region_name), ()) ORDER BY r.region_name NULLS FIRST, c.category_desc NULLS FIRST;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4164.75 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 80199.11 UNION ALL SELECT r.region_name, NULL AS category_desc, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 9654.61 GROUP BY r.region_name HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 57087.49 ORDER BY region_name, category_desc;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member m2 WHERE m2.region_no = r.region_no AND m2.curr_balance > 4929.72) AS members_with_high_balance, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p JOIN member m3 ON p.member_no = m3.member_no WHERE m3.region_no = r.region_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS recent_payments_sum FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pv ON c.provider_no = pv.provider_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND c.charge_amt >= 3154.25 AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 970447.29 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, (SELECT AVG(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01') AS avg_member_payment FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 7074.93 AND c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 15260.57 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(SUM(c.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no) AS avg_charges_per_member FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt >= 5196.07 AND c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no || '|' || ch.statement_no) AS distinct_member_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS distinct_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1765.68 AND s.statement_amt >= 50808.89 AND m.curr_balance < 25543.26 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 139336.7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) >= 20 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5998.12 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), ()) ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3749.8 AND s.statement_amt >= 37903.26 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 13622.64 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 79056.69 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 38 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) BETWEEN 8704.07 AND 42921.93 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank LIMIT 97;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.country, m.state_prov, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, m.country ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region_country FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1903.8 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND (p.payment_dt IS NULL OR p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01') AND m.curr_balance > 90954.32 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.country, m.state_prov, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 30890.01 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 14 AND (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) > 4582.51 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charge_amount DESC, net_balance DESC;
