SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov AS member_state, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(pm.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, m.state_prov ORDER BY c.category_no) AS prev_category_charges FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON s.statement_no = pm.statement_no AND m.member_no = pm.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' OR s.due_dt IS NULL) AND ch.charge_amt > 383978.32 AND pm.payment_amt < 610210.75 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.statement_dt::DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ch.charge_dt::DATE) <= 3 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, c.category_desc, c.category_no, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 3639213.6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 770 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC, charge_count DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, r.country, m.corp_no, c.corp_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(st.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no AND ch.statement_no = st.statement_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND st.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 17621.18 AND st.statement_amt >= 29628.3 AND p.payment_amt <= 26740.36 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM category cat WHERE cat.category_no = ch.category_no AND cat.category_code = 'A' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM member m2 WHERE m2.corp_no = m.corp_no AND m2.region_no = m.region_no AND m2.curr_balance < -4892.33 ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, r.country, m.corp_no, c.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 533025.65 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 41 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_members ASC;

SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS distinct_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT st.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT py.payment_no) AS distinct_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_code || p.provider_code) AS distinct_charge_provider_codes, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(st.statement_amt) AS total_statements, SUM(py.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN payment py ON m.member_no = py.member_no JOIN corporation cp ON m.corp_no = cp.corp_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 964037.53 AND st.statement_amt > 536923.78 AND py.payment_amt > 913339.2 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND st.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND py.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_no HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 34 AND COUNT(DISTINCT st.statement_no) > 57 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_statements DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 98705.28 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.charge_dt, c.charge_amt, s.statement_amt, p.payment_amt, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_desc, AVG(c.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY c.member_no) AS avg_member_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY p.member_no ORDER BY p.payment_dt) AS running_payment_total FROM charge c JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN payment p ON s.member_no = p.member_no JOIN member m ON c.member_no = m.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 31228.95 AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY c.charge_dt, c.charge_amt, s.statement_amt, p.payment_amt, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_desc, c.member_no, p.member_no, p.payment_dt HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > (SELECT AVG(charge_amt) FROM charge WHERE charge_dt >= '1992-01-01') ORDER BY c.charge_dt DESC, running_payment_total DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.charge_dt, c.charge_amt, AVG(c.charge_amt) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY c.charge_dt::DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_charge FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 4217.45 AND c.charge_dt::DATE >= '2020-01-01'::DATE AND cat.category_no = 14 ORDER BY m.member_no, c.charge_dt;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) FROM member m WHERE m.region_no = r.region_no) AS member_count_in_region FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7484.93 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, r.region_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 8332.59 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_desc ORDER BY m.lastname, m.firstname) AS running_total_charges_by_category FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 9195.01 AND s.statement_amt > 11442.39 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ch.charge_dt::date) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.statement_dt::date)) BETWEEN 0 AND 3 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 47412.57 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, r.region_name, c.category_desc;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3644.49 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM charge ch2 WHERE ch2.member_no = m.member_no AND ch2.charge_amt > 2767.29 AND ch2.charge_dt >= '2019-01-01' ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 30981.54 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 10 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_name, m.city, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name, m.city ORDER BY c.category_desc ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 8887.49 GROUP BY r.region_name, m.city, c.category_desc, c.category_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 70831.16 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) >= 71 ORDER BY r.region_name, m.city, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, m.city, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS members_charged, AVG(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name, m.city, c.category_desc) AS avg_charge_by_region_city_category FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8639.57 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, m.city, c.category_desc, ch.charge_amt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 32560.8 INTERSECT SELECT r.region_name, m.city, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS members_charged, AVG(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name, m.city, c.category_desc) AS avg_charge_by_region_city_category FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN payment pay ON s.member_no = pay.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2832.94 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND pay.payment_amt > 180.93 GROUP BY r.region_name, m.city, c.category_desc, ch.charge_amt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 7669.07 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS charge_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN provider pv ON c.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 8023.83 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM charge WHERE charge_dt >= '2019-01-01' AND charge_amt > 2483.99 AND provider_no IN ( SELECT provider_no FROM provider WHERE region_no = 1 AND expr_dt >= '2022-01-01' ) ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 31900.77 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) >= 25 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_name, p.provider_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(st.statement_amt) AS avg_statement FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN charge ch ON st.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON st.statement_no = pm.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 701.41 AND st.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, p.provider_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 17173.27 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, c.category_no, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8491.51 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, c.category_no), (r.region_no), (c.category_no), () ) ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, c.corp_no, m.member_no, cat.category_no, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_month, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.provider_no) AS unique_providers FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5995.67 AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2020-01-01' AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2022-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 2303.15 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, c.corp_no, m.member_no, cat.category_no, statement_year, statement_month), (r.region_no, c.corp_no, cat.category_no, statement_year, statement_month), (r.region_no, cat.category_no, statement_year, statement_month), (r.region_no, statement_year, statement_month), (statement_year, statement_month), () ) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 24415.05 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, m.member_no, cat.category_no, statement_year DESC, statement_month DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, c.corp_no, m.member_no, cat.category_no, p.provider_no, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON m.member_no = pay.member_no AND s.statement_no = pay.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7177.01 AND s.statement_amt >= 34757.19 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 52490.3 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, c.corp_no, m.member_no, cat.category_no, p.provider_no), (r.region_no, c.corp_no, m.member_no, cat.category_no), (r.region_no, c.corp_no, m.member_no), (r.region_no, c.corp_no), (r.region_no), (cat.category_no, p.provider_no), (cat.category_no), (p.provider_no), () ) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 62350.02 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 11 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, m.member_no, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(DISTINCT c.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 4434.59 AND c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, MAX(s.statement_amt) AS max_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_rank_by_charges FROM region r LEFT JOIN corporation cor ON r.region_no = cor.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON cor.corp_no = m.corp_no OR (m.corp_no IS NULL AND cor.corp_no IS NULL AND r.region_no = m.region_no) LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no INNER JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no INNER JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no LEFT JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 5551.72 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 74091.39 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pr.provider_no) FROM provider pr WHERE pr.region_no = r.region_no AND pr.expr_dt >= '2020-01-01') AS active_providers, (SELECT SUM(ch.charge_amt) FROM charge ch JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.member_no IN (SELECT m2.member_no FROM member m2 WHERE m2.region_no = r.region_no) AND cat.category_code = 'A') AS category_specific_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 9505.05 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 496668.43 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 738 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, COUNT(DISTINCT p.provider_no) AS total_providers, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(py.payment_amt) AS total_payments, CASE WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) > SUM(py.payment_amt) THEN 'Deficit' WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) < SUM(py.payment_amt) THEN 'Surplus' ELSE 'Balanced' END AS financial_status, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_member_balance FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no AND p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN payment py ON m.member_no = py.member_no JOIN statement s ON py.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND py.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_amt > 74580.87 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 549983.64 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (ORDER BY r.region_no) AS prev_region_total FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 440557.9 AND ch.member_no IN ( SELECT m2.member_no FROM member m2 JOIN payment p2 ON m2.member_no = p2.member_no WHERE p2.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p2.payment_amt >= 988420.0 GROUP BY m2.member_no HAVING COUNT(p2.payment_no) > 31 ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 3916138.74 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 361 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, r.region_no, c.category_desc;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_charge, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_charges FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5147.38 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, ch.charge_dt, ch.charge_amt ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no, ch.charge_dt;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member m2 WHERE m2.region_no = r.region_no AND m2.expr_dt >= '2020-01-01') AS active_members_in_region FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3758.76 AND m.curr_balance < -710.63 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 25162.19 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 8001.53 AND s.statement_amt > 44948.54 AND p.payment_amt > 1463.45 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 75833.92 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 43 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 38855.64 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) > 43133.6 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3394.15 AND m.curr_balance < (SELECT AVG(sub.curr_balance) FROM member sub WHERE sub.region_no = m.region_no AND sub.corp_no IN (SELECT subc.corp_no FROM corporation subc WHERE subc.region_no = m.region_no AND subc.corp_code = 'A')) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 35809.87 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 93 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS provider_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7697.49 AND s.statement_amt >= 29383.34 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 93669.71 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 64707.87 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 5 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON m.member_no = pay.member_no AND s.statement_no = pay.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9606.12 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_amt < 1608.85 AND pay.payment_amt > 1997.63 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, p.provider_no, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 28858.44 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 19 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, s.due_dt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SELECT AVG(sub_s.statement_amt) FROM statement sub_s WHERE sub_s.member_no = m.member_no AND sub_s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND sub_s.statement_dt <= '1990-01-01') AS avg_statement_amt_member, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.category_no) AS distinct_categories_charged FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 668806.72 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND pv.region_no = r.region_no GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, s.due_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 6039776.38 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.category_no) >= 2 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank_in_region, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.charge_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS charge_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(c.charge_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS charge_month, COUNT(DISTINCT c.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(SUM(c.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, cat.category_no ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.charge_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(c.charge_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3month FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 1296.54 AND TO_DATE(c.charge_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.charge_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(c.charge_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 48337.74 ORDER BY r.region_no, cat.category_no, charge_year, charge_month;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.country, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amt FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 8671.87 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.country UNION ALL SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, p.country, COUNT(DISTINCT p.provider_no) AS provider_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge c ON p.provider_no = c.provider_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 4239.54 AND c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, p.country ORDER BY region_no, country;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, AVG(COALESCE(s.statement_amt, 0)) AS avg_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pv ON c.provider_no = pv.provider_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (pv.region_no = 91 OR pv.region_no IS NULL) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 89217.31 UNION ALL SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, NULL::integer AS member_no, NULL::character varying AS lastname, NULL::character varying AS firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, 0::numeric AS total_payments, 0::bigint AS statement_count, 0::numeric AS avg_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pv ON c.provider_no = pv.provider_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND pv.provider_no IN (SELECT provider_no FROM provider WHERE region_no = 36) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) > 868 ORDER BY region_no, charge_rank_in_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 227.49 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 9852.96 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT s.statement_no, s.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(SUM(c.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.member_no) AS avg_member_charges FROM statement s JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 4067.06 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY s.statement_no, s.member_no ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

WITH charge_summary AS ( SELECT c.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM charge c WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 5814.23 ) SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cs.total_charges, cs.charge_count, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN charge_summary cs ON m.member_no = cs.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cs.total_charges, cs.charge_count ORDER BY cs.total_charges DESC LIMIT 23;

WITH charge_summary AS ( SELECT c.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM charge c WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY c.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 4727.51 ) SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cs.total_charges, cs.charge_count, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN charge_summary cs ON m.member_no = cs.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cs.total_charges, cs.charge_count ORDER BY cs.total_charges DESC LIMIT 33;

SELECT c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS distinct_providers FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6462.78 GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) > 30 ORDER BY distinct_members DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3654.2 AND ch.charge_amt < 1962.84 AND m.curr_balance > 9198.31 GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) > 81.49 ORDER BY total_charge DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1747.07 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 51781.71 AND ch.member_no IN (SELECT member_no FROM statement WHERE statement_amt > 57038.47) GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 298379.12 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, p.provider_name, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count, ( SELECT MAX(pm.payment_amt) FROM payment pm WHERE pm.member_no = ch.member_no AND pm.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' ) AS max_payment_for_member FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt >= 364.45 GROUP BY c.category_desc, p.provider_name, ch.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 28832.94 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name) AS region_charge_total, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name)) / STDDEV(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name) AS charge_zscore FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation cr ON m.corp_no = cr.corp_no AND m.region_no = cr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no AND ch.statement_no = pm.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND p.provider_name LIKE 'A%' AND m.country = 'US' AND c.category_desc LIKE 'Service%' GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name, m.country HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 9695951.86 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 870 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank, region_charge_total;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN payment p ON ch.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6662.51 AND p.payment_amt > 2416.83 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 1213.39 INTERSECT SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN payment p ON ch.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2018-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2018-12-31' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) < 56114.5 ORDER BY avg_charge DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2473.99 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 479827.07 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2042.92 AND m.curr_balance < 5397.73 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 40391.28 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2064.16 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND r.region_no = 68 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc UNION ALL SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS unique_providers, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7026.36 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND r.region_no = 27 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM charge c JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 8386.11 AND p.payment_amt > 1238.54 GROUP BY c.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 36714.02 INTERSECT SELECT c.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM charge c JOIN member m ON c.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 5537.42 AND r.region_no = 10 GROUP BY c.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 18046.11;

SELECT c.member_no, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount FROM member c JOIN statement s ON c.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 6323.08 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.member_no ORDER BY total_statement_amount DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 7774.73 AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 9693.86 AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(c.charge_no) AS charge_count, COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charges FROM member m LEFT JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_no IS NULL AND m.curr_balance > 4557.71 AND m.issue_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING COUNT(c.charge_no) = 0 ORDER BY m.member_no;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.city, m.state_prov, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(p.payment_no) AS payment_count FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.member_no IN (SELECT s.member_no FROM statement s WHERE s.statement_amt > 70718.98) GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.city, m.state_prov ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt FROM member m LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_no IS NULL AND m.curr_balance > 8366.61 AND m.issue_dt >= '2020-01-01' ORDER BY m.member_no;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, MIN(ch.charge_dt) AS earliest_charge_date, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 541.17 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2000-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -4490.21 AND m.prev_balance > 4235.68 AND co.corp_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 19412.98 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_payments FROM region r JOIN provider pr ON r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN charge ch ON pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no LEFT JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 578.45 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 30223.4 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 778.63 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 1753.59 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 464.77 ORDER BY member_count DESC, avg_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2215.58 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 2673.9 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 17061.78 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 629.34 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 18961.34 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_curr_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation cor ON r.region_no = cor.region_no AND r.region_no IS NOT NULL AND cor.region_no IS NOT NULL JOIN member m ON cor.corp_no = m.corp_no AND cor.corp_no IS NOT NULL AND m.corp_no IS NOT NULL JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no AND m.member_no IS NOT NULL AND ch.member_no IS NOT NULL JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no AND ch.category_no IS NOT NULL AND c.category_no IS NOT NULL JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND m.member_no IS NOT NULL AND p.member_no IS NOT NULL JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND m.member_no IS NOT NULL AND s.member_no IS NOT NULL JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND ch.provider_no IS NOT NULL AND pr.provider_no IS NOT NULL WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8333.01 AND s.statement_amt > 21803.49 AND p.payment_amt > 4310.84 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname), (r.region_name, c.category_desc), (r.region_name), ()) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > SUM(p.payment_amt) AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) > 29.99 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, AVG(avg_statement_amt) AS avg_member_statement_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.member_no, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amt FROM statement s WHERE s.statement_dt >= ( SELECT MIN(s2.statement_dt) FROM statement s2 WHERE s2.statement_amt > 9412.23 ) GROUP BY s.member_no ) AS subq ON m.member_no = subq.member_no WHERE r.region_no = 1 AND m.issue_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 22595.98 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, cat.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2355.19 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 78374.76 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND co.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7628.19 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 4166.84 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 36596.18 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM region r INNER JOIN provider pr ON r.region_no = pr.region_no INNER JOIN charge ch ON pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no INNER JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no INNER JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5882.08 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 74913.77 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY r.region_no) AS prev_charge_amt FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 19598.33 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_amt > 871595.38 AND m.curr_balance < 77214.09 AND pr.provider_no IN (SELECT provider_no FROM provider WHERE provider_code = 'A') GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 6688591.24 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 962 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY r.region_no) AS prev_charge_amt FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 966586.64 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_amt > 166242.12 AND m.curr_balance < 263476.21 AND pr.provider_no IN (SELECT provider_no FROM provider WHERE provider_code = 'A') GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 7991754.57 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 34 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS last_charge_date, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3371.84 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM statement st WHERE st.member_no = m.member_no AND st.statement_amt > 2791.12 AND st.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment pm WHERE pm.member_no = m.member_no AND pm.payment_amt > 1713.06 AND pm.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 43765.7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 49 AND (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) > 1560.02 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, region_charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS unique_providers, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE (ch.charge_amt > 6023.43 OR s.statement_amt < 3249.94) AND (m.curr_balance >= 6968.87 OR m.prev_balance <= 3760.41) AND NOT (ch.charge_dt < '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt > '2020-01-01') AND (cat.category_no IN (41, 31, 45) OR pv.provider_no BETWEEN 587 AND 268) AND (s.due_dt >= '2020-01-01' OR m.issue_dt <= '2010-01-01') GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 43297.65 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 3 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) BETWEEN 4207.92 AND 1151.45 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank ASC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 268.07 AND m.curr_balance < (SELECT AVG(sub.curr_balance) FROM member sub WHERE sub.region_no = m.region_no AND sub.corp_no IN (SELECT subc.corp_no FROM corporation subc WHERE subc.region_no = m.region_no AND subc.corp_code = 'A')) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 16436.92 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 37 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, r.region_no, r.region_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no) AS avg_net_per_member_group, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, (SELECT AVG(sub_ch.charge_amt) FROM charge sub_ch WHERE sub_ch.category_no = c.category_no AND sub_ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01') AS avg_category_charge_since_date FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND s.statement_amt > 54430.57 JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND pr.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no AND co.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '1990-01-01' AND m.expr_dt > '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 4061.45 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.category_no, c.category_desc, r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), () ) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 164562.59 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 295 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no, total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, r.region_no, r.region_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no) AS avg_net_per_member_group, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, (SELECT AVG(sub_ch.charge_amt) FROM charge sub_ch WHERE sub_ch.category_no = c.category_no AND sub_ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01') AS avg_category_charge_since_date FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND s.statement_amt > 71414.96 JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND pr.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no AND co.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '1990-01-01' AND m.expr_dt > '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 5781.55 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.category_no, c.category_desc, r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), () ) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 855676.64 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 807 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no, total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charges FROM member m LEFT JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) > 89769.87 INTERSECT SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payments FROM member m LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) > 84953.19 ORDER BY member_no;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 360.7 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 1319.08 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 1942.72 ORDER BY member_count DESC, avg_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, MAX(s.statement_amt) AS max_statement, MIN(s.due_dt) AS earliest_due_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name) AS region_total_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 126121.13 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 2636290.97 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) >= 514 ORDER BY region_total_charge DESC, charge_rank LIMIT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.category_desc) FROM category c WHERE c.category_code = 'A');

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no AND m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN statement s ON s.member_no = m.member_no JOIN charge ch ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN category c ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 28604.28 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 939.14 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 79047.48 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_payment) FROM ( SELECT p.member_no, MAX(p.payment_amt) AS max_payment FROM payment p WHERE p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY p.member_no HAVING MAX(p.payment_amt) > 2980.93 ) sub WHERE sub.member_no IN (SELECT m2.member_no FROM member m2 WHERE m2.region_no = r.region_no) ) AS max_payment_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND s.statement_amt > 7986.07 AND pr.provider_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, r.region_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 532569.53 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 63 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, r.region_name, c.category_desc;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2024-12-31' AND ch.charge_amt > 8151.41 AND m.curr_balance > 32034.89 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 289612.45 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 80.51 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_name, category_desc;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS rank_by_charge FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4679.18 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, cat.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_month, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name, c.corp_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_corp FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON s.statement_no = pm.statement_no AND m.member_no = pm.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8092.71 AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('1990-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(s.due_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= TO_DATE('1990-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND m.curr_balance < 97603.07 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_name, c.corp_name, cat.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))), (r.region_name, c.corp_name, cat.category_desc, p.provider_name), (r.region_name, c.corp_name, cat.category_desc), (r.region_name, c.corp_name), (r.region_name), () ) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 13073.81 ORDER BY r.region_name, c.corp_name, total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS charge_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN provider pv ON c.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 642.28 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM charge WHERE charge_dt >= '2019-01-01' AND charge_amt > 2929.45 AND provider_no IN ( SELECT provider_no FROM provider WHERE region_no = 4 AND expr_dt >= '2022-01-01' ) ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 48727.92 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) >= 5 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_payments_count, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amt FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 3586.36 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 16751.25 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(st.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount FROM region r JOIN provider pr ON r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN charge ch ON pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no LEFT JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no AND st.statement_dt >= '1995-01-01' WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1995-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 651.45 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 82583.78 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.provider_no) AS provider_count, CORR(ch.charge_amt, p.payment_amt) AS charge_payment_correlation FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 7464.71 AND s.statement_amt > 6089.23 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 930106.88 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 24 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, member_count DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3483.38 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) < 134076.26 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_per_member FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 471.56 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 959380.12 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS unique_members, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.provider_no) AS unique_providers FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1040.78 AND s.statement_amt >= 48328.97 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 20787.2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 12 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_member_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS members_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT p.member_no) AS members_paid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY c.category_no ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_charges_by_category FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND pr.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3901.32 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (c.category_desc LIKE '%Emergency%' OR pr.provider_name LIKE '%General%') AND r.region_name NOT LIKE '%Test%' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 21413.61 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 45 ORDER BY r.region_no, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT p.statement_no) AS distinct_statements_paid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_charges_by_category FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1432.12 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -59312.62 AND s.statement_amt > 71267.82 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 35038.64 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) > 33 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) < 40581.11 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT p.statement_no) AS distinct_statements_paid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_charges_by_category FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2492.25 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -70017.39 AND s.statement_amt > 4930.98 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 61356.63 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) > 49 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) < 39718.05 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;
