SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.member_no, m.curr_balance, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT pr.provider_no FROM provider pr JOIN charge ch2 ON pr.provider_no = ch2.provider_no WHERE pr.region_no = r.region_no AND ch2.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch2.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01') AS sub) AS active_providers FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 88900.08 AND m.expr_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.member_no, m.curr_balance HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 927132.48 OR COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) > 71 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, r.region_no, m.member_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS distinct_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS distinct_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT cat.category_no) AS distinct_categories, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date, MIN(p.payment_dt) AS earliest_payment_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.corp_no ORDER BY SUM(s.statement_amt) DESC) AS statement_rank_in_corp FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2508.15 AND s.statement_amt > 25438.29 AND p.payment_amt > 407.22 AND m.curr_balance < 91449.04 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 71073.88 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) > 92 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 105 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.corp_no, c.corp_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(DISTINCT p.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.category_no) AS distinct_categories, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_code) AS distinct_charge_codes, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT py.payment_no) AS distinct_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, SUM(py.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_curr_balance, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date, MIN(ch.charge_dt) AS earliest_charge_date FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN payment py ON s.statement_no = py.statement_no AND m.member_no = py.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8126.93 AND s.statement_amt > 24806.92 AND py.payment_amt > 19382.82 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND py.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.issue_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND c.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.corp_no, c.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 755549.01 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) > 57.04 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.provider_no) > 36.62 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, distinct_members DESC, distinct_providers DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.corp_no, c.corp_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(DISTINCT p.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS distinct_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT py.payment_no) AS distinct_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(py.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, AVG(py.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date, MIN(py.payment_dt) AS earliest_payment_date FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN payment py ON s.statement_no = py.statement_no AND m.member_no = py.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8270.42 AND py.payment_amt > 2512.7 AND s.statement_amt > 297.82 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND py.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.corp_no, c.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 6522.94 AND SUM(py.payment_amt) > 44858.04 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC, distinct_members DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.corp_no, c.corp_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members_charged, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND (s.due_dt <= '2020-01-01' OR s.due_dt IS NULL) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.corp_no, c.corp_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 95831.21 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_no, corp_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.corp_no, c.corp_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, CASE WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 765932.17 THEN 'High Charge' WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) BETWEEN 5705.49 AND 2099.85 THEN 'Medium Charge' ELSE 'Low Charge' END AS charge_category, CASE WHEN AVG(s.statement_amt) - SUM(pay.payment_amt) > 2694.81 THEN 'High Outstanding' WHEN AVG(s.statement_amt) - SUM(pay.payment_amt) BETWEEN 180.5 AND 278.65 THEN 'Medium Outstanding' ELSE 'Low Outstanding' END AS outstanding_category, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS total_statements, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(pay.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank_global FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND m.member_no = pay.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 2592.69 AND s.statement_amt > 7504.14 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.corp_no, c.corp_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 76540.48 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) > 14 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank_in_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 61550.78 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank_in_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, MAX(ch.charge_amt) AS max_charge_amt, MIN(ch.charge_amt) AS min_charge_amt, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.category_no) AS distinct_categories_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS distinct_payments_made, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance_delta, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(m.curr_balance, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt) AS prev_balance_before_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 8563.85 AND m.curr_balance > 68352.05 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, ch.charge_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 37940.87 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.category_no) >= 10 AND AVG(ch.charge_amt) < 3020.99 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC, m.member_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amt, (SELECT MAX(s.statement_amt) FROM statement s WHERE s.member_no = m.member_no AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '1992-01-01') AS max_statement_amt_per_member, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statement_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt BETWEEN '1992-01-01' AND '1992-01-01' LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND pr.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 6698365.54 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, c.category_desc, m.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 50465826.21 AND AVG(ch.charge_amt) < 2654061.28 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC, region_no, m.state_prov, c.category_desc;

SELECT s.member_no, s.statement_dt, s.statement_amt, AVG(s.statement_amt) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.member_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3period, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(p.payment_no) AS payment_count FROM statement s JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND s.member_no = c.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND s.member_no = p.member_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 1694.12 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY s.member_no, s.statement_dt, s.statement_amt, s.statement_no ORDER BY s.member_no, s.statement_dt;

SELECT s.region_name, s.state_prov, s.member_count, s.avg_balance, s.total_payments, (SELECT MAX(p.payment_dt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = s.member_no AND p.payment_amt > 9196.41) AS last_large_payment_date FROM ( SELECT r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.member_no, COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY r.region_no) AS member_count, AVG(m.curr_balance) OVER(PARTITION BY r.region_no) AS avg_balance, SUM(py.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN payment py ON m.member_no = py.member_no WHERE py.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.member_no, m.curr_balance ) s WHERE s.total_payments > 786.24 ORDER BY s.region_name, s.total_payments DESC;

WITH charge_summary AS ( SELECT c.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM charge c WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY c.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 1037.63 ) SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cs.total_charges, cs.charge_count, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN charge_summary cs ON m.member_no = cs.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cs.total_charges, cs.charge_count ORDER BY cs.total_charges DESC LIMIT 97;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3712.53 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, (SELECT AVG(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = ch.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS avg_recent_payments FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND r.region_name = 'North' GROUP BY c.category_desc, ch.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 44394.23 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_code LIKE 'A' GROUP BY c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 481.28 GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 5547.75 AND COUNT(*) >= 36 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SELECT AVG(sub_ch.charge_amt) FROM charge sub_ch WHERE sub_ch.member_no = m.member_no AND sub_ch.charge_amt > 9205.98 AND sub_ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01') AS avg_large_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND s.statement_dt BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '1990-01-01' WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5350.34 AND ch.charge_dt BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '1990-01-01' AND m.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND pv.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND corp.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.member_no, r.region_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 14756.69 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 92124.61 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.charge_dt, c.charge_code, AVG(c.charge_amt) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.charge_code ORDER BY c.charge_dt ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_charge FROM charge c WHERE c.charge_amt > 4628.89 GROUP BY c.charge_dt, c.charge_code, c.charge_amt ORDER BY c.charge_dt;

SELECT c1.member_no AS member1, c2.member_no AS member2, COUNT(DISTINCT s1.statement_no) AS shared_statements, SUM(c1.charge_amt) AS total_charges_member1, SUM(c2.charge_amt) AS total_charges_member2 FROM charge c1 JOIN charge c2 ON c1.statement_no = c2.statement_no AND c1.member_no < c2.member_no JOIN statement s1 ON c1.statement_no = s1.statement_no JOIN statement s2 ON c2.statement_no = s2.statement_no WHERE c1.charge_amt > 1159.97 AND c2.charge_amt > 2284.5 GROUP BY c1.member_no, c2.member_no HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s1.statement_no) > 5 ORDER BY shared_statements DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charge c WHERE c.member_no = m.member_no AND c.charge_amt > 687.42) AS high_charge_count, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_payments FROM member m WHERE m.region_no = 6 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM corporation corp WHERE corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND corp.region_no = m.region_no ) ORDER BY high_charge_count DESC, recent_payments DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND m.member_no IN (SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 9151.76 AND payment_dt >= '1992-01-01') GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 34433.16 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(c.charge_no) AS charge_count FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt >= 4458.08 AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 11820.02 UNION ALL SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(p.payment_no) AS payment_count FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt >= 1805.97 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 30566.91 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_payment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charge ch WHERE ch.member_no = m.member_no AND ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements FROM member m LEFT JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 7985.1 AND m.expr_dt >= '2024-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 4677.86 OR SUM(ch.charge_amt) IS NULL ORDER BY m.curr_balance DESC;

SELECT m.region_no, m.corp_no, c.category_no, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE)) AS charge_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE)) AS charge_month, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(*) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charged, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, MAX(ch.charge_amt) AS max_charge, MIN(ch.charge_amt) AS min_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_prev_balance, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_curr_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no, m.corp_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS corp_charge_rank, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE))) AS region_monthly_running_total FROM member m JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.payment_dt AS DATE)) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE)) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(p.payment_dt AS DATE)) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE)) LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(s.statement_dt AS DATE)) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE)) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(s.statement_dt AS DATE)) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE)) WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3098.61 AND CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' AND CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE) <= '2000-01-01' AND pr.provider_no IN (SELECT provider_no FROM provider WHERE region_no = m.region_no AND CAST(expr_dt AS DATE) > '2000-01-01') GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (m.region_no, m.corp_no, c.category_no, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE))), (m.region_no, m.corp_no, c.category_no), (m.region_no, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE))), (m.region_no, m.corp_no), (m.region_no), (c.category_no), (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(ch.charge_dt AS DATE))), () ) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 124971.54 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 294 ORDER BY m.region_no, m.corp_no, c.category_no, charge_year DESC, charge_month DESC, total_charged DESC;

SELECT p1.region_no, p1.provider_no, p1.provider_name, p2.provider_no AS other_provider_no, p2.provider_name AS other_provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c1.charge_no) AS charge_count_self, COUNT(DISTINCT c2.charge_no) AS charge_count_other, SUM(c1.charge_amt) AS total_charge_self, SUM(c2.charge_amt) AS total_charge_other FROM provider p1 JOIN provider p2 ON p1.region_no = p2.region_no AND p1.provider_no != p2.provider_no JOIN charge c1 ON p1.provider_no = c1.provider_no JOIN charge c2 ON p2.provider_no = c2.provider_no WHERE c1.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND c2.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p1.region_no, p1.provider_no, p1.provider_name, p2.provider_no, p2.provider_name HAVING SUM(c1.charge_amt) > 99540.65 AND SUM(c2.charge_amt) > 34721.76 ORDER BY total_charge_self DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2915.4 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 4275.16 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 25152.4 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name) AS avg_charge_per_region FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3527.77 AND ch.charge_dt >= ( SELECT MAX(payment_dt) FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > ( SELECT AVG(payment_amt) FROM payment WHERE member_no IN (SELECT member_no FROM member WHERE region_no = r.region_no) ) ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 8882.49 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 713.17 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 55387.47 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS unique_members, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no AND co.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND m.country = 'US' JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no AND ch.charge_dt BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt > '2019-01-01' WHERE (c.category_code = 'A' OR c.category_code = 'A') AND NOT (m.curr_balance < -382.42 OR m.prev_balance > 307.02) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 920368.88 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) <= 92 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_amt > 9923.73 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM provider pr WHERE pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no AND pr.region_no = r.region_no AND pr.expr_dt >= ch.charge_dt ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 170424.74 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.provider_no) AS unique_providers, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS balance_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 504.54 AND m.curr_balance < -42839.96 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM charge c2 JOIN statement s2 ON c2.statement_no = s2.statement_no WHERE c2.member_no = m.member_no AND c2.charge_amt > 4484.55 AND s2.statement_amt > 19684.05 ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 48271.92 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) >= 44 AND (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) > 5318.63 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, balance_rank;

SELECT r.region_name, p.provider_name, m.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charge, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_prev_balance, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_curr_balance, SUM(py.payment_amt) AS total_payment, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge c ON p.provider_no = c.provider_no JOIN member m ON c.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no AND m.region_no = co.region_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment py ON m.member_no = py.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND (cat.category_desc LIKE '%Service%' OR p.provider_name LIKE '%Medical%') AND co.country = 'US' GROUP BY r.region_name, p.provider_name, m.lastname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 6405.46 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) >= 41 ORDER BY total_charge DESC, charge_count DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, c.category_no, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7241.69 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, c.category_no), (r.region_no), (c.category_no), () ) ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, c.corp_no, cat.category_no, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_year, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9973.53 AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2020-01-01' AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 1110.92 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, c.corp_no, cat.category_no, statement_year), (r.region_no, c.corp_no, cat.category_no), (r.region_no, c.corp_no), (r.region_no), () ) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 41539.07 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, cat.category_no, statement_year;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_balance, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 1130.85 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 1988.25 AND s.statement_dt >= ( SELECT MAX(statement_dt) FROM statement WHERE statement_dt < '1990-01-01' ) AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > ( SELECT AVG(payment_amt) FROM payment WHERE payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' ) ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) > 9 ORDER BY total_statements DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN provider pv ON r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN charge ch ON pv.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no AND m.region_no = co.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 98767.39 AND s.statement_amt > 16633.74 AND m.prev_balance < 9226.77 AND co.corp_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 2973361.63 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 376 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_no, category_desc;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, MAX(ch.charge_amt) AS max_charge_amount, MIN(p.payment_amt) AS min_payment_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.corp_no ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank FROM region r INNER JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 741.0 AND s.statement_amt BETWEEN 509.18 AND 12627.34 AND m.curr_balance < -3111.33 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 5 AND SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 30733.88 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) < 12148.54 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, net_balance ASC LIMIT 790;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 6819.35 AND s.statement_amt > 45404.69 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 40320.94 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 11 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 958.87 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, s.due_dt, ch.charge_no, ch.charge_amt, ch.charge_dt, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, p.payment_no, p.payment_amt, p.payment_dt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt) AS running_member_charges, COUNT(p.payment_no) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no, s.statement_no) AS payments_per_statement, AVG(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY cat.category_no, r.region_no) AS avg_category_charge_by_region, CASE WHEN s.statement_amt > 12200.12 AND s.due_dt < '2020-01-01' THEN 'High Amount Past Due' WHEN s.statement_amt BETWEEN 4119.01 AND 4572.44 AND s.due_dt >= '2020-01-01' THEN 'Medium Amount On Time' WHEN s.statement_amt < 475.7 THEN 'Low Amount' ELSE 'Standard' END AS statement_risk_category, CASE WHEN m.curr_balance - m.prev_balance > 6947.53 THEN 'Balance Increased' WHEN m.curr_balance - m.prev_balance < -7330.55 THEN 'Balance Decreased' ELSE 'Balance Stable' END AS member_balance_trend, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS distinct_charges, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS latest_statement_date FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE s.statement_dt >= '2019-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt >= '2019-01-01' AND (m.curr_balance > 84777.21 OR m.prev_balance > 38272.41) AND ch.charge_amt > 3660.84 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, s.due_dt, ch.charge_no, ch.charge_amt, ch.charge_dt, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, p.payment_no, p.payment_amt, p.payment_dt, m.curr_balance, m.prev_balance HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 10311.36 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 23 ORDER BY total_payments DESC, avg_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.country, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amt FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 3073.02 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.country UNION ALL SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, p.country, COUNT(DISTINCT p.provider_no) AS provider_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge c ON p.provider_no = c.provider_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 902.8 AND c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, p.country ORDER BY region_no, country;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 588.56 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 6067.45 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) DESC) AS balance_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2023-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 9300.46 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 33104.61 ORDER BY r.region_no, balance_rank;

SELECT s.member_no, s.statement_dt, s.statement_amt, AVG(s.statement_amt) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.member_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt::DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3period FROM statement s WHERE s.statement_amt > 6697.09 AND s.statement_dt::DATE >= '2020-01-01'::DATE ORDER BY s.member_no, s.statement_dt;

SELECT s.statement_no, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_amt, SUM(p.payment_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY s.member_no ORDER BY p.payment_dt) AS running_payment_total, COUNT(p.payment_no) OVER (PARTITION BY s.member_no ORDER BY p.payment_dt) AS payment_count, AVG(s.statement_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no) AS avg_statement_by_region FROM statement s JOIN member m ON s.member_no = m.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 2140.86 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY s.statement_no, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_amt, m.region_no, p.payment_dt, p.payment_amt, p.payment_no ORDER BY m.member_no, p.payment_dt;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN region r ON co.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2016.42 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(*) > 208 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2888.16 AND s.statement_amt < 20745.25 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 2963.33 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2022-12-31' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 57752.95 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, p.provider_name, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 7177.92 AND m.curr_balance < 16490.91 AND r.region_no = 97 GROUP BY c.category_desc, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 15744.98 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charges FROM category c LEFT JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no LEFT JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no LEFT JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' OR ch.charge_dt IS NULL GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) < 91 OR COUNT(ch.charge_no) IS NULL ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.member_no IN (SELECT m.member_no FROM member m WHERE m.curr_balance > 8029.76) GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.charge_dt, c.charge_amt, s.statement_amt, p.payment_amt, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_desc, AVG(c.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY c.member_no) AS avg_member_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY p.member_no ORDER BY p.payment_dt) AS running_payment_total FROM charge c JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN payment p ON s.member_no = p.member_no JOIN member m ON c.member_no = m.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 42666.18 AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY c.charge_dt, c.charge_amt, s.statement_amt, p.payment_amt, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_desc, c.member_no, p.member_no, p.payment_dt HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > (SELECT AVG(charge_amt) FROM charge WHERE charge_dt >= '1992-01-01') ORDER BY c.charge_dt DESC, running_payment_total DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 7171.75 AND c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 9094.02 AND c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(c.charge_no) AS charge_count, COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charges FROM member m LEFT JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_no IS NULL AND m.curr_balance > 3440.39 AND m.issue_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING COUNT(c.charge_no) = 0 ORDER BY m.member_no;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.charge_dt, c.charge_amt, AVG(c.charge_amt) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY c.charge_dt::DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_charge FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 152.41 AND c.charge_dt::DATE >= '2020-01-01'::DATE AND cat.category_no = 11 ORDER BY m.member_no, c.charge_dt;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM member m JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 4818.37 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 21276.2 ORDER BY total_statement_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r INNER JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no INNER JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no INNER JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 25372.56 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE (ch.charge_amt > 175.99 OR ch.charge_amt < 236.24) AND NOT (m.curr_balance <= 926.92 AND m.prev_balance >= 950.92) AND (ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' OR p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01') GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 42998.56 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) < 10 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name) AS avg_charge_per_region FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7009.91 AND ch.charge_dt >= ( SELECT MAX(payment_dt) FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > ( SELECT AVG(payment_amt) FROM payment WHERE member_no IN (SELECT member_no FROM member WHERE region_no = r.region_no) ) ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 6302.66 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.state_prov, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amt, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT p.member_no) AS unique_members_paid, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.provider_no) AS unique_providers, MAX(m.curr_balance) AS max_current_balance, MIN(m.prev_balance) AS min_previous_balance, SUM(m.curr_balance - m.prev_balance) AS net_balance_change, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r INNER JOIN corporation cor ON r.region_no = cor.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON cor.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 2804.01 AND p.payment_amt < 9163.65 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.state_prov HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 55627.16 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 536.35 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments ASC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payment, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_current_balance, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_previous_balance, SUM(m.curr_balance - m.prev_balance) AS balance_change FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON s.statement_no = pm.statement_no AND m.member_no = pm.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 62636.33 AND s.statement_amt > 54511.47 AND m.curr_balance > 4454.54 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND pm.payment_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name), (r.region_name, c.category_desc), (r.region_name, p.provider_name), (c.category_desc, p.provider_name), (r.region_name), (c.category_desc), (p.provider_name), ()) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 388049.21 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 386.95 ORDER BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_current_balance, SUM(py.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name, c.category_desc) AS region_category_total FROM region r INNER JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment py ON m.member_no = py.member_no AND s.statement_no = py.statement_no INNER JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no INNER JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no INNER JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 7761.53 AND m.curr_balance < 39026.82 AND s.statement_amt > 7045.79 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 45302.29 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 65 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pr.provider_no) FROM provider pr WHERE pr.region_no = r.region_no AND pr.expr_dt >= '2020-01-01') AS active_providers, (SELECT SUM(ch.charge_amt) FROM charge ch JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.member_no IN (SELECT m2.member_no FROM member m2 WHERE m2.region_no = r.region_no) AND cat.category_code = 'A') AS category_specific_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 7568.05 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 480109.96 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 644 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND p.payment_amt > 569.81 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 61010.79 ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statement_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ch.charge_code = 'A' THEN ch.charge_amt ELSE 0 END) AS total_charge_code_a, SUM(CASE WHEN ch.charge_code = 'B' THEN ch.charge_amt ELSE 0 END) AS total_charge_code_b FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8826.33 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 2553.63 ORDER BY avg_charge_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no || '|' || ch.statement_no) AS distinct_member_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS distinct_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5478.74 AND s.statement_amt >= 69436.02 AND m.curr_balance < 16406.84 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 194968.51 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) >= 27 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5979.18 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (p.payment_dt IS NULL OR p.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01') GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 48561.07 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 79 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9872.88 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (p.payment_dt IS NULL OR p.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01') GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 98348.57 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 342 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, MAX(ch.charge_amt) AS max_charge_amount, MIN(p.payment_amt) AS min_payment_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 5505.52 AND p.payment_amt < 4465.44 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 18278.95 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 14 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) BETWEEN 1659.77 AND 7127.54 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 17250.03 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_charge_rank ASC LIMIT 704;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt) AS prev_member_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7523.26 AND s.statement_amt BETWEEN 19969.27 AND 110111.93 AND (m.lastname LIKE 'A%' OR m.firstname LIKE 'A%') AND ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, ch.charge_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 65211.26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 17 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, region_charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS provider_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3958.31 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_amt < 35468.92 AND p.payment_amt > 3885.66 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 14177.97 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 16 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amt, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 52701.24 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 43 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, pv.provider_no, pv.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT st.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(st.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no AND st.statement_no = pm.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3354.78 AND st.statement_amt > 26239.09 AND pm.payment_amt > 3770.17 AND m.curr_balance > 51187.42 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, pv.provider_no, pv.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 12831.95 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 40 AND SUM(pm.payment_amt) > 33474.81 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, pv.provider_no, pv.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT st.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(st.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no AND ch.statement_no = st.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no AND st.statement_no = pm.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1372.52 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND st.statement_amt > 30447.62 AND st.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 69502.5 AND pm.payment_amt > 2929.02 AND pm.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, pv.provider_no, pv.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 78135.25 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 50 AND SUM(pm.payment_amt) > 7708.5 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, charge_rank_by_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (m.curr_balance + SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS projected_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM statement s WHERE s.member_no = m.member_no AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS recent_statements, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (m.curr_balance + SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS balance_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 8422.75 AND p.payment_amt > 2040.07 AND pr.region_no = r.region_no GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) > 7602.58 ORDER BY r.region_no, balance_rank_in_region, projected_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_avg_payments, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.corp_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_statements_per_corp, SUM(m.curr_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS region_moving_balance, MAX(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS neighbor_max_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 3145.9 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 49360.18 AND ch.charge_amt > 39140.89 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, m.curr_balance, ch.charge_amt, p.payment_amt, ch.charge_dt, p.payment_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 6969.8 AND AVG(p.payment_amt) < 969.1 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, m.member_no, s.statement_dt DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.country AS member_country, p.country AS provider_country, cat.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_curr_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no AND m.country = r.country JOIN corporation c ON m.corp_no = c.corp_no AND m.country = c.country JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND p.country = r.country JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND s.member_no = m.member_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND pay.payment_dt BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '1990-01-01' WHERE ch.charge_amt > 679005.95 AND m.curr_balance < 175548.07 AND c.corp_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.country, p.country, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 7971768.72 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 388 UNION ALL SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, NULL AS member_country, p.country AS provider_country, cat.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, 0 AS total_payments, 0 AS avg_prev_balance, 0 AS avg_curr_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no AND p.country = r.country JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 968298.23 AND p.provider_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, p.country, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 3825967.51 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 346 ORDER BY region_charge_rank, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.country, m.state_prov, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, m.country ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region_country FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8113.8 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND (p.payment_dt IS NULL OR p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01') AND m.curr_balance > 86874.24 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.country, m.state_prov, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 164739.17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 34 AND (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) > 18766.08 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charge_amount DESC, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 287.63 AND c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 680.39 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 1676.13 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 7061.22 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT r1.region_no, r1.region_name, r2.region_name AS other_region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_balance FROM region r1 JOIN region r2 ON r1.region_no = r2.region_no JOIN member m ON m.region_no = r1.region_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 9312.8 GROUP BY r1.region_no, r1.region_name, r2.region_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 122 ORDER BY avg_balance DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, ROUND(AVG(ch.charge_amt), 2) AS avg_charge_amt, COUNT(*) AS total_charges FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2021-01-01' AND r.region_name LIKE 'East%' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 35599.12 ORDER BY avg_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2024-12-31' AND ch.charge_amt > 6049.93 AND m.curr_balance > 94002.99 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 284569.5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 56.88 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_name, category_desc;

SELECT r.region_name, p.provider_name, cat.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS num_statements, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(pay.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, AVG(SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(pay.payment_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name) AS avg_region_net_balance FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge c ON p.provider_no = c.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN member m ON c.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no AND m.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no AND c.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND s.member_no = pay.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 94596.49 GROUP BY r.region_name, p.provider_name, cat.category_desc, r.region_no, p.provider_no, cat.category_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 76526.01 AND (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(pay.payment_amt)) > 61290.49 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, r.region_name, p.provider_name;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 134.17 AND s.statement_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT p.member_no FROM payment p WHERE p.payment_amt > 319.14 ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(s.statement_amt) > 316296.37 ORDER BY total_statement_amount DESC;
