SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 803.59 AND s.statement_amt >= 48967.61 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 46909.14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 13 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank LIMIT 172;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 361.79 AND p.payment_amt > 2202.29 AND r.region_no = 9 GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > (SELECT AVG(charge_amt) FROM charge WHERE charge_amt > 5367.99) ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charge c WHERE c.member_no = m.member_no AND c.charge_amt > 256.65) AS high_charge_count FROM member m JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 4743.53 AND m.issue_dt >= '2020-01-01' ORDER BY high_charge_count DESC, m.curr_balance DESC;

SELECT m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.curr_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM member m1 JOIN member m2 ON m1.region_no = m2.region_no AND m1.member_no != m2.member_no JOIN charge c ON m1.member_no = c.member_no WHERE m1.curr_balance > 8399.88 AND c.charge_amt BETWEEN 93.34 AND 664.51 GROUP BY m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.curr_balance HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 1987.02 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_payment) FROM ( SELECT p.member_no, MAX(p.payment_amt) AS max_payment FROM payment p WHERE p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY p.member_no HAVING MAX(p.payment_amt) > 5590.58 ) sub WHERE sub.member_no IN (SELECT m2.member_no FROM member m2 WHERE m2.region_no = r.region_no) ) AS max_payment_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND s.statement_amt > 23156.12 AND pr.provider_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, r.region_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 129609.31 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 20 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, r.region_name, c.category_desc;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amt FROM region r LEFT JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no LEFT JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' OR s.statement_dt IS NULL GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) < 2020 ORDER BY total_statement_amt DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 624.95 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 20763.35 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1279.6 AND s.statement_amt >= 33565.19 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 67528.47 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 9 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank LIMIT 625;

SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, cor.corp_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_prev_balance, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_curr_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_activity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (ORDER BY r.region_name, c.category_desc) AS prev_region_category_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN region r ON pr.region_no = r.region_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation cor ON m.corp_no = cor.corp_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 102368.75 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND cor.corp_name LIKE 'A' AND pr.provider_name LIKE 'A' GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name, cor.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 9733412.94 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 5888 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_charge_rank, net_activity;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation cor ON r.region_no = cor.region_no JOIN member m ON cor.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= (SELECT MIN(payment_dt) FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 5978.3) AND ch.charge_dt <= (SELECT MAX(payment_dt) FROM payment WHERE payment_amt < 5533.65) AND ch.charge_amt > (SELECT AVG(charge_amt) FROM charge WHERE charge_code = 'A') GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 952412.91 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no) AS avg_net_balance_by_region_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) DESC) AS member_balance_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 20615.12 AND s.statement_amt > 53166.3 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) > -79664.47 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 41450.19 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 47 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT c.category_code, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, CASE WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 29967.49 THEN 'High' WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 9575.49 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS charge_volume_category FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_code ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, (SELECT MAX(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01') AS max_recent_payment FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4281.54 AND r.region_no = 61 GROUP BY c.category_desc, m.member_no HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) >= 40 ORDER BY avg_charge DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN member m ON s.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4580.75 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND r.region_no = 10 GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(s.statement_amt) > 649361.98 ORDER BY total_statement DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM member m WHERE m.member_no = ch.member_no AND m.curr_balance > 2175.46 ) AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 10088.93 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9399.69 AND p.payment_amt > 3583.14 AND r.region_no = 1 GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > (SELECT AVG(charge_amt) FROM charge WHERE charge_amt > 278.56) ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 34128.05 AND ch.member_no IN (SELECT member_no FROM statement WHERE statement_amt > 38647.43) GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 670115.07 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN region r ON ch.provider_no IN (SELECT pv.provider_no FROM provider pv WHERE pv.region_no = r.region_no) JOIN payment p ON ch.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 36612.17 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 440055.39 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND (ch.charge_amt > 1215.11 OR ch.charge_code = 'A') AND NOT (m.country = 'A') GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 150419.84 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name) AS region_charge_total, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name)) / STDDEV(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name) AS charge_zscore FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation cr ON m.corp_no = cr.corp_no AND m.region_no = cr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no AND ch.statement_no = pm.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND p.provider_name LIKE 'A%' AND m.country = 'US' AND c.category_desc LIKE 'Service%' GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name, m.country HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 1301236.32 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 102 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank, region_charge_total;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.member_no IN ( SELECT m.member_no FROM member m WHERE m.curr_balance >= 1788.59 ) AND ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 14854.99 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.member_no IN ( SELECT m.member_no FROM member m WHERE m.curr_balance >= 6720.19 ) AND ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 68931.11 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, r.region_no, r.region_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 6138.98 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((c.category_no, c.category_desc, r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), ()) ORDER BY c.category_no, r.region_no;

SELECT c.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM charge c JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 11.45 AND p.payment_amt > 4067.85 GROUP BY c.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 28719.7 INTERSECT SELECT c.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM charge c JOIN member m ON c.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 9986.82 AND r.region_no = 8 GROUP BY c.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 23499.34;

SELECT c.member_no, c.lastname, c.firstname, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_charge) FROM ( SELECT AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, MAX(ch.charge_amt) AS max_charge FROM charge ch WHERE ch.member_no = c.member_no AND ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY ch.category_no ) sub ) AS peak_charge FROM member c WHERE c.region_no = 4 GROUP BY c.member_no, c.lastname, c.firstname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charge ch2 WHERE ch2.member_no = c.member_no AND ch2.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY ch2.provider_no)) > 5 ORDER BY peak_charge DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, COUNT(s.statement_no) AS statement_count FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 8450.98 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 24687.32 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(c.charge_no) AS charge_count FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt >= 7175.25 AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 18057.63 UNION ALL SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(p.payment_no) AS payment_count FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt >= 4056.21 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 34195.06 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS payment_count_since_date, (SELECT SUM(c.charge_amt) FROM charge c WHERE c.member_no = m.member_no AND c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS total_charges_since_date FROM member m WHERE m.curr_balance > 1674.31 AND m.country = 'A' ORDER BY m.curr_balance DESC;

SELECT m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.curr_balance, m2.prev_balance, (m1.curr_balance - m2.prev_balance) AS balance_change FROM member m1 JOIN member m2 ON m1.member_no = m2.member_no AND m1.region_no = m2.region_no AND m1.curr_balance > 9955.21 AND m2.prev_balance < 2281.21 JOIN region r ON m1.region_no = r.region_no WHERE m1.curr_balance > m2.prev_balance AND r.region_no = 3 GROUP BY m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.curr_balance, m2.prev_balance HAVING AVG(m1.curr_balance) > 4606.44 ORDER BY balance_change DESC;

SELECT r.region_name AS region, c.category_desc AS category, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM region r JOIN provider pv ON r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN charge ch ON pv.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 52092.46 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 82950.96 UNION ALL SELECT r.region_name AS region, 'All Categories' AS category, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 82406.98 GROUP BY r.region_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 804117.95 ORDER BY region, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE (ch.charge_amt > 674.7 OR p.payment_amt < 873.51) AND NOT (m.curr_balance <= 14.13 AND s.statement_amt >= 3057.58) AND (ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' OR s.statement_dt <= '2020-01-01') GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 39401.97 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) < 94 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 9204.88 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > ( SELECT AVG(payment_amt) FROM payment WHERE payment_dt >= '2019-01-01' ) ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 15557.11 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.member_no, SUM(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no) AS region_category_total, AVG(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no) AS region_avg_charge FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6583.15 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, ch.charge_amt ORDER BY region_category_total DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, AVG(pay.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, MAX(s.statement_amt) AS max_statement, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_prev_balance, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_curr_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name, c.category_desc) AS region_category_total FROM region r INNER JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no INNER JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no INNER JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no INNER JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND m.member_no = pay.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7977.71 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND p.provider_name IS NOT NULL AND m.curr_balance > 68586.93 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 81940.6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 85 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_name, category_desc;

SELECT r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.provider_no) AS unique_providers, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS balance_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 1427.1 AND m.curr_balance < -20168.97 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM charge c2 JOIN statement s2 ON c2.statement_no = s2.statement_no WHERE c2.member_no = m.member_no AND c2.charge_amt > 570.71 AND s2.statement_amt > 2169.0 ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 20509.85 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) >= 38 AND (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) > 7663.14 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, balance_rank;

SELECT r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, c.charge_amt, cat.category_desc, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01') AS payment_count FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 993909.57 GROUP BY r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, c.charge_amt, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 2793.52 ORDER BY m.curr_balance DESC, payment_count ASC;

SELECT r.region_no, c.category_no, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_curr_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_activity, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(s.statement_amt) DESC) AS statement_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE (ch.charge_amt > 5509.48 OR p.payment_amt > 2626.62) AND (s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' OR s.due_dt >= '2020-01-01') AND NOT (m.country = 'USA' AND m.state_prov IN ('CA', 'NY')) AND (ch.charge_code = 'A' OR ch.charge_code = 'B' OR ch.charge_code = 'C') AND (pr.provider_code = 'X' OR pr.provider_code = 'Y') AND (c.category_code = 'Z' OR c.category_code = 'W') GROUP BY r.region_no, c.category_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 88719.71 AND (SUM(p.payment_amt) > 46278.85 OR AVG(m.prev_balance) < -202.38) AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 60 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments ASC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, (SELECT AVG(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS avg_recent_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 283.88 AND s.statement_amt >= 1656.13 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 7 ORDER BY member_count DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND cat.category_code = 'A' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 978131.8 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON p.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 7361.03 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 302927.12 ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amt FROM region r LEFT JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no LEFT JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' OR s.statement_dt IS NULL GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) < 4925 ORDER BY total_statement_amt DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 541.39 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 3326.08 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 1396.1 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_current_balance, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_previous_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(s.statement_amt) DESC) AS statement_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1072.28 AND s.statement_amt > 43055.78 AND p.payment_amt > 4845.2 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND r.region_no IN (48, 24, 25) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 925367.05 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 822 AND SUM(s.statement_amt) > 776388.26 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, total_statement_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no LEFT JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9388.38 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (co.corp_code = 'A' OR m.member_code = 'A' OR co.corp_code IS NULL) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 29127.88 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7963.33 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 137169.93 AND COUNT(ch.charge_no) >= 282 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_curr_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(*) AS total_records FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 903208.75 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), () ) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 5710590.42 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(st.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.statement_no) AS statements_with_payments, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region_category, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY MIN(ch.charge_dt)) AS prev_member_charge_total FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN charge ch ON st.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN payment p ON st.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3593.11 AND st.statement_amt > 2771.61 AND p.payment_amt > 387.43 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND st.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 86992.34 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 35454.38 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) > 82 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE (ch.charge_amt > 4687.95 OR p.payment_amt < 3980.2) AND (s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' OR s.due_dt <= '2020-01-01') AND NOT (m.curr_balance < 674.17 AND m.prev_balance > -771.42) AND (cat.category_no = 78 OR pr.provider_no = 817) AND (r.region_no = 23 OR c.corp_no = 7377) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 37269.42 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 87 AND (SUM(p.payment_amt) < 7362.54 OR AVG(s.statement_amt) > 7275.64) ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 6511.61 AND s.statement_amt > 39291.13 AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 50304.39 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 78 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 7675.24 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) > 19772.26 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt) AS prev_member_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4826.38 AND s.statement_amt BETWEEN 35513.05 AND 180957.3 AND (m.lastname LIKE 'A%' OR m.firstname LIKE 'A%') AND ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, ch.charge_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 35553.35 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 5 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, region_charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, s.due_dt, ch.charge_no, ch.charge_amt, ch.charge_dt, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, p.payment_no, p.payment_amt, p.payment_dt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt) AS running_member_charges, COUNT(p.payment_no) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no, s.statement_no) AS payments_per_statement, AVG(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY cat.category_no, r.region_no) AS avg_category_charge_by_region, CASE WHEN s.statement_amt > 14408.04 AND s.due_dt < '2020-01-01' THEN 'High Amount Past Due' WHEN s.statement_amt BETWEEN 1219.54 AND 2346.43 AND s.due_dt >= '2020-01-01' THEN 'Medium Amount On Time' WHEN s.statement_amt < 4.69 THEN 'Low Amount' ELSE 'Standard' END AS statement_risk_category, CASE WHEN m.curr_balance - m.prev_balance > 2401.95 THEN 'Balance Increased' WHEN m.curr_balance - m.prev_balance < -4616.15 THEN 'Balance Decreased' ELSE 'Balance Stable' END AS member_balance_trend, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS distinct_charges, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS latest_statement_date FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE s.statement_dt >= '2019-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt >= '2019-01-01' AND (m.curr_balance > 50506.66 OR m.prev_balance > 92223.11) AND ch.charge_amt > 3341.38 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, s.due_dt, ch.charge_no, ch.charge_amt, ch.charge_dt, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, p.payment_no, p.payment_amt, p.payment_dt, m.curr_balance, m.prev_balance HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 7822.76 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 82 ORDER BY total_payments DESC, avg_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) FILTER (WHERE ch.charge_code = 'A') AS charge_code_A_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, LAG(SUM(pay.payment_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY MAX(s.statement_dt)) AS prev_member_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND m.member_no = pay.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5039.82 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND p.provider_no > 1653 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 39695.79 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) >= 80 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 932.89 AND c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 3050.23 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, AVG(COALESCE(s.statement_amt, 0)) AS avg_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pv ON c.provider_no = pv.provider_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (pv.region_no = 45 OR pv.region_no IS NULL) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 716880.44 UNION ALL SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, NULL::integer AS member_no, NULL::character varying AS lastname, NULL::character varying AS firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, 0::numeric AS total_payments, 0::bigint AS statement_count, 0::numeric AS avg_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pv ON c.provider_no = pv.provider_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND pv.provider_no IN (SELECT provider_no FROM provider WHERE region_no = 76) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) > 694 ORDER BY region_no, charge_rank_in_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charge ch WHERE ch.member_no = m.member_no AND ch.charge_amt > 8484.52) AS high_charge_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no AND s.statement_no = ch.statement_no WHERE m.curr_balance >= 46246.86 AND s.due_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 5403.9 ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, MAX(ch.charge_amt) AS max_charge_amt, MIN(ch.charge_amt) AS min_charge_amt, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.category_no) AS distinct_categories_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS distinct_payments_made, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance_delta, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(m.curr_balance, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt) AS prev_balance_before_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 2689.49 AND m.curr_balance > 96312.13 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, ch.charge_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 86335.93 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.category_no) >= 9 AND AVG(ch.charge_amt) < 2001.16 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC, m.member_no;

COALESCE(p.payment_amt, 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.statement_amt) DESC) AS statement_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.category_no) AS category_dense_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_row FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7880.22 AND p.payment_amt > 269.79 AND s.statement_amt > 77.56 GROUP BY c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_no, m.region_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 23905.36 AND COUNT(*) > 110.59 INTERSECT SELECT c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, COUNT(s.statement_no) AS statement_count, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge, MAX(p.payment_dt) AS latest_payment, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS latest_statement, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, SUM(ch.charge_amt - COALESCE(p.payment_amt, 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.statement_amt) DESC) AS statement_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.category_no) AS category_dense_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_row FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_no, m.region_no HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 83416.28 AND COUNT(p.payment_no) > 623.07 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC, total_statements DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN payment p ON ch.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2248.91 AND p.payment_amt > 2973.8 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 1037.83 INTERSECT SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN payment p ON ch.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2018-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2018-12-31' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) < 7631.47 ORDER BY avg_charge DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, c.category_code, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4560.67 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -4089.92 AND r.region_no = 9 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc, c.category_code HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 4786.74 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, c.category_code, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_dt, MIN(ch.charge_dt) AS earliest_charge_dt FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN region r ON co.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3112.59 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -5833.44 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc, c.category_code HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 33994.13 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 124 UNION ALL SELECT p.provider_no, p.provider_name, p.provider_code, SUM(ch2.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch2.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch2.member_no) AS unique_members, MAX(ch2.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_dt, MIN(ch2.charge_dt) AS earliest_charge_dt FROM provider p JOIN charge ch2 ON p.provider_no = ch2.provider_no JOIN member m2 ON ch2.member_no = m2.member_no JOIN corporation co2 ON m2.corp_no = co2.corp_no JOIN region r2 ON co2.region_no = r2.region_no WHERE ch2.charge_amt > 1675.74 AND ch2.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch2.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND m2.curr_balance < -749.56 GROUP BY p.provider_no, p.provider_name, p.provider_code HAVING SUM(ch2.charge_amt) > 99486.17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch2.member_no) >= 6 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.member_no, c.lastname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_count FROM member c JOIN charge ch ON c.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no JOIN region r ON pv.region_no = r.region_no JOIN payment p ON c.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON p.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY c.member_no, c.lastname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 497499.7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 43 INTERSECT SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, AVG(p2.payment_amt) AS avg_payment2, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statements_count2 FROM member m JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN payment p2 ON s.statement_no = p2.statement_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r2 ON corp.region_no = r2.region_no WHERE s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p2.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND corp.corp_code = 'A' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname HAVING SUM(s.statement_amt) > 406978.18 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) >= 9 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c1.member_no, c1.category_no, SUM(c1.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM charge c1 JOIN category cat ON c1.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c1.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND c1.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY c1.member_no, c1.category_no HAVING SUM(c1.charge_amt) > 114710.53 INTERSECT SELECT p1.member_no, c2.category_no, SUM(c2.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM payment p1 JOIN statement s ON p1.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN charge c2 ON s.member_no = c2.member_no WHERE p1.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND p1.payment_dt <= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY p1.member_no, c2.category_no HAVING SUM(c2.charge_amt) > 33391.95 ORDER BY member_no, category_no;

SELECT c1.member_no, c1.category_no, SUM(c1.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM charge c1 JOIN category cat ON c1.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c1.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND c1.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY c1.member_no, c1.category_no HAVING SUM(c1.charge_amt) > 830383.09 INTERSECT SELECT p1.member_no, c2.category_no, SUM(c2.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM payment p1 JOIN statement s ON p1.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN charge c2 ON s.member_no = c2.member_no WHERE p1.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND p1.payment_dt <= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY p1.member_no, c2.category_no HAVING SUM(c2.charge_amt) > 245055.0 ORDER BY member_no, category_no;

SELECT m.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 8519.14 AND c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charges, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payments, COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance FROM member m LEFT JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM member WHERE curr_balance > 3424.26 ) AND (c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' OR c.charge_dt IS NULL) AND (p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' OR p.payment_dt IS NULL) GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) > -4711.03 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(SUM(c.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no) AS avg_region_charges FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 9321.19 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.region_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 41436.53 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS charge_count FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 3529.07 AND c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND m.member_no IN (SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 2642.22 AND payment_dt >= '1992-01-01') GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 37625.32 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.city, m.state_prov, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SELECT AVG(sub_avg.avg_charge) FROM ( SELECT AVG(c_inner.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM charge c_inner WHERE c_inner.member_no = m.member_no GROUP BY c_inner.provider_no ) AS sub_avg ) AS avg_charge_per_provider FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.city, m.state_prov HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 39465.63 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.city, m.state_prov, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(p.payment_no) AS payment_count FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.member_no IN (SELECT s.member_no FROM statement s WHERE s.statement_amt > 63522.57) GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.city, m.state_prov ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt FROM member m LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_no IS NULL AND m.curr_balance > 370.89 AND m.issue_dt >= '2020-01-01' ORDER BY m.member_no;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, MAX(s.statement_amt) AS max_statement, MIN(s.due_dt) AS earliest_due_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name) AS region_total_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 73250.59 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 3190085.62 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) >= 87 ORDER BY region_total_charge DESC, charge_rank LIMIT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.category_desc) FROM category c WHERE c.category_code = 'A');

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name) AS avg_region_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3025.15 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 38666.93 ORDER BY r.region_name, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 1660.38 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM member WHERE curr_balance > 4923.96 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 46945.28 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, c.corp_no, cat.category_no, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_year, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3142.54 AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2020-01-01' AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 1663.7 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, c.corp_no, cat.category_no, statement_year), (r.region_no, c.corp_no, cat.category_no), (r.region_no, c.corp_no), (r.region_no), () ) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 11941.3 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, cat.category_no, statement_year;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS distinct_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS distinct_payments, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM region r JOIN provider pr ON r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN charge c ON pr.provider_no = c.provider_no JOIN payment p ON c.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 75130.67 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m2.member_no) FROM member m2 WHERE m2.region_no = r.region_no AND m2.prev_balance > 739.81) AS high_balance_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge c ON p.provider_no = c.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN member m ON c.member_no = m.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 2667.76 AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 35044.56 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT c.member_no) AS distinct_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge c ON p.provider_no = c.provider_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 12908.03 UNION ALL SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.member_no) AS distinct_members FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no WHERE pm.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(pm.payment_amt) > 742271.77 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT c.member_no) AS distinct_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge c ON p.provider_no = c.provider_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 676967.91 UNION ALL SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.member_no) AS distinct_members FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no WHERE pm.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(pm.payment_amt) > 724669.21 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_charge, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND co.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 923.38 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, ch.charge_dt, ch.charge_amt ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_desc, ch.charge_dt;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_year, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('2020-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= TO_DATE('2020-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ch.charge_amt > 7307.85 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 78470.77 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 29 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment, MAX(s.statement_amt) AS max_statement, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN provider pv ON r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN charge ch ON pv.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation cp ON m.corp_no = cp.corp_no AND m.region_no = cp.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 7174.2 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 928632.78 UNION ALL SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, 'ALL_CATEGORIES' AS category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment, MAX(s.statement_amt) AS max_statement, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3696.24 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 958515.46 ORDER BY region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8909.39 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 8085.51 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 566.4 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 4476.33 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_current_balance, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_previous_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(s.statement_amt) DESC) AS statement_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9986.82 AND s.statement_amt > 26188.54 AND p.payment_amt > 35056.82 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND r.region_no IN (2, 38, 75) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 748137.01 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 959 AND SUM(s.statement_amt) > 929864.43 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, total_statement_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS distinct_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS distinct_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, COUNT(DISTINCT co.corp_no) AS distinct_corporations, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_curr_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8824.26 AND p.payment_amt > 1652.01 AND s.statement_amt > 8195.21 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 7101567.29 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 2297874.11 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 5855.4 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt >= 1252.8 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), () ) ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt >= 7009.68 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), () ) ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(st.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amt, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_no ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank_in_category, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no) AS region_category_total_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN payment p ON st.member_no = p.member_no AND st.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN charge ch ON st.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND st.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 7938.64 AND m.prev_balance < -566.67 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 33678.23 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) > 71 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank_in_region;
