SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_previous_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.provider_no) AS total_providers, COUNT(DISTINCT cat.category_no) AS total_categories, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r LEFT JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no LEFT JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 7664.69 AND p.payment_amt > 4769.48 AND s.statement_amt > 10200.21 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 40583.92 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 9256.82 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 49 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, total_payment_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS balance_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3646.68 AND p.payment_amt > 429.24 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 31055.11 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 7 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, balance_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) DESC) AS balance_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 5837.5 AND s.statement_amt > 42265.42 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc HAVING (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) > 13802.44 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, balance_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, s.due_dt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SELECT AVG(sub_s.statement_amt) FROM statement sub_s WHERE sub_s.member_no = m.member_no AND sub_s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND sub_s.statement_dt <= '1990-01-01') AS avg_statement_amt_member, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.category_no) AS distinct_categories_charged FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 868218.93 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND pv.region_no = r.region_no GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, s.due_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 3248535.25 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.category_no) >= 99 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank_in_region, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.member_no, c.lastname, c.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS region_rank FROM region r JOIN member c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN charge ch ON c.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON c.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 439.32 AND p.payment_amt > 2374.78 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.member_no, c.lastname, c.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) > 4394.9 ORDER BY r.region_no, region_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 395.73 AND c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 1490.8 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT s.statement_no, s.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(SUM(c.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.member_no) AS avg_member_charges FROM statement s JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 3811.5 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY s.statement_no, s.member_no ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, (SELECT MAX(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01') AS max_recent_payment FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4795.65 AND r.region_no = 19 GROUP BY c.category_desc, m.member_no HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) >= 21 ORDER BY avg_charge DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6681.56 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc UNION ALL SELECT p.provider_name, SUM(py.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM provider p JOIN payment py ON p.provider_no = py.member_no WHERE py.payment_amt > 5081.03 AND py.payment_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.provider_name ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SELECT AVG(sub_ch.charge_amt) FROM charge sub_ch WHERE sub_ch.member_no = m.member_no AND sub_ch.charge_amt > 1698.24 AND sub_ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01') AS avg_large_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND s.statement_dt BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '1990-01-01' WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4737.81 AND ch.charge_dt BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '1990-01-01' AND m.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND pv.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND corp.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.member_no, r.region_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 2453.88 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS latest_statement FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND (s.due_dt < '2023-01-01' OR s.statement_dt < '2022-01-01') AND ch.charge_amt > 8726.59 GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 15764.92 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.region_no, m.corp_no, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment, AVG(st.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' LEFT JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3059.57 AND m.member_no IN (SELECT m2.member_no FROM member m2 WHERE m2.curr_balance > 74589.13 AND m2.region_no IN (SELECT r2.region_no FROM region r2 WHERE r2.region_name LIKE 'A')) GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.region_no, m.corp_no, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 27574.15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 87 ORDER BY total_charge DESC, m.member_no;

SELECT c.charge_dt, c.charge_code, AVG(c.charge_amt) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.charge_code ORDER BY c.charge_dt ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_charge FROM charge c WHERE c.charge_amt > 3921.99 GROUP BY c.charge_dt, c.charge_code, c.charge_amt ORDER BY c.charge_dt;

SELECT c.region_no, c.region_name, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_current_balance FROM region c JOIN member m ON c.region_no = m.region_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 66336.33 GROUP BY c.region_no, c.region_name ORDER BY total_current_balance DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement FROM member m JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 7564.66 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance HAVING AVG(s.statement_amt) > 810.7 ORDER BY m.curr_balance DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amt, AVG(outer_subquery.avg_charge_per_category) AS overall_avg_charge_per_category FROM member m JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN ( SELECT c.member_no, cat.category_desc, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_per_category FROM charge c JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.member_no, cat.category_desc ) outer_subquery ON m.member_no = outer_subquery.member_no WHERE s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name HAVING SUM(s.statement_amt) > 1088.31 ORDER BY overall_avg_charge_per_category DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 41.82 AND ch.charge_amt < 3693.11 AND m.curr_balance > 420.84 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 82466.55 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 4444.78 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 16435.93 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM region r LEFT JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no AND c.corp_code = 'A' LEFT JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND m.member_code = 'A' LEFT JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no AND ch.charge_amt > 1197.27 WHERE r.region_no IN (6) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 25284.5 OR SUM(ch.charge_amt) IS NULL ORDER BY member_count DESC, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) AS statement_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS balance_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 4724.87 AND s.statement_amt > 26012.13 AND m.curr_balance > 34457.7 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 16990.53 AND (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) > 24844.46 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) > 5 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, balance_rank LIMIT 85;

SELECT r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) AS statement_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS balance_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 6152.13 AND s.statement_amt > 25877.43 AND m.curr_balance > 13386.88 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 36410.55 AND (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) > 13414.88 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) > 5 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, balance_rank LIMIT 748;

SELECT r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charge ch WHERE ch.member_no = m.member_no AND ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS recent_charges_count, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS recent_payments_sum FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN corporation c ON m.corp_no = c.corp_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 12815.55 AND m.expr_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance ORDER BY m.curr_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, p.provider_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(st.statement_amt) AS avg_statement FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN charge ch ON st.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON st.statement_no = pm.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1861.67 AND st.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, p.provider_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 46396.02 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, c.category_no, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4771.72 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, c.category_no), (r.region_no), (c.category_no), () ) ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, (SELECT AVG(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01') AS avg_payment_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 852.47 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) >= 3 ORDER BY member_count DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(SUM(c.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no) AS avg_charges_per_member FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt >= 4452.93 AND c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 2997.37 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 8264.49 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 39 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4298.86 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) < 762312.99 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 1126.59 AND r.region_no BETWEEN 79 AND 75 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 41412.32 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 207 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_member_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS members_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT p.member_no) AS members_paid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY c.category_no ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_charges_by_category FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND pr.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2424.56 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (c.category_desc LIKE '%Emergency%' OR pr.provider_name LIKE '%General%') AND r.region_name NOT LIKE '%Test%' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 14144.5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 96 ORDER BY r.region_no, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.corp_no, corp.corp_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, SUM(m.prev_balance + m.curr_balance) AS total_member_balance FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 39300.78 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.corp_no, corp.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 189814.21 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 140 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, region_no, category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region FROM region r LEFT JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no LEFT JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 1622.24 AND s.statement_amt > 8713.31 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 8872.22 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 1 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) > 11254.54 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, charge_rank_by_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS unique_providers, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 6684.0 AND s.statement_amt > 7316.19 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 49504.36 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 10 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 31094.9 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, m.prev_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance_change FROM region r INNER JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no AND c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' WHERE m.curr_balance > 2733.08 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, m.prev_balance HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) > 12 OR COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) > 76 ORDER BY net_balance_change DESC, r.region_no, m.member_no;

SELECT s.member_no, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement FROM statement s JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 9156.88 AND cat.category_no = 17 GROUP BY s.member_no HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 41 INTERSECT SELECT p.member_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment FROM payment p WHERE p.payment_amt > 4110.65 GROUP BY p.member_no HAVING COUNT(*) >= 9 ORDER BY total_statement DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (p.region_no = 34 OR p.state_prov = 'A') AND NOT (ch.charge_code = 'A') GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 185228.94 AND COUNT(*) >= 44859 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement FROM charge c JOIN member m ON c.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment p ON c.statement_no = p.statement_no AND c.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no AND c.member_no = s.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 52.78 AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 9589.26 ORDER BY total_payment DESC;

SELECT m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(c.charge_no) AS charge_count FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 5940.76 AND c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 12462.86 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) AS statement_count FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider p ON c.provider_no = p.provider_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment pmt WHERE pmt.member_no = m.member_no AND pmt.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' ) GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 4324.1 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement FROM member m JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 9118.89 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance HAVING AVG(s.statement_amt) > 1470.51 ORDER BY m.curr_balance DESC;

SELECT m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.corp_no, COUNT(DISTINCT c1.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(c1.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p1.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM member m1 JOIN member m2 ON m1.region_no = m2.region_no AND m1.member_no <> m2.member_no JOIN charge c1 ON m1.member_no = c1.member_no JOIN payment p1 ON m1.member_no = p1.member_no WHERE m1.curr_balance > 50.68 AND c1.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.corp_no HAVING SUM(c1.charge_amt) > 98738.23 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM region r INNER JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no INNER JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no INNER JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 276.9 ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE (ch.charge_amt > 9747.43 OR p.payment_amt < 29.84) AND NOT (m.curr_balance <= 2384.14 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01') AND (r.region_no = 3 OR c.category_no = 2) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 17449.37 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 90 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_payment) FROM ( SELECT p.member_no, MAX(p.payment_amt) AS max_payment FROM payment p WHERE p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY p.member_no HAVING MAX(p.payment_amt) > 625.04 ) sub WHERE sub.member_no IN (SELECT m2.member_no FROM member m2 WHERE m2.region_no = r.region_no) ) AS max_payment_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND s.statement_amt > 52244.91 AND pr.provider_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, r.region_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 700208.26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 55 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, r.region_name, c.category_desc;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT p.member_no) AS distinct_members_paid, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name, c.category_desc ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN provider pr ON r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN charge ch ON pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7820.01 AND p.payment_amt > 9558.31 AND s.statement_amt > 1533.76 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, r.region_no, c.category_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 908728.87 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 83147.5 ORDER BY total_charges DESC LIMIT 962;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, p.provider_name, cat.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, (SELECT SUM(pm.payment_amt) FROM payment pm WHERE pm.member_no = m.member_no AND pm.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS recent_payments, (SELECT MAX(s.statement_amt) FROM statement s WHERE s.member_no = m.member_no AND s.statement_dt <= '1992-01-01') AS max_statement_amount, SUM(m.curr_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS running_balance_by_region FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no AND p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 57531.05 AND m.curr_balance < -66015.68 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, m.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 617123.65 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member m2 WHERE m2.region_no = r.region_no AND m2.curr_balance > 6784.5) AS members_with_high_balance, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p JOIN member m3 ON p.member_no = m3.member_no WHERE m3.region_no = r.region_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS recent_payments_sum FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pv ON c.provider_no = pv.provider_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND c.charge_amt >= 4828.41 AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 574373.16 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 9641.99 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT p.member_no FROM payment p WHERE p.payment_amt > 4959.78 AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, MAX(s.statement_amt) AS max_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_rank_by_charges FROM region r LEFT JOIN corporation cor ON r.region_no = cor.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON cor.corp_no = m.corp_no OR (m.corp_no IS NULL AND cor.corp_no IS NULL AND r.region_no = m.region_no) LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no INNER JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no INNER JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no LEFT JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 1598.49 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 81096.26 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND p.payment_amt > 189.22 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 82733.17 ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 6320.99 AND s.statement_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT p.member_no FROM payment p WHERE p.payment_amt > 2588.0 ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(s.statement_amt) > 40267.15 ORDER BY total_statement_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2759.99 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 4086.12 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statement_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ch.charge_code = 'A' THEN ch.charge_amt ELSE 0 END) AS total_charge_code_a, SUM(CASE WHEN ch.charge_code = 'B' THEN ch.charge_amt ELSE 0 END) AS total_charge_code_b FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5024.4 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 246.59 ORDER BY avg_charge_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount FROM region r INNER JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND s.due_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 49702.44 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 88371.62 ORDER BY member_count DESC, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 1352.73 AND s.statement_amt > 12378.45 AND p.payment_amt > 857.2 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 31113.6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 43 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 17360.66 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) > 23306.64 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 5349.98 AND s.statement_amt > 13945.89 AND p.payment_amt > 803.85 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 82692.64 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 8 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 16491.99 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) > 29600.73 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS unique_providers, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 8397.44 AND s.statement_amt > 39297.03 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 26806.18 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 10 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 40606.16 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank_in_corp FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 4370.57 AND s.statement_amt > 24396.74 AND p.payment_amt > 24994.16 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 14127.54 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 16382.87 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) > 12.06 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank_in_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, m.prev_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance_change FROM region r INNER JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no AND c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' WHERE m.curr_balance > 9599.66 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, m.prev_balance HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) > 92 OR COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) > 20 ORDER BY net_balance_change DESC, r.region_no, m.member_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.country, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, MAX(CASE WHEN s.statement_amt > (SELECT AVG(s2.statement_amt) FROM statement s2 WHERE s2.member_no IN (SELECT m2.member_no FROM member m2 WHERE m2.region_no = r.region_no)) THEN s.statement_amt ELSE NULL END) AS max_above_avg_statement, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no AND c.corp_no IS NOT NULL JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND m.member_no IS NOT NULL JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND s.statement_no IS NOT NULL JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND ch.charge_no IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND p.payment_no IS NOT NULL WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 4219.58 AND m.curr_balance < -8827.07 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM provider pr WHERE pr.region_no = r.region_no AND pr.expr_dt > '1990-01-01') > 4.43 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.country HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > (SELECT AVG(total_charge) FROM (SELECT SUM(ch2.charge_amt) AS total_charge FROM charge ch2 JOIN statement s2 ON ch2.statement_no = s2.statement_no WHERE s2.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY s2.member_no) AS sub) AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 742.04 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_members ASC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charges, COALESCE(SUM(pm.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payments, COALESCE(AVG(s.statement_amt), 0) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS active_members, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) DESC) AS provider_rank_in_region FROM region r INNER JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no INNER JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no INNER JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.member_no = s.member_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON s.statement_no = pm.statement_no AND s.member_no = pm.member_no INNER JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no LEFT JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no AND m.region_no = co.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND (pm.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' OR pm.payment_dt IS NULL) AND s.due_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 1849.99 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) > 38921.9 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 29 ORDER BY r.region_no, provider_rank_in_region, total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.charge_dt, c.charge_amt, AVG(c.charge_amt) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY c.charge_dt::DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_charge FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 901.31 AND c.charge_dt::DATE >= '2020-01-01'::DATE AND cat.category_no = 32 ORDER BY m.member_no, c.charge_dt;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2743.98 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 8443.39 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 7080.78 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM region r LEFT JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no AND c.corp_code = 'A' LEFT JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND m.member_code = 'A' LEFT JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no AND ch.charge_amt > 3590.33 WHERE r.region_no IN (6) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 48564.84 OR SUM(ch.charge_amt) IS NULL ORDER BY member_count DESC, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6654.63 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 72.86 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4995.01 AND p.payment_amt > 2228.6 AND r.region_no = 9 GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > (SELECT AVG(charge_amt) FROM charge WHERE charge_amt > 3066.95) ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, p.provider_name, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 5010.76 AND m.curr_balance < 51635.03 AND r.region_no = 89 GROUP BY c.category_desc, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 46958.27 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, COUNT(*) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE c.category_desc LIKE '%Service%' AND p.provider_name LIKE '%Medical%' GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name) AS region_charge_total, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name)) / STDDEV(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name) AS charge_zscore FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation cr ON m.corp_no = cr.corp_no AND m.region_no = cr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no AND ch.statement_no = pm.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND p.provider_name LIKE 'A%' AND m.country = 'US' AND c.category_desc LIKE 'Service%' GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name, m.country HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 5618666.4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 475 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank, region_charge_total;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.region_no, m.corp_no, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment, AVG(st.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' LEFT JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 5086.34 AND m.member_no IN (SELECT m2.member_no FROM member m2 WHERE m2.curr_balance > 91783.55 AND m2.region_no IN (SELECT r2.region_no FROM region r2 WHERE r2.region_name LIKE 'A')) GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.region_no, m.corp_no, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 5548.61 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 57 ORDER BY total_charge DESC, m.member_no;

SELECT r.region_name, m.country, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.statement_no) AS statements_with_payments, SUM(st.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN charge ch ON st.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON st.statement_no = pm.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 82343.77 AND st.statement_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND st.due_dt <= '2000-01-01' AND pm.payment_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, m.country, c.category_desc, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 518120.78 AND SUM(pm.payment_amt) > 975792.57 INTERSECT SELECT r.region_name, m.country, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.statement_no) AS statements_with_payments, SUM(st.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN charge ch ON st.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON st.statement_no = pm.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 54926.34 AND st.statement_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND st.due_dt <= '2000-01-01' AND pm.payment_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, m.country, c.category_desc, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 497678.47 AND SUM(pm.payment_amt) > 305839.58 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) DESC) AS balance_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt) AS prev_charge_sum FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 982927.95 AND s.statement_amt > 314069.5 GROUP BY r.region_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc, m.member_no, ch.charge_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 383716.34 ORDER BY r.region_name, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, m.state_prov, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, CASE WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) > 0 THEN 'Debt' WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) < 0 THEN 'Credit' ELSE 'Balanced' END AS financial_status FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, m.state_prov, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 660.18 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m2.member_no) FROM member m2 WHERE m2.region_no = r.region_no AND m2.prev_balance > 2680.5) AS high_balance_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge c ON p.provider_no = c.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN member m ON c.member_no = m.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 1120.28 AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 96298.71 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1982.49 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.country, m.state_prov, pr.provider_name, co.corp_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, m.country ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region_country, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no) AS avg_category_charge_per_region, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) FILTER (WHERE ch.charge_amt > 30102.79) AS high_charge_members, MAX(SUM(p.payment_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY m.corp_no) AS max_payment_by_corporation FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no AND m.region_no = co.region_no JOIN provider pr ON r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no AND pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.country, m.state_prov, pr.provider_name, co.corp_name, c.category_no, m.corp_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 21549.05 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) > 17 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_curr_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(*) AS total_records FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 714190.13 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), () ) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 1417639.91 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, MAX(ch.charge_amt) AS max_charge_amount, MIN(p.payment_amt) AS min_payment_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region FROM region r INNER JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 6947.89 AND p.payment_amt < 345.67 AND s.statement_amt BETWEEN 16605.79 AND 22160.74 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 27324.04 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 55 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) > 7357.41 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, charge_rank_by_region LIMIT 980;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS provider_count FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4471.05 AND s.statement_amt >= 29567.25 AND p.payment_amt <= 42579.47 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 15989.88 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 12 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT pmt.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(pmt.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT st.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(st.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(pmt.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region FROM region r INNER JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON st.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment pmt ON st.statement_no = pmt.statement_no AND m.member_no = pmt.member_no LEFT JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no LEFT JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7736.31 AND st.statement_amt > 6072.32 AND pmt.payment_amt > 2828.04 AND m.curr_balance > 354.92 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND st.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND pmt.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, p.provider_no, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 42898.87 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 1 AND SUM(pmt.payment_amt) > 47391.21 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, charge_rank_by_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.country, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, (SELECT MAX(sub_c.charge_amt) FROM charge sub_c WHERE sub_c.category_no = cat.category_no AND sub_c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND sub_c.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01') AS max_category_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 1347.36 AND p.payment_amt > 1085.59 AND s.statement_amt > 5128.02 AND m.curr_balance < -2512.55 AND pr.region_no = r.region_no GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.country, cat.category_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 9548.1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 432 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_members ASC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt >= 6265.82 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) > 226 INTERSECT SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt >= 38896.38 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) > 203 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(SUM(c.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no) AS avg_region_charges FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 1163.02 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.region_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 20019.07 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1998-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1998-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) > 2918.41 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_charge FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 4851.36 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, c.category_no, ch.charge_dt, ch.charge_amt ORDER BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, ch.charge_dt;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) FROM member m WHERE m.region_no = r.region_no) AS member_count_in_region FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4073.01 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, r.region_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 28127.12 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1374.7 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 16798.93 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_rank FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 585135.88 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, p.provider_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(st.statement_amt) AS avg_statement FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN charge ch ON st.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON st.statement_no = pm.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4494.52 AND st.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, p.provider_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 12985.48 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, (SELECT AVG(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01') AS avg_payment_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 578.67 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) >= 8 ORDER BY member_count DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS provider_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9408.2 AND s.statement_amt >= 38729.97 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 33575.8 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 8306.81 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 44 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;
