SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_corp FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2020-12-31' AND cat.category_code = 'A' AND pv.provider_code = 'P' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 603821.13 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 67 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 192176.88 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov AS member_state, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(pm.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, m.state_prov ORDER BY c.category_no) AS prev_category_charges FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON s.statement_no = pm.statement_no AND m.member_no = pm.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' OR s.due_dt IS NULL) AND ch.charge_amt > 565852.68 AND pm.payment_amt < 606447.14 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.statement_dt::DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ch.charge_dt::DATE) <= 8 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, c.category_desc, c.category_no, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 8135745.06 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 116 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC, charge_count DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charge, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_curr_balance, SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_activity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 1035.76 AND p.payment_amt > 3321.37 AND s.statement_amt > 2433.25 AND m.curr_balance > 6911.99 AND pr.region_no = r.region_no GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 6003.68 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 17980.25 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) > 963 ORDER BY total_charge DESC, member_count DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, p.provider_name, r.region_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.country, m.state_prov, m.city, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(py.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(st.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT py.statement_no) AS statements_with_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(py.payment_amt) AS net_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(py.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_dense_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.country, m.state_prov ORDER BY m.city) AS prev_city_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN statement st ON ch.statement_no = st.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment py ON ch.member_no = py.member_no AND ch.statement_no = py.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6022.92 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND st.statement_amt > 25026.15 AND py.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -6383.24 GROUP BY c.category_desc, p.provider_name, r.region_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.country, m.state_prov, m.city HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 43489.64 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) > 48 ORDER BY net_amount DESC, charge_rank_by_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount FROM region r INNER JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND s.due_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 69808.7 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 1639.52 ORDER BY member_count DESC, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r INNER JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no INNER JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no INNER JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no INNER JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 234.29 AND s.statement_amt > 24996.08 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 35765.06 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 81 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank ASC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, MAX(ch.charge_amt) AS max_charge_amt, MIN(ch.charge_amt) AS min_charge_amt, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.category_no) AS distinct_categories_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS distinct_payments_made, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance_delta, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(m.curr_balance, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt) AS prev_balance_before_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 6383.84 AND m.curr_balance > 24907.4 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, ch.charge_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 80975.83 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.category_no) >= 5 AND AVG(ch.charge_amt) < 2197.61 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC, m.member_no;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment_amt, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, SUM(ch2.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt_self_join, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_member_balance, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member m2 WHERE m2.region_no = r.region_no AND m2.expr_dt >= '1995-01-01') AS active_members_in_region FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch2 ON ch.member_no = ch2.member_no AND ch.category_no = ch2.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4450.84 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 82213.68 GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 14474.67 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, m.region_no, m.corp_no, p.region_no, p.provider_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge, AVG(pay.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, MAX(s.statement_amt) AS max_statement_amt, MIN(s.due_dt) AS earliest_due_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_desc ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(pay.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no, m.corp_no) AS member_count_per_corp FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment pay ON m.member_no = pay.member_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND pay.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN corporation cor ON m.corp_no = cor.corp_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no AND p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.statement_dt::DATE) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ch.charge_dt::DATE) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.statement_dt::DATE) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ch.charge_dt::DATE) + 1 GROUP BY c.category_desc, m.region_no, m.corp_no, p.region_no, p.provider_name, r.region_name, cor.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 613602.76 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 89 ORDER BY total_charge DESC, avg_payment ASC;

SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(pm.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(pm.payment_amt), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0), 2) AS payment_coverage_percent, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ch.provider_no ORDER BY MIN(ch.charge_dt)) AS prev_provider_charge_total FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation cr ON m.corp_no = cr.corp_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON s.statement_no = pm.statement_no AND s.member_no = pm.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt < '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_amt > 58026.73 AND ch.charge_amt BETWEEN 6895.98 AND 2585.73 AND p.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name, r.region_no, ch.provider_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 775977.19 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 55 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, region_charge_rank;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE m.member_no IN ( SELECT s.member_no FROM statement s WHERE s.statement_amt > 4827.83 AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' ) AND c.charge_amt > 986.33 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 26611.64 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(c.charge_no) AS charge_count, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, MAX(c.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 4135.95 AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 16433.0 UNION ALL SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(p.payment_no) AS payment_count, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, MAX(p.payment_dt) AS latest_payment_date FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 664.96 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 3565.63 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, member_no;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1995-01-01') AS total_recent_payments, (SELECT AVG(s.statement_amt) FROM statement s WHERE s.member_no = m.member_no AND s.statement_dt >= '1995-01-01') AS avg_recent_statement FROM member m JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation c ON m.corp_no = c.corp_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 1588.98 AND r.region_name = 'North America' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance ORDER BY m.curr_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name) AS avg_region_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9088.84 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 25251.89 ORDER BY r.region_name, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8468.12 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 20520.04 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 602.9 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 17553.28 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(DISTINCT c.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 7733.86 AND c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS members_with_charges FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 9573.89 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 44389.6 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(*) AS total_charges, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = ch.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS member_recent_payments FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3874.02 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, ch.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 417745.71 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5665.85 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), ()) ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_member_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS charged_member_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.member_no) AS paying_member_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_per_corp FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2010-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2010-01-01' AND s.due_dt >= '2010-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2010-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 8999.41 AND (p.payment_amt IS NULL OR p.payment_amt > 69.07) AND m.curr_balance < -1385.44 AND m.prev_balance < -8110.3 AND pr.expr_dt > '2025-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 45355.92 AND (SUM(p.payment_amt) IS NULL OR SUM(p.payment_amt) < 8931.94) AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) > 56 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, cat.category_no, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.statement_no) AS statements_with_payments, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date, MIN(p.payment_dt) AS earliest_payment_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS net_balance_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5835.71 AND (p.payment_amt IS NULL OR p.payment_amt > 3013.13) AND (s.statement_amt IS NULL OR s.statement_amt >= 3894.44) AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (p.payment_dt IS NULL OR p.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01') AND cat.category_code = 'A' AND pr.provider_code = 'A' AND m.curr_balance BETWEEN 7498.1 AND 3302.23 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 27650.76 AND (SUM(p.payment_amt) IS NULL OR SUM(p.payment_amt) < 20030.67) AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 22 ORDER BY r.region_no, net_balance DESC, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS provider_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7048.76 AND s.statement_amt >= 24324.35 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 85818.84 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 57680.67 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 14 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, COUNT(s.statement_no) AS statement_count, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge, MAX(p.payment_dt) AS latest_payment, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS latest_statement, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, SUM(ch.charge_amt - COALESCE(p.payment_amt, 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.statement_amt) DESC) AS statement_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.category_no) AS category_dense_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_row FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5389.41 AND p.payment_amt > 246.64 AND s.statement_amt > 8366.78 GROUP BY c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_no, m.region_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 50945.37 AND COUNT(*) > 619.12 INTERSECT SELECT c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, COUNT(s.statement_no) AS statement_count, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge, MAX(p.payment_dt) AS latest_payment, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS latest_statement, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, SUM(ch.charge_amt - COALESCE(p.payment_amt, 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.statement_amt) DESC) AS statement_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.category_no) AS category_dense_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_row FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_no, m.region_no HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 69468.52 AND COUNT(p.payment_no) > 878.9 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC, total_statements DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, pr.provider_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS unique_statements FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 2661.79 GROUP BY c.category_desc, pr.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 40632.9 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt FROM category c LEFT JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) < 4752.62 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.member_no IN (SELECT m.member_no FROM member m WHERE m.curr_balance > 5787.87) GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 8420.4 AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 33847.51 INTERSECT SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 4010.1 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 48983.94 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.country, m.state_prov, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charge, COUNT(c.charge_no) AS charge_count FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider p ON c.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 8920.93 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.country, m.state_prov HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 13136.25 ORDER BY total_charge DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS unique_members, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no AND co.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND m.country = 'US' JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no AND ch.charge_dt BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt > '2019-01-01' WHERE (c.category_code = 'A' OR c.category_code = 'A') AND NOT (m.curr_balance < -818.92 OR m.prev_balance > 542.8) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 704988.74 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) <= 32 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 8912.29 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM charge ch2 WHERE ch2.member_no = m.member_no AND ch2.charge_amt > 1520.45 AND ch2.charge_dt >= '2019-01-01' ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 21222.49 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 4 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01') AND c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 9988.52 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 190499.3 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9528.71 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 55.8 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 405.73 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 1709.8 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS current_balance_sum, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS previous_balance_sum, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region FROM region r LEFT JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no LEFT JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 304.65 AND s.statement_amt BETWEEN 10817.62 AND 132980.08 AND p.payment_amt >= 3414.72 AND m.curr_balance < -1645.48 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 5041.57 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 36 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) BETWEEN 20033.78 AND 61064.64 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, charge_rank_by_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r INNER JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no INNER JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no INNER JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no INNER JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 8494.23 AND s.statement_amt > 3705.94 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 7976.82 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 93 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank ASC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.statement_no) AS statements_with_payments, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS balance_rank_in_corp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS global_balance_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND (p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' OR p.payment_dt IS NULL) AND ch.charge_amt > 4551.6 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 43977.99 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4959.83 AND s.statement_amt >= 42461.95 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 53329.84 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 87049.69 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 44 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) BETWEEN 3318.21 AND 13034.05 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank LIMIT 865;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS distinct_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT chg.charge_no) AS distinct_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT cat.category_no) AS distinct_categories, COUNT(DISTINCT chg.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, SUM(chg.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, MAX(chg.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date, MIN(p.payment_dt) AS earliest_payment_date, SUM(CASE WHEN chg.charge_code = 'A' THEN chg.charge_amt ELSE 0 END) AS charge_code_a_total, SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_code = 'P' THEN p.payment_amt ELSE 0 END) AS payment_code_p_total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.prev_balance > m.curr_balance) AS members_balance_decreased, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(chg.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) DESC) AS global_statement_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN charge chg ON s.statement_no = chg.statement_no AND m.member_no = chg.member_no JOIN category cat ON chg.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider prov ON chg.provider_no = prov.provider_no AND r.region_no = prov.region_no WHERE chg.charge_amt > 7480.46 AND s.statement_amt >= 35542.7 AND p.payment_amt >= 5387.47 AND chg.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND m.issue_dt <= '1980-01-01' AND s.due_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(chg.charge_amt) > 76662.61 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) >= 814 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) > 399 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_charge_rank ASC, global_statement_rank ASC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov AS member_state, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(pm.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, m.state_prov ORDER BY c.category_no) AS prev_category_charges FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON s.statement_no = pm.statement_no AND m.member_no = pm.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' OR s.due_dt IS NULL) AND ch.charge_amt > 162084.86 AND pm.payment_amt < 494957.58 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.statement_dt::DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ch.charge_dt::DATE) <= 9 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, c.category_desc, c.category_no, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 7284566.4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 626 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC, charge_count DESC;

SELECT r1.region_no, r1.region_name, r2.region_name AS other_region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_balance FROM region r1 JOIN region r2 ON r1.region_no = r2.region_no JOIN member m ON m.region_no = r1.region_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 2930.92 GROUP BY r1.region_no, r1.region_name, r2.region_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 830 ORDER BY avg_balance DESC;

SELECT s.member_no, s.statement_dt, s.statement_amt, AVG(s.statement_amt) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.member_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt::DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3period FROM statement s WHERE s.statement_amt > 3295.87 AND s.statement_dt::DATE >= '2020-01-01'::DATE ORDER BY s.member_no, s.statement_dt;

WITH charge_summary AS ( SELECT c.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM charge c WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 6231.42 ) SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cs.total_charges, cs.charge_count, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN charge_summary cs ON m.member_no = cs.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cs.total_charges, cs.charge_count ORDER BY cs.total_charges DESC LIMIT 69;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 45737.83 AND c.category_no IN (SELECT category_no FROM charge WHERE charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY category_no HAVING COUNT(*) > 550) GROUP BY c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 3804.29 AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation cr ON m.corp_no = cr.corp_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON ch.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2023-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 4020.7 AND m.curr_balance < -4028.15 AND cr.corp_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 60347.3 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4636.8 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 4719.84 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 28309.56 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 12719.05 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, m.country, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.country ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 2051.07 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, m.country ORDER BY m.country, payment_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7328.89 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) < 732002.59 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2466.17 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 38906.86 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 720.81 AND m.curr_balance < (SELECT AVG(sub.curr_balance) FROM member sub WHERE sub.region_no = m.region_no AND sub.corp_no IN (SELECT subc.corp_no FROM corporation subc WHERE subc.region_no = m.region_no AND subc.corp_code = 'A')) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 29625.77 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 48 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.statement_no) AS statements_with_payments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charge ch2 WHERE ch2.member_no = m.member_no AND ch2.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_charge_count, (SELECT SUM(ch3.charge_amt) FROM charge ch3 WHERE ch3.member_no = m.member_no AND ch3.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_charge_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment p2 WHERE p2.member_no = m.member_no AND p2.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_payment_count, (SELECT SUM(p3.payment_amt) FROM payment p3 WHERE p3.member_no = m.member_no AND p3.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_payment_total, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS last_statement_date, MIN(s.due_dt) AS earliest_due_date FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5679.24 AND s.statement_amt > 15314.31 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND cat.category_code = 'A' AND pr.provider_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 819157.19 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 140509.32 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) > 3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.statement_no) > 41 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC LIMIT 113;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.member_no, c.lastname, c.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS region_rank FROM region r JOIN member c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN charge ch ON c.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON c.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6630.06 AND p.payment_amt > 5396.41 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.member_no, c.lastname, c.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) > -3763.97 ORDER BY r.region_no, region_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.corp_no, c.corp_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members_charged, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND (s.due_dt <= '2020-01-01' OR s.due_dt IS NULL) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.corp_no, c.corp_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 9862.26 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_no, corp_no;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND ch.member_no IN (SELECT member_no FROM member WHERE region_no = 5) GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 82707.51 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 43545.97 AND c.category_no IN (SELECT category_no FROM charge WHERE charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY category_no HAVING COUNT(*) > 977) GROUP BY c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.state_prov ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_state FROM charge ch JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE c.category_code LIKE 'A' AND m.state_prov LIKE 'AA' AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt < '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.state_prov HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 76383.98 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_amt || '|' || ch.charge_code) AS distinct_charge_combinations, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2126.95 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charge DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt >= 1085.77 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 468.86 INTERSECT SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN payment p ON ch.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE p.payment_amt >= 4691.82 AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc ORDER BY category_no;

SELECT c.member_no, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount FROM member c JOIN statement s ON c.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 8578.55 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.member_no ORDER BY total_statement_amount DESC;

SELECT c1.member_no AS member1, c2.member_no AS member2, COUNT(DISTINCT s1.statement_no) AS shared_statements, SUM(c1.charge_amt) AS total_charges_member1, SUM(c2.charge_amt) AS total_charges_member2 FROM charge c1 JOIN charge c2 ON c1.statement_no = c2.statement_no AND c1.member_no < c2.member_no JOIN statement s1 ON c1.statement_no = s1.statement_no JOIN statement s2 ON c2.statement_no = s2.statement_no WHERE c1.charge_amt > 9036.99 AND c2.charge_amt > 6840.38 GROUP BY c1.member_no, c2.member_no HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s1.statement_no) > 1 ORDER BY shared_statements DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS total_charges, COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charge_amount, COALESCE(AVG(c.charge_amt), 0) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payment_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS total_statements, COALESCE(SUM(s.statement_amt), 0) AS total_statement_amount, r.region_name, cor.corp_name, prov.provider_name, cat.category_desc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) DESC) AS charge_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) DESC) AS charge_count_rank, LAG(COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0), 1) OVER (ORDER BY m.member_no) AS prev_member_total_charge FROM member m LEFT JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no AND c.charge_amt > 7886.04 LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_amt > 714.5 LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND s.statement_amt > 7839.92 LEFT JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no LEFT JOIN corporation cor ON m.corp_no = cor.corp_no LEFT JOIN provider prov ON c.provider_no = prov.provider_no LEFT JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE m.issue_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (m.country = 'USA' OR m.country IS NULL) GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name, cor.corp_name, prov.provider_name, cat.category_desc, m.issue_dt, m.country HAVING COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) > 38424.09 OR COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) > 48298.32 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(c.charge_no) AS charge_count, COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charges FROM member m LEFT JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 7745.01 AND (c.charge_dt IS NULL OR c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01') GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING COUNT(c.charge_no) < 44 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS charge_count, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 722.65 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 30107.67 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) AS statements_count FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 8101.83 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation cor ON r.region_no = cor.region_no JOIN member m ON cor.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= (SELECT MIN(payment_dt) FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 9055.0) AND ch.charge_dt <= (SELECT MAX(payment_dt) FROM payment WHERE payment_amt < 2867.2) AND ch.charge_amt > (SELECT AVG(charge_amt) FROM charge WHERE charge_code = 'A') GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 790998.71 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, MAX(s.statement_amt) AS max_statement, MIN(s.due_dt) AS earliest_due_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name) AS region_total_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 534097.95 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 5712598.16 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) >= 745 ORDER BY region_total_charge DESC, charge_rank LIMIT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.category_desc) FROM category c WHERE c.category_code = 'A');

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1453.24 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 81551.9 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name, c.category_desc) AS avg_category_charge_per_region, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON ch.member_no = pm.member_no AND ch.statement_no = pm.statement_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2023-12-31' AND ch.charge_amt > 986.35 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 1777.76 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charge ch WHERE ch.member_no = m.member_no AND ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS recent_charges_count, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS recent_payments_sum FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN corporation c ON m.corp_no = c.corp_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 5866.19 AND m.expr_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance ORDER BY m.curr_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, c.category_no, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4547.57 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, c.category_no), (r.region_no), (c.category_no), () ) ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, (SELECT AVG(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS avg_recent_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 420.08 AND s.statement_amt >= 840.24 AND m.curr_balance <= 5994.45 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 9 AND SUM(ch.charge_amt) < 1461.01 ORDER BY member_count DESC, avg_recent_payment DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1999-01-01') AS recent_payments FROM region r JOIN corporation cr ON r.region_no = cr.region_no JOIN member m ON cr.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1999-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 961625.13 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(m.curr_balance - m.prev_balance) AS net_balance_change, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 789879.42 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 1474826.4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 747 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank_by_region, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, MAX(ch.charge_amt) AS max_charge_amount, MIN(p.payment_amt) AS min_payment_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 9201.37 AND p.payment_amt < 494.14 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 3888.22 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 66 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) BETWEEN 3837.08 AND 36418.0 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 15172.71 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_charge_rank ASC LIMIT 972;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS distinct_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS distinct_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT cat.category_no) AS distinct_categories, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date, MIN(p.payment_dt) AS earliest_payment_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.corp_no ORDER BY SUM(s.statement_amt) DESC) AS statement_rank_in_corp FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9633.83 AND s.statement_amt > 7275.59 AND p.payment_amt > 4263.52 AND m.curr_balance < 72215.76 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 60626.44 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) > 64 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 218 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_month, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3926.96 AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2020-01-01' AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2022-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 408.72 AND pv.provider_no > 75 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, r.region_name), (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name), (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname), (r.region_no, r.region_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))), (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))), () ) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 45472.65 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 9 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_member_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS provider_count, MAX(s.statement_amt) AS max_statement_amt FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider prov ON ch.provider_no = prov.provider_no AND r.region_no = prov.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8153.28 AND s.statement_amt >= 46711.54 AND m.curr_balance < 17785.14 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 532636.84 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) > 506 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, region_no, category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 817.33 AND c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 4545.59 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 185.88 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 4291.45 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT c.category_no) AS distinct_categories, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(SUM(c.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY MAX(c.charge_dt)) AS prev_member_charge_total FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 6115.64 AND p.payment_amt > 499.39 AND s.statement_amt BETWEEN 25257.63 AND 75630.27 AND c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 28738.6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.category_no) >= 15 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, s.statement_dt, SUM(s.statement_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_statement_amt, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_count_statements FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_amt >= 35858.18 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, s.statement_dt, s.statement_amt ORDER BY r.region_no, s.statement_dt;

SELECT c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.category_desc LIKE 'A%' AND m.state_prov LIKE 'A' GROUP BY c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, p.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1536.59 AND (ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' OR ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01') AND NOT (m.country = 'A') GROUP BY c.category_desc, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) < 70882.54 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 1703.45 AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 6126.95 AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.corp_no, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amt, AVG(m2.curr_balance) AS avg_other_member_balance FROM member m1 JOIN payment p ON m1.member_no = p.member_no JOIN member m2 ON m1.region_no = m2.region_no AND m1.corp_no = m2.corp_no AND m1.member_no != m2.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 22273.68 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.corp_no HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 54316.88 ORDER BY total_payment_amt DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.provider_no) AS provider_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM region r LEFT JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no LEFT JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 4206.85 AND c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SELECT AVG(sub_ch.charge_amt) FROM charge sub_ch JOIN statement sub_s ON sub_ch.statement_no = sub_s.statement_no WHERE sub_s.member_no = m.member_no AND sub_ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.category_no) AS distinct_categories, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS latest_statement_date, MIN(s.due_dt) AS earliest_due_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment sub_p WHERE sub_p.member_no = m.member_no AND sub_p.payment_dt BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31') AS payments_in_range, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank_global FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4934.5 AND s.statement_amt >= 6340.97 AND cat.category_code IN ('A', 'B') AND pr.provider_code = 'P' AND s.statement_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 18476.89 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) >= 60 AND AVG(p.payment_amt) BETWEEN 1386.82 AND 5739.45 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments ASC, latest_statement_date DESC;
