SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS balance_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 7391.56 AND p.payment_amt > 4068.78 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 36387.97 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 5 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, balance_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov AS member_state, m.country AS member_country, c.corp_name, p.provider_name, cat.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT py.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(py.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_current_balance, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_previous_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, m.state_prov ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS prev_charge_amount_by_state FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment py ON s.statement_no = py.statement_no AND m.member_no = py.member_no WHERE ( (ch.charge_amt > 42047.91 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01') OR (s.statement_amt BETWEEN 52532.15 AND 15122.09) OR (m.curr_balance < -3939.32 AND m.prev_balance > 5982.45) ) AND NOT (p.provider_code = 'A' OR cat.category_code = 'A') AND (m.country = 'US' OR c.country = 'US') AND (ch.charge_code IN ('A', 'B') OR s.statement_code = 'A') GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.country, c.corp_name, p.provider_name, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 267206.35 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 852 AND (AVG(ch.charge_amt) < 12439.28 OR SUM(py.payment_amt) > 418961.19) ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, total_current_balance ASC;

SELECT r1.region_no AS region1_no, r2.region_no AS region2_no, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.member_no) AS members_in_region1, COUNT(DISTINCT m2.member_no) AS members_in_region2, AVG(m1.curr_balance) AS avg_balance_region1, AVG(m2.curr_balance) AS avg_balance_region2 FROM region r1 JOIN member m1 ON r1.region_no = m1.region_no JOIN region r2 ON r1.region_no != r2.region_no JOIN member m2 ON r2.region_no = m2.region_no WHERE m1.curr_balance > 3832.01 AND m2.curr_balance > 7317.25 GROUP BY r1.region_no, r2.region_no HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.member_no) > 23 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m2.member_no) > 82 ORDER BY r1.region_no, r2.region_no;

SELECT s.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM statement s JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY s.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 2955.98 INTERSECT SELECT p.member_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM payment p WHERE p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY p.member_no HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 7766.12 ORDER BY member_no;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6540.7 AND m.curr_balance < 3304.13 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 6551.87 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3069.44 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 32642.98 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, m.country, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.country ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 6691.69 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, m.country ORDER BY m.country, payment_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS active_members, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01' ) AND c.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING AVG(c.charge_amt) > 205.11 ORDER BY active_members DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, (SELECT AVG(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01') AS avg_member_payment FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 9746.87 AND c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 11839.04 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 7499.47 AND s.statement_dt >= ( SELECT MAX(statement_dt) FROM statement WHERE statement_dt < '1990-01-01' ) AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > ( SELECT AVG(payment_amt) FROM payment WHERE payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' ) ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) > 44 ORDER BY total_statements DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member m2 WHERE m2.region_no = r.region_no AND m2.expr_dt >= '2020-01-01') AS active_members_in_region FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 1755.98 AND m.curr_balance < -8765.93 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 43149.67 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1750.47 AND p.payment_amt > 1072.02 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 88957.74 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS provider_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 8016.2 AND s.statement_amt > 29623.8 AND m.curr_balance > 5828.98 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 41150.41 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) > 6 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) > 19511.08 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT chg.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(chg.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(chg.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS latest_statement_date, SUM(m.prev_balance + m.curr_balance) AS total_member_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT prov.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, SUM(chg.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(chg.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.statement_amt) DESC) AS statement_amount_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge chg ON s.statement_no = chg.statement_no AND m.member_no = chg.member_no JOIN category cat ON chg.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider prov ON chg.provider_no = prov.provider_no AND r.region_no = prov.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE chg.charge_amt > 24087.83 AND s.statement_amt > 35907.55 AND chg.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(chg.charge_amt) > 325549.14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT chg.charge_no) >= 20 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, total_member_balance DESC, charge_rank_in_region LIMIT 826;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, r.country, m.corp_no, c.corp_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(st.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no AND ch.statement_no = st.statement_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND st.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 45711.01 AND st.statement_amt >= 45707.99 AND p.payment_amt <= 79463.49 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM category cat WHERE cat.category_no = ch.category_no AND cat.category_code = 'A' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM member m2 WHERE m2.corp_no = m.corp_no AND m2.region_no = m.region_no AND m2.curr_balance < -9682.11 ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, r.country, m.corp_no, c.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 425023.4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 57 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_members ASC;

SELECT s.member_no, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement, m.corp_no, r.region_name FROM statement s JOIN member m ON s.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation c ON m.corp_no = c.corp_no JOIN region r ON c.region_no = r.region_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 8576.2 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.member_no IN (SELECT p.member_no FROM payment p WHERE p.payment_amt > 4131.4) GROUP BY s.member_no, m.corp_no, r.region_name ORDER BY total_statement DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT s.member_no, s.statement_dt, s.statement_amt, AVG(s.statement_amt) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.member_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3period, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(p.payment_no) AS payment_count FROM statement s JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND s.member_no = c.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND s.member_no = p.member_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 8248.52 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY s.member_no, s.statement_dt, s.statement_amt, s.statement_no ORDER BY s.member_no, s.statement_dt;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 5112.61 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_amt > 755.0) GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 30167.45 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, r.region_no, r.region_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 4980.03 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((c.category_no, c.category_desc, r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), ()) ORDER BY c.category_no, r.region_no;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, sub.max_charge, sub.total_paid FROM member m JOIN ( SELECT c.member_no, MAX(c.charge_amt) AS max_charge, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_paid FROM charge c LEFT JOIN payment p ON c.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= ( SELECT MIN(s.statement_dt) FROM statement s WHERE s.member_no = c.member_no AND s.statement_amt > 4788.9 ) WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.member_no ) sub ON m.member_no = sub.member_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 189.82 ORDER BY sub.total_paid DESC, m.member_no;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2272.5 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.member_no IN (SELECT s.member_no FROM statement s WHERE s.statement_amt > 37348.64 AND s.due_dt >= '1990-01-01') GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 40719.14 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3887.02 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 2924.47 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 17005.79 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 9009.35 AND AVG(p.payment_amt) < 407.15 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5170.75 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM statement WHERE statement_amt > ( SELECT AVG(statement_amt) FROM statement WHERE statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' ) ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 6633.15 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, m1.member_no AS member1_no, m1.lastname AS member1_lastname, m2.member_no AS member2_no, m2.lastname AS member2_lastname, c1.category_desc AS category1_desc, c2.category_desc AS category2_desc, SUM(ch1.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt_member1, SUM(ch2.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt_member2, AVG(p1.payment_amt) AS avg_payment_amt_member1, AVG(p2.payment_amt) AS avg_payment_amt_member2, COUNT(DISTINCT s1.statement_no) AS statement_count_member1, COUNT(DISTINCT s2.statement_no) AS statement_count_member2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch1.charge_amt) + SUM(ch2.charge_amt) DESC) AS total_charge_rank, LAG(SUM(ch1.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, m1.member_no ORDER BY ch1.charge_dt) AS prev_charge_member1 FROM region r JOIN member m1 ON r.region_no = m1.region_no JOIN member m2 ON m1.region_no = m2.region_no AND m1.member_no < m2.member_no JOIN charge ch1 ON m1.member_no = ch1.member_no JOIN charge ch2 ON m2.member_no = ch2.member_no JOIN category c1 ON ch1.category_no = c1.category_no JOIN category c2 ON ch2.category_no = c2.category_no JOIN payment p1 ON m1.member_no = p1.member_no JOIN payment p2 ON m2.member_no = p2.member_no JOIN statement s1 ON m1.member_no = s1.member_no JOIN statement s2 ON m2.member_no = s2.member_no JOIN provider pr1 ON ch1.provider_no = pr1.provider_no JOIN provider pr2 ON ch2.provider_no = pr2.provider_no JOIN corporation co1 ON m1.corp_no = co1.corp_no JOIN corporation co2 ON m2.corp_no = co2.corp_no WHERE ch1.charge_amt > 2944.64 AND ch2.charge_amt > 3288.25 AND s1.statement_amt >= 34176.14 AND s2.statement_amt <= 26078.84 AND p1.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p2.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, r.region_no, m1.member_no, m1.lastname, total_charge_rank, r.region_no, total_charge_amt_member1 DESC, total_charge_amt_member2 DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7578.87 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 9839.67 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.country, m.state_prov, pr.provider_name, co.corp_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, m.country ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region_country, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no) AS avg_category_charge_per_region, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) FILTER (WHERE ch.charge_amt > 34152.57) AS high_charge_members, MAX(SUM(p.payment_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY m.corp_no) AS max_payment_by_corporation FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no AND m.region_no = co.region_no JOIN provider pr ON r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no AND pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.country, m.state_prov, pr.provider_name, co.corp_name, c.category_no, m.corp_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 305731.78 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) > 4 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation cor ON r.region_no = cor.region_no JOIN member m ON cor.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE (ch.charge_amt > 9938.51 OR s.statement_amt < 1391.68) AND NOT (c.category_code = 'A' AND ch.charge_dt < '1990-01-01') GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 7902.97 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 14428.94 ORDER BY total_payment DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, p.provider_name, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count, ( SELECT MAX(pm.payment_amt) FROM payment pm WHERE pm.member_no = ch.member_no AND pm.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' ) AS max_payment_for_member FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt >= 1357.94 GROUP BY c.category_desc, p.provider_name, ch.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 48476.65 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, pr.provider_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS unique_statements FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 5013.93 GROUP BY c.category_desc, pr.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 9895.94 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.member_no, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount FROM member c JOIN statement s ON c.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 2131.25 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.member_no ORDER BY total_statement_amount DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement FROM member m JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 3670.41 GROUP BY m.member_no INTERSECT SELECT m.member_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 9493.47 GROUP BY m.member_no;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 42.91 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 80464.77 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, m.state_prov, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, CASE WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) > 0 THEN 'Debt' WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) < 0 THEN 'Credit' ELSE 'Balanced' END AS financial_status FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, m.state_prov, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 8651.57 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.country, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, (SELECT MAX(sub_c.charge_amt) FROM charge sub_c WHERE sub_c.category_no = cat.category_no AND sub_c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND sub_c.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01') AS max_category_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 1244.74 AND p.payment_amt > 6951.53 AND s.statement_amt > 9446.8 AND m.curr_balance < -3220.31 AND pr.region_no = r.region_no GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.country, cat.category_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 64104.15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 427 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_members ASC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 153.27 AND c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 30098.24 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.provider_no) AS unique_providers, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN provider pv ON c.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 852.11 AND m.curr_balance < -3356.03 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM charge c2 JOIN statement s2 ON c2.statement_no = s2.statement_no WHERE c2.member_no = m.member_no AND c2.charge_amt > 3369.05 AND s2.statement_amt > 1892.64 ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 19727.82 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) >= 99 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) BETWEEN 831.41 AND 17207.58 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) DESC) AS balance_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2023-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 2324.12 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 12599.24 ORDER BY r.region_no, balance_rank;

SELECT s.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM statement s JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 3327.65 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY s.member_no ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS unique_providers, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no || '-' || ch.charge_no) AS unique_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_current_balance, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_desc ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) DESC) AS member_rank FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN region r ON co.region_no = r.region_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND s.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 6748.57 AND s.statement_amt > 5599.3 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 564597.15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 172.98 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, unique_members DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 370.03 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 1319.95 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 339.28 ORDER BY member_count DESC, avg_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, CASE WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 37352.3 THEN 'High' WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) BETWEEN 1195.76 AND 1790.73 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS charge_category FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE r.region_no = 7 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 1656.48 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 73642.63 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, cat.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2623.42 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 63094.7 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(m.curr_balance - m.prev_balance) AS net_balance_change, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 650577.64 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 1632833.76 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 944 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank_by_region, total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch1.member_no) AS members_with_charges, SUM(ch1.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch2.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_same_category FROM category c JOIN charge ch1 ON c.category_no = ch1.category_no JOIN charge ch2 ON ch1.category_no = ch2.category_no AND ch1.statement_no = ch2.statement_no AND ch1.charge_no <> ch2.charge_no WHERE ch1.charge_amt > 1735.72 AND ch2.charge_amt > 2933.13 GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ch1.member_no) > 844 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1516.68 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND r.region_name = 'North America' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) < 15178.16 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, p.provider_name, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 9511.14 AND m.curr_balance < 25292.54 AND r.region_no = 91 GROUP BY c.category_desc, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 96071.48 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 31231.37 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.region_no, m.corp_no, c.category_no, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no, m.corp_no) AS avg_charge_per_corp, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_no) AS charge_count_per_category FROM member m JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN corporation cor ON m.corp_no = cor.corp_no AND m.region_no = cor.region_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 7049.17 GROUP BY m.region_no, m.corp_no, c.category_no, ch.charge_amt ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, 'charge' AS source_type, COUNT(DISTINCT c.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_amount FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 3457.16 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name UNION ALL SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, 'payment' AS source_type, COUNT(DISTINCT p.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_amount FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 2889.64 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name ORDER BY region_no, source_type;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, (SELECT AVG(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS avg_recent_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 630.28 AND s.statement_amt >= 320.66 AND m.curr_balance <= 9570.71 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 13 AND SUM(ch.charge_amt) < 5959.24 ORDER BY member_count DESC, avg_recent_payment DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON p.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 6108.43 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 23772.13 ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(st.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount FROM region r JOIN provider pr ON r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN charge ch ON pr.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no LEFT JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no AND st.statement_dt >= '1995-01-01' WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1995-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 791.09 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 89003.73 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_per_member FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 6082.54 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 39622.4 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 296.14 AND s.statement_amt > 42929.72 AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 69841.59 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 24 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 49455.01 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) > 2242.06 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS provider_count FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8170.44 AND s.statement_amt >= 21160.93 AND p.payment_amt <= 63715.76 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 38310.01 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 8 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_month, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8358.54 AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2020-01-01' AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2022-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 4170.04 AND pv.provider_no > 996 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, r.region_name), (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name), (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname), (r.region_no, r.region_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))), (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))), () ) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 41838.87 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 97 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, s.due_dt, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, ch.charge_code, ch.charge_amt, ch.charge_dt, p.payment_amt, p.payment_dt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt) AS running_region_corp_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no) AS avg_member_payment, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY cat.category_no) AS total_category_charges, SUM(s.statement_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no) AS total_region_statement, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no) - SUM(p.payment_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no)) AS net_region_corp_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 277.52 AND s.statement_amt > 43822.21 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, s.due_dt, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, ch.charge_code, ch.charge_amt, ch.charge_dt, p.payment_amt, p.payment_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 87771.44 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) >= 64 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, m.member_no, s.statement_no, ch.charge_dt;

SELECT s.member_no, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement, m.corp_no, r.region_name FROM statement s JOIN member m ON s.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation c ON m.corp_no = c.corp_no JOIN region r ON c.region_no = r.region_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 3046.97 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.member_no IN (SELECT p.member_no FROM payment p WHERE p.payment_amt > 4015.79) GROUP BY s.member_no, m.corp_no, r.region_name ORDER BY total_statement DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(SUM(c.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no) AS avg_region_charges FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 7494.63 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.region_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 2989.15 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.curr_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM member m1 JOIN member m2 ON m1.region_no = m2.region_no AND m1.member_no != m2.member_no JOIN charge c ON m1.member_no = c.member_no WHERE m1.curr_balance > 5132.4 AND c.charge_amt BETWEEN 247.43 AND 829.55 GROUP BY m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.curr_balance HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 4162.06 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 389.28 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 1345.47 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 425.37 ORDER BY member_count DESC, avg_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 172.52 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 28192.08 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_month, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment_amount, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS unique_members, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.provider_no) AS unique_providers, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_current_balance, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_previous_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4696.53 AND s.statement_amt > 35456.5 AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('2000-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= TO_DATE('2000-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND m.curr_balance > 81244.93 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, statement_year, statement_month), (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, statement_year), (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name, statement_year, statement_month), (r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc, statement_year, statement_month), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), (statement_year, statement_month), () ) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 440988.27 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 417 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no, statement_year, statement_month, total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 62820.27 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8248.8 AND s.statement_amt >= 16628.98 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 26287.94 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 5 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank LIMIT 156;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS balance_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 4843.33 AND m.curr_balance < -4946.44 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 39993.47 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 3 ORDER BY r.region_no, balance_rank;

SELECT c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS unique_members, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS unique_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5459.8 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) > 844 ORDER BY avg_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_amt || '|' || ch.charge_code) AS distinct_charge_combinations, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3123.09 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charge DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2095.2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_amt > 2481.06) GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 315436.15 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9555.89 AND (m.curr_balance < -4448.39 OR m.prev_balance IS NOT NULL) AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 34846.97 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, c.category_code, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4160.7 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -4812.59 AND r.region_no = 3 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc, c.category_code HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 4527.51 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.charge_dt, c.charge_amt, AVG(c.charge_amt) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY c.charge_dt::DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_charge FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 3022.74 AND c.charge_dt::DATE >= '2020-01-01'::DATE AND cat.category_no = 20 ORDER BY m.member_no, c.charge_dt;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name, c.category_desc ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8227.99 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -87231.55 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 36876.41 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 18 AND (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) > 3748.89 ORDER BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, total_charges DESC, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, AVG(pay.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, MAX(s.statement_amt) AS max_statement, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_prev_balance, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_curr_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name, c.category_desc) AS region_category_total FROM region r INNER JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no INNER JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no INNER JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no INNER JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND m.member_no = pay.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5989.31 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND p.provider_name IS NOT NULL AND m.curr_balance > 48473.98 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 79391.11 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 88 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_name, category_desc;

SELECT r.region_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt, COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_payments_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p2.payment_amt), 0) FROM payment p2 WHERE p2.member_no = m.member_no AND p2.payment_dt BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2023-12-31') AS payment_sum_in_period, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(SUM(c.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS prev_member_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no JOIN provider pv ON c.provider_no = pv.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 17908.07 AND s.statement_amt > 40444.69 AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 377056.11 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) > 5 ORDER BY r.region_name, total_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) AS statement_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS balance_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 8661.09 AND s.statement_amt > 49586.81 AND m.curr_balance > 64024.32 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 39044.59 AND (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) > 1455.37 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) > 9 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, balance_rank LIMIT 47;

SELECT r.region_name, p.provider_name, m.lastname, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charge, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_prev_balance, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_curr_balance, SUM(py.payment_amt) AS total_payment, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge c ON p.provider_no = c.provider_no JOIN member m ON c.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no AND m.region_no = co.region_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment py ON m.member_no = py.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND (cat.category_desc LIKE '%Service%' OR p.provider_name LIKE '%Medical%') AND co.country = 'US' GROUP BY r.region_name, p.provider_name, m.lastname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 85470.65 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) >= 2 ORDER BY total_charge DESC, charge_count DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.member_no) AS members_in_region, COUNT(DISTINCT m2.member_no) AS members_same_country, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN member m1 ON r.region_no = m1.region_no JOIN member m2 ON m1.country = m2.country JOIN statement s ON m1.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 32269.88 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 84042.16 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_current_balance, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_previous_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(s.statement_amt) DESC) AS statement_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1843.85 AND s.statement_amt > 9550.79 AND p.payment_amt > 45205.88 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND r.region_no IN (17, 16, 65) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 518778.25 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 46 AND SUM(s.statement_amt) > 915474.97 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, total_statement_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.member_no, m.curr_balance, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT pr.provider_no FROM provider pr JOIN charge ch2 ON pr.provider_no = ch2.provider_no WHERE pr.region_no = r.region_no AND ch2.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch2.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01') AS sub) AS active_providers FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 77705.25 AND m.expr_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.member_no, m.curr_balance HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 146003.42 OR COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) > 21 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, r.region_no, m.member_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT chg.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(chg.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(chg.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS latest_statement_date, SUM(m.prev_balance + m.curr_balance) AS total_member_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT prov.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, SUM(chg.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(chg.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.statement_amt) DESC) AS statement_amount_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge chg ON s.statement_no = chg.statement_no AND m.member_no = chg.member_no JOIN category cat ON chg.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider prov ON chg.provider_no = prov.provider_no AND r.region_no = prov.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE chg.charge_amt > 66348.78 AND s.statement_amt > 32770.87 AND chg.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(chg.charge_amt) > 504347.47 AND COUNT(DISTINCT chg.charge_no) >= 12 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, total_member_balance DESC, charge_rank_in_region LIMIT 414;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, s.due_dt, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, ch.charge_code, ch.charge_amt, ch.charge_dt, p.payment_amt, p.payment_dt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt) AS running_region_corp_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no) AS avg_member_payment, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY cat.category_no) AS total_category_charges, SUM(s.statement_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no) AS total_region_statement, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no) - SUM(p.payment_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no)) AS net_region_corp_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4895.75 AND s.statement_amt > 26688.88 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, s.due_dt, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, ch.charge_code, ch.charge_amt, ch.charge_dt, p.payment_amt, p.payment_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 41989.34 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) >= 79 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, m.member_no, s.statement_no, ch.charge_dt;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, s.statement_dt, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, AVG(SUM(s.statement_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3period FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 5661.59 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, s.statement_dt ORDER BY r.region_no, s.statement_dt;

SELECT s.region_name, s.state_prov, s.member_count, s.avg_balance, s.total_payments, (SELECT MAX(p.payment_dt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = s.member_no AND p.payment_amt > 4626.17) AS last_large_payment_date FROM ( SELECT r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.member_no, COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY r.region_no) AS member_count, AVG(m.curr_balance) OVER(PARTITION BY r.region_no) AS avg_balance, SUM(py.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN payment py ON m.member_no = py.member_no WHERE py.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.member_no, m.curr_balance ) s WHERE s.total_payments > 2528.12 ORDER BY s.region_name, s.total_payments DESC;

SELECT s.statement_no, s.member_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, c.charge_amt, cat.category_desc FROM statement s JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE s.statement_no IN ( SELECT statement_no FROM charge WHERE charge_amt > 8630.93 ) AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY s.statement_no, s.member_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, c.charge_amt, cat.category_desc ORDER BY s.statement_amt DESC;

SELECT c1.member_no AS member1, c2.member_no AS member2, COUNT(DISTINCT s1.statement_no) AS shared_statements, SUM(c1.charge_amt) AS total_charges_member1, SUM(c2.charge_amt) AS total_charges_member2 FROM charge c1 JOIN charge c2 ON c1.statement_no = c2.statement_no AND c1.member_no < c2.member_no JOIN statement s1 ON c1.statement_no = s1.statement_no JOIN statement s2 ON c2.statement_no = s2.statement_no WHERE c1.charge_amt > 8971.23 AND c2.charge_amt > 6887.9 GROUP BY c1.member_no, c2.member_no HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s1.statement_no) > 6 ORDER BY shared_statements DESC;

SELECT m.region_no, m.corp_no, c.category_no, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no, m.corp_no) AS avg_charge_per_corp, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_no) AS charge_count_per_category FROM member m JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN corporation cor ON m.corp_no = cor.corp_no AND m.region_no = cor.region_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 9005.89 GROUP BY m.region_no, m.corp_no, c.category_no, ch.charge_amt ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 482.69 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT s.member_no FROM statement s WHERE s.statement_amt > 1308.42 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 478.02 ORDER BY member_count DESC, avg_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 880.03 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 3245.43 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 526.12 ORDER BY member_count DESC, avg_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no AND m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN statement s ON s.member_no = m.member_no JOIN charge ch ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN category c ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 19541.56 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3701.24 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 42520.34 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name, c.category_desc ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 639.73 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -33207.69 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 27577.91 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 36 AND (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) > 4771.67 ORDER BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, total_charges DESC, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name, c.category_desc ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 74.55 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -33449.43 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 15215.35 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 15 AND (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) > 9715.94 ORDER BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, total_charges DESC, net_balance DESC;
