SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.corp_no, corp.corp_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, SUM(m.prev_balance + m.curr_balance) AS total_member_balance FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 75697.02 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.corp_no, corp.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 518479.4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 84 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, region_no, category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT pay.statement_no) AS distinct_statements_paid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region_category, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY MAX(ch.charge_dt)) AS previous_member_charge_total FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND m.member_no = pay.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7609.75 AND s.statement_amt >= 45499.74 AND m.curr_balance < -5666.41 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (p.provider_code = 'A' OR p.provider_code IS NULL) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 28669.74 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 750.83 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no, charge_rank_in_region_category, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_charge_total, AVG(p.payment_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY m.corp_no, m.region_no) AS avg_payment_by_corp_region, COUNT(ch.charge_no) OVER (PARTITION BY ch.provider_no, ch.category_no) AS charge_count_by_provider_category, SUM(m.prev_balance + m.curr_balance) AS total_member_balance, MAX(s.due_dt) AS latest_due_date, MIN(p.payment_dt) AS earliest_payment_date FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND c.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND ch.category_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 1818.25 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -1200.77 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_no, s.statement_amt, s.statement_dt, ch.provider_no, ch.category_no, m.corp_no, m.region_no, ch.charge_amt, ch.charge_no, p.payment_amt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 36843.19 AND COUNT(p.payment_no) >= 78 ORDER BY total_member_balance DESC, running_charge_total ASC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN payment p ON ch.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 31564.31 AND p.payment_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, MAX(ch.charge_amt) AS max_charge_amount, MIN(ch.charge_amt) AS min_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(DISTINCT p.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_current_balance, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_previous_balance, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(pm.payment_amt)) AS net_activity, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) DESC) AS charge_count_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (ORDER BY c.category_no) AS prev_category_total_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3042.64 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND p.provider_no IN (SELECT provider_no FROM provider WHERE region_no IN (SELECT region_no FROM region WHERE region_name LIKE 'A')) AND m.member_no IN (SELECT member_no FROM member WHERE curr_balance > 4917.47 AND prev_balance > 1188.15) AND co.corp_no IN (SELECT corp_no FROM corporation WHERE country = 'A') GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 300127.24 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 5102 AND AVG(ch.charge_amt) < 971.95 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, total_charges DESC, c.category_no ASC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4313.39 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_amt > 2448.38) GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 456810.1 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1995-01-01') AS recent_payments FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 3413.4 AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 3415.62 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1995-01-01') AS total_recent_payments, (SELECT AVG(s.statement_amt) FROM statement s WHERE s.member_no = m.member_no AND s.statement_dt >= '1995-01-01') AS avg_recent_statement FROM member m JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation c ON m.corp_no = c.corp_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 8938.36 AND r.region_name = 'North America' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance ORDER BY m.curr_balance DESC;

SELECT m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.curr_balance, m2.prev_balance, (m1.curr_balance - m2.prev_balance) AS balance_change FROM member m1 JOIN member m2 ON m1.member_no = m2.member_no AND m1.region_no = m2.region_no AND m1.curr_balance > 4264.81 AND m2.prev_balance < 930.5 JOIN region r ON m1.region_no = r.region_no WHERE m1.curr_balance > m2.prev_balance AND r.region_no = 6 GROUP BY m1.member_no, m1.region_no, m1.curr_balance, m2.prev_balance HAVING AVG(m1.curr_balance) > 758.03 ORDER BY balance_change DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt < '2020-01-02' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 65055.02 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, 'charge' AS source_type, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS record_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_amount FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge c ON p.provider_no = c.provider_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 9538.48 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name UNION ALL SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, 'payment' AS source_type, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.payment_no) AS record_count, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_amount FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no WHERE pm.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND pm.payment_amt > 1462.32 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name ORDER BY region_no, source_type;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_amt > 8827.16 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_payment_count FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) > 91 ORDER BY member_count DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6022.54 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 91844.96 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = ch.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01') AS member_total_payments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM statement s WHERE s.member_no = ch.member_no AND s.statement_amt > 9223.23) AS high_statement_count, MAX(m.curr_balance) AS max_current_balance, MIN(m.prev_balance) AS min_previous_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN statement st ON ch.statement_no = st.statement_no AND m.member_no = st.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 265.74 AND m.curr_balance < -6418.24 AND pr.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, ch.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 10696.44 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 50 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_no, category_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(st.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amt, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_no ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank_in_category, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no) AS region_category_total_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN payment p ON st.member_no = p.member_no AND st.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN charge ch ON st.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND st.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 5856.61 AND m.prev_balance < -3340.3 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 1585.75 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) > 25 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank_in_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT pay.statement_no) AS distinct_statements_paid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region_category, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY MAX(ch.charge_dt)) AS previous_member_charge_total FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND m.member_no = pay.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5002.81 AND s.statement_amt >= 29348.47 AND m.curr_balance < -3864.7 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (p.provider_code = 'A' OR p.provider_code IS NULL) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 3477.39 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 775.68 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no, charge_rank_in_region_category, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.member_no, m.curr_balance, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT pr.provider_no FROM provider pr JOIN charge ch2 ON pr.provider_no = ch2.provider_no WHERE pr.region_no = r.region_no AND ch2.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch2.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01') AS sub) AS active_providers FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 34174.27 AND m.expr_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.member_no, m.curr_balance HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 435537.86 OR COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) > 26 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, r.region_no, m.member_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r INNER JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no INNER JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no INNER JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no INNER JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 1629.17 AND s.statement_amt > 48715.87 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 14548.08 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 41 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank ASC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT s.member_no FROM statement s WHERE s.statement_amt > 59797.79 ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 618608.34 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r1.region_no AS region1_id, r1.region_name AS region1_name, r2.region_no AS region2_id, r2.region_name AS region2_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch1.charge_amt) AS total_charges_region1, SUM(ch2.charge_amt) AS total_charges_region2, AVG(ch1.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_region1, AVG(ch2.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_region2, COUNT(DISTINCT ch1.member_no) AS unique_members_region1, COUNT(DISTINCT ch2.member_no) AS unique_members_region2, SUM(st1.statement_amt) AS total_statements_region1, SUM(st2.statement_amt) AS total_statements_region2, SUM(p1.payment_amt) AS total_payments_region1, SUM(p2.payment_amt) AS total_payments_region2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r1.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch1.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region1 FROM region r1 JOIN region r2 ON r1.region_no > r2.region_no JOIN provider pv1 ON r1.region_no = pv1.region_no JOIN provider pv2 ON r2.region_no = pv2.region_no JOIN charge ch1 ON pv1.provider_no = ch1.provider_no JOIN charge ch2 ON pv2.provider_no = ch2.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch1.category_no = c.category_no AND ch2.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m1 ON ch1.member_no = m1.member_no JOIN member m2 ON ch2.member_no = m2.member_no JOIN statement st1 ON ch1.statement_no = st1.statement_no JOIN statement st2 ON ch2.statement_no = st2.statement_no JOIN payment p1 ON st1.statement_no = p1.statement_no AND ch1.member_no = p1.member_no JOIN payment p2 ON st2.statement_no = p2.statement_no AND ch2.member_no = p2.member_no JOIN corporation corp1 ON m1.corp_no = corp1.corp_no JOIN corporation corp2 ON m2.corp_no = corp2.corp_no WHERE ch1.charge_amt > 1238.12 AND ch2.charge_amt > 3606.1 AND ch1.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch2.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND st1.statement_amt > 35747.18 AND st2.statement_amt > 18612.77 GROUP BY r1.region_no, r1.region_name, r2.region_no, r2.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch1.charge_amt) > 81129.36 AND SUM(ch2.charge_amt) > 748886.65 ORDER BY total_charges_region1 DESC, total_charges_region2 DESC;

WITH charge_summary AS ( SELECT c.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM charge c WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY c.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 3791.24 ) SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cs.total_charges, cs.charge_count, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN charge_summary cs ON m.member_no = cs.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cs.total_charges, cs.charge_count ORDER BY cs.total_charges DESC LIMIT 18;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 4041.14 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 52.67 INTERSECT SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt <= '2021-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt < 9511.98 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 52.78 ORDER BY category_no;

SELECT c.charge_dt, c.charge_code, AVG(c.charge_amt) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.charge_code ORDER BY c.charge_dt ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_charge FROM charge c WHERE c.charge_amt > 2370.46 GROUP BY c.charge_dt, c.charge_code, c.charge_amt ORDER BY c.charge_dt;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category ca ON ch.category_no = ca.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt BETWEEN 1360.71 AND 7248.71 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 945 ORDER BY avg_charge DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5681.85 AND s.statement_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2000-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -1189.32 AND pr.expr_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 22722.52 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 503 INTERSECT SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5191.81 AND s.due_dt >= '2000-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2000-01-01' AND m.prev_balance > 3532.21 AND pr.issue_dt <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 64353.1 AND AVG(m.curr_balance) <= 1608.94 ORDER BY region_no, category_no;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, MAX(s.statement_amt) AS max_statement_amt, MIN(p.payment_amt) AS min_payment_amt, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_no) AS charges_per_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS category_rank FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN payment p ON s.member_no = p.member_no AND p.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND pr.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 8251.38 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -32119.58 AND pr.provider_no > 8756 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 13527.02 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 819 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, category_rank;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, c.category_code, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no) AS member_total_payments FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 842.04 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc, c.category_code, m.member_no HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 37 ORDER BY avg_charge DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.region_no, m.corp_no, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment, AVG(st.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' LEFT JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 884.83 AND m.member_no IN (SELECT m2.member_no FROM member m2 WHERE m2.curr_balance > 45514.54 AND m2.region_no IN (SELECT r2.region_no FROM region r2 WHERE r2.region_name LIKE 'A')) GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.region_no, m.corp_no, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 18055.24 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 57 ORDER BY total_charge DESC, m.member_no;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(c.charge_no) AS charge_count, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, MAX(c.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 2624.43 AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 9381.44 UNION ALL SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(p.payment_no) AS payment_count, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, MAX(p.payment_dt) AS latest_payment_date FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 231.12 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 2665.11 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, member_no;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation cr ON m.corp_no = cr.corp_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON ch.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2023-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 1179.67 AND m.curr_balance < -4172.07 AND cr.corp_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 62938.94 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE (ch.charge_amt > 8681.28 OR p.payment_amt < 582.55) AND NOT (m.curr_balance <= 106.77 AND s.statement_amt >= 3484.97) AND (ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' OR s.statement_dt <= '2020-01-01') GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 41150.32 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) < 10 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, c.corp_no, m.member_no, cat.category_no, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_month, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.provider_no) AS unique_providers FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2958.46 AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2020-01-01' AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2022-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 3430.84 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, c.corp_no, m.member_no, cat.category_no, statement_year, statement_month), (r.region_no, c.corp_no, cat.category_no, statement_year, statement_month), (r.region_no, cat.category_no, statement_year, statement_month), (r.region_no, statement_year, statement_month), (statement_year, statement_month), () ) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 28021.95 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, m.member_no, cat.category_no, statement_year DESC, statement_month DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 5705.05 AND s.statement_dt >= ( SELECT MAX(statement_dt) FROM statement WHERE statement_dt < '1990-01-01' ) AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > ( SELECT AVG(payment_amt) FROM payment WHERE payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' ) ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) > 100 ORDER BY total_statements DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_amt > 1821.7 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' ) AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 61137.64 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

WITH regional_charges AS ( SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND corp.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc ), member_payment_analysis AS ( SELECT m.member_no, m.region_no, m.corp_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT p.statement_no) AS statements_paid, (SELECT AVG(charge_amt) FROM charge ch2 WHERE ch2.member_no = m.member_no AND ch2.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01') AS recent_avg_charges FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON p.statement_no = s.statement_no AND p.member_no = s.member_no WHERE p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.region_no, m.corp_no HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 727.36 ), correlated_balance AS ( SELECT rc.region_no, rc.region_name, rc.category_no, rc.category_desc, rc.total_charges, rc.unique_members, rc.avg_charge_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_payment_analysis mpa WHERE mpa.region_no = rc.region_no AND mpa.total_payments > rc.avg_charge_amount * 1.5) AS high_paying_members, (SELECT AVG(m.curr_balance - m.prev_balance) FROM member m WHERE m.region_no = rc.region_no AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM charge ch3 WHERE ch3.member_no = m.member_no AND ch3.category_no = rc.category_no AND ch3.charge_amt > 1119.69 )) AS net_balance_change FROM regional_charges rc ) SELECT cb.region_no, cb.region_name, cb.category_no, cb.category_desc, cb.total_charges, cb.unique_members, cb.avg_charge_amount, cb.high_paying_members, cb.net_balance_change, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) FROM statement s JOIN member m ON s.member_no = m.member_no WHERE m.region_no = cb.region_no AND s.statement_amt > cb.avg_charge_amount * 4.06 AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01') AS high_value_statements, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cb.region_no ORDER BY cb.total_charges DESC) AS region_charge_rank, LAG(cb.total_charges, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY cb.region_no ORDER BY cb.category_no) AS prev_category_charges FROM correlated_balance cb WHERE cb.total_charges > 5661.47 AND cb.unique_members >= 75 AND cb.net_balance_change < -3239.22 ORDER BY cb.region_no, cb.total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, p.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6742.86 AND (ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' OR ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01') AND NOT (m.country = 'A') GROUP BY c.category_desc, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) < 750673.18 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no) AS region_avg_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 9090.61 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT pm.member_no FROM payment pm WHERE pm.payment_amt > 2245.34 AND pm.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 22476.4 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3584.73 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc UNION ALL SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payment p JOIN member m ON p.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 4735.45 AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc ORDER BY region_name, category_desc;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 328.18 ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 35220.72 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, p.provider_name, cat.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS num_statements, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(pay.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, AVG(SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(pay.payment_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name) AS avg_region_net_balance FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge c ON p.provider_no = c.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN member m ON c.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no AND m.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no AND c.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND s.member_no = pay.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 17210.67 GROUP BY r.region_name, p.provider_name, cat.category_desc, r.region_no, p.provider_no, cat.category_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 908063.55 AND (SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(pay.payment_amt)) > 135124.28 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, r.region_name, p.provider_name;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (ORDER BY r.region_no) AS prev_region_total FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 939691.53 AND ch.member_no IN ( SELECT m2.member_no FROM member m2 JOIN payment p2 ON m2.member_no = p2.member_no WHERE p2.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p2.payment_amt >= 861963.09 GROUP BY m2.member_no HAVING COUNT(p2.payment_no) > 94 ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 3541777.3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 396 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, r.region_no, c.category_desc;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2335.17 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 14584.45 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, pv.provider_no, pv.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT st.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(st.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN payment pm ON m.member_no = pm.member_no AND st.statement_no = pm.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6504.79 AND st.statement_amt > 18230.87 AND pm.payment_amt > 4728.27 AND m.curr_balance > 60919.81 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, pv.provider_no, pv.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 56920.19 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 56 AND SUM(pm.payment_amt) > 41249.73 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.country, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, (SELECT MAX(sub_c.charge_amt) FROM charge sub_c WHERE sub_c.category_no = cat.category_no AND sub_c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND sub_c.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01') AS max_category_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 9559.25 AND p.payment_amt > 6517.13 AND s.statement_amt > 7472.5 AND m.curr_balance < -9784.19 AND pr.region_no = r.region_no GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.country, cat.category_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 57629.13 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 184 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_members ASC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, m.prev_balance, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS distinct_charges, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01') AS recent_payments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM statement s WHERE s.member_no = m.member_no AND s.statement_amt > 84588.12) AS high_statements, MAX(c.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date, MIN(c.charge_dt) AS earliest_charge_date, pv.provider_name, cat.category_desc, corp.corp_name FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN provider pv ON c.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN statement st ON c.statement_no = st.statement_no AND m.member_no = st.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND c.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 7068.56 AND c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -48110.53 AND m.prev_balance > 22468.5 AND pv.provider_code = 'A' AND cat.category_code = 'A' AND corp.corp_code = 'A' AND r.region_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, m.prev_balance, pv.provider_name, cat.category_desc, corp.corp_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 709317.79 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) >= 799 AND AVG(c.charge_amt) BETWEEN 412.13 AND 1076.15 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, m.member_no ASC;

WITH regional_charges AS ( SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND corp.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc ), member_payment_analysis AS ( SELECT m.member_no, m.region_no, m.corp_no, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT p.statement_no) AS statements_paid, (SELECT AVG(charge_amt) FROM charge ch2 WHERE ch2.member_no = m.member_no AND ch2.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01') AS recent_avg_charges FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN statement s ON p.statement_no = s.statement_no AND p.member_no = s.member_no WHERE p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.region_no, m.corp_no HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 7957.7 ), correlated_balance AS ( SELECT rc.region_no, rc.region_name, rc.category_no, rc.category_desc, rc.total_charges, rc.unique_members, rc.avg_charge_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_payment_analysis mpa WHERE mpa.region_no = rc.region_no AND mpa.total_payments > rc.avg_charge_amount * 8.77) AS high_paying_members, (SELECT AVG(m.curr_balance - m.prev_balance) FROM member m WHERE m.region_no = rc.region_no AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM charge ch3 WHERE ch3.member_no = m.member_no AND ch3.category_no = rc.category_no AND ch3.charge_amt > 529.29 )) AS net_balance_change FROM regional_charges rc ) SELECT cb.region_no, cb.region_name, cb.category_no, cb.category_desc, cb.total_charges, cb.unique_members, cb.avg_charge_amount, cb.high_paying_members, cb.net_balance_change, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) FROM statement s JOIN member m ON s.member_no = m.member_no WHERE m.region_no = cb.region_no AND s.statement_amt > cb.avg_charge_amount * 3.72 AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01') AS high_value_statements, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cb.region_no ORDER BY cb.total_charges DESC) AS region_charge_rank, LAG(cb.total_charges, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY cb.region_no ORDER BY cb.category_no) AS prev_category_charges FROM correlated_balance cb WHERE cb.total_charges > 37067.49 AND cb.unique_members >= 94 AND cb.net_balance_change < -7665.89 ORDER BY cb.region_no, cb.total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c LEFT JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no LEFT JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt < '1990-01-01' AND (m.lastname LIKE 'A%' OR m.lastname IS NULL) GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 658340.54 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 5332.94 AND p.payment_amt > 1408.01 AND c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 13771.77 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, m.city, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name, m.city ORDER BY c.category_desc ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 5013.9 GROUP BY r.region_name, m.city, c.category_desc, c.category_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 88116.59 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) >= 98 ORDER BY r.region_name, m.city, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE (ch.charge_amt > 1311.12 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01') OR (ch.charge_amt < 408.87 AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01') GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 41008.76 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region FROM region r LEFT JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no LEFT JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 9424.45 AND s.statement_amt > 11174.26 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 39823.38 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 44 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) > 16007.52 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, charge_rank_by_region;

SELECT r1.region_no AS region1_id, r1.region_name AS region1_name, r2.region_no AS region2_id, r2.region_name AS region2_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch1.charge_amt) AS total_charges_region1, SUM(ch2.charge_amt) AS total_charges_region2, AVG(ch1.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_region1, AVG(ch2.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_region2, COUNT(DISTINCT ch1.member_no) AS unique_members_region1, COUNT(DISTINCT ch2.member_no) AS unique_members_region2, SUM(st1.statement_amt) AS total_statements_region1, SUM(st2.statement_amt) AS total_statements_region2, SUM(p1.payment_amt) AS total_payments_region1, SUM(p2.payment_amt) AS total_payments_region2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r1.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch1.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region1 FROM region r1 JOIN region r2 ON r1.region_no > r2.region_no JOIN provider pv1 ON r1.region_no = pv1.region_no JOIN provider pv2 ON r2.region_no = pv2.region_no JOIN charge ch1 ON pv1.provider_no = ch1.provider_no JOIN charge ch2 ON pv2.provider_no = ch2.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch1.category_no = c.category_no AND ch2.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m1 ON ch1.member_no = m1.member_no JOIN member m2 ON ch2.member_no = m2.member_no JOIN statement st1 ON ch1.statement_no = st1.statement_no JOIN statement st2 ON ch2.statement_no = st2.statement_no JOIN payment p1 ON st1.statement_no = p1.statement_no AND ch1.member_no = p1.member_no JOIN payment p2 ON st2.statement_no = p2.statement_no AND ch2.member_no = p2.member_no JOIN corporation corp1 ON m1.corp_no = corp1.corp_no JOIN corporation corp2 ON m2.corp_no = corp2.corp_no WHERE ch1.charge_amt > 5579.36 AND ch2.charge_amt > 8069.79 AND ch1.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch2.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND st1.statement_amt > 32978.1 AND st2.statement_amt > 31988.13 GROUP BY r1.region_no, r1.region_name, r2.region_no, r2.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch1.charge_amt) > 713199.72 AND SUM(ch2.charge_amt) > 168841.73 ORDER BY total_charges_region1 DESC, total_charges_region2 DESC;

WITH charge_summary AS ( SELECT c.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM charge c WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY c.member_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 3306.17 ) SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cs.total_charges, cs.charge_count, COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payments FROM member m JOIN charge_summary cs ON m.member_no = cs.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cs.total_charges, cs.charge_count ORDER BY cs.total_charges DESC LIMIT 77;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5336.2 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS charge_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN provider pv ON c.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 4405.68 AND m.curr_balance < 4209.38 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM charge c2 JOIN statement s2 ON c2.statement_no = s2.statement_no WHERE c2.member_no = m.member_no AND c2.charge_amt > 3094.73 AND s2.statement_dt BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 46750.86 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) >= 100 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_balance, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 707.1 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS members_with_charges FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 4046.14 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 69261.26 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT s.statement_no, s.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, m.curr_balance, r.region_name, cor.corp_name FROM statement s JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND s.member_no = c.member_no JOIN member m ON s.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation cor ON m.corp_no = cor.corp_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND s.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY s.statement_no, s.member_no, m.curr_balance, r.region_name, cor.corp_name HAVING (SUM(c.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) > 70022.8 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT s.statement_no, s.statement_dt, s.statement_amt, AVG(s.statement_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY s.member_no ORDER BY s.statement_dt ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3_statements, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name FROM statement s JOIN member m ON s.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 5457.95 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY s.statement_no, s.statement_dt, s.statement_amt, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name ORDER BY s.member_no, s.statement_dt;

SELECT c.category_code, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, CASE WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 15670.54 THEN 'High' WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 8566.93 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS charge_volume_category FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_code ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, (SELECT AVG(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = ch.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS avg_recent_payments FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND r.region_name = 'North' GROUP BY c.category_desc, ch.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 27348.88 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(pm.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(pm.payment_amt), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0), 2) AS payment_coverage_percent, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ch.provider_no ORDER BY MIN(ch.charge_dt)) AS prev_provider_charge_total FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation cr ON m.corp_no = cr.corp_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON s.statement_no = pm.statement_no AND s.member_no = pm.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt < '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_amt > 17444.93 AND ch.charge_amt BETWEEN 4062.99 AND 9604.83 AND p.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name, p.provider_name, r.region_no, ch.provider_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 104412.85 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 567 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, region_charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name, c.category_desc) AS avg_category_charge_per_region, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON ch.member_no = pm.member_no AND ch.statement_no = pm.statement_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2023-12-31' AND ch.charge_amt > 1372.41 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 257.81 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.country, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, MAX(CASE WHEN s.statement_amt > (SELECT AVG(s2.statement_amt) FROM statement s2 WHERE s2.member_no IN (SELECT m2.member_no FROM member m2 WHERE m2.region_no = r.region_no)) THEN s.statement_amt ELSE NULL END) AS max_above_avg_statement, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no AND c.corp_no IS NOT NULL JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND m.member_no IS NOT NULL JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND s.statement_no IS NOT NULL JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND ch.charge_no IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND p.payment_no IS NOT NULL WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 5605.01 AND m.curr_balance < -3710.78 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM provider pr WHERE pr.region_no = r.region_no AND pr.expr_dt > '1990-01-01') > 92.53 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.country HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > (SELECT AVG(total_charge) FROM (SELECT SUM(ch2.charge_amt) AS total_charge FROM charge ch2 JOIN statement s2 ON ch2.statement_no = s2.statement_no WHERE s2.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY s2.member_no) AS sub) AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 814.57 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_members ASC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.member_no, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 13878.21 ORDER BY r.region_name, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members_charged, SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_amt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE p.payment_amt END) AS total_payments_received, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 716730.58 AND ch.member_no IN (SELECT m2.member_no FROM member m2 WHERE m2.curr_balance > 57610.7 AND m2.region_no = r.region_no) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 309740.28 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank_by_region;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_code, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(c.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, AVG(COALESCE(m.prev_balance, 0)) AS avg_prev_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT c.provider_no) AS distinct_providers FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND c.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 55085.54 AND m.curr_balance < -86028.08 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_code HAVING (SUM(c.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) > 16646.42 ORDER BY net_balance DESC, r.region_no, m.member_code;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt) AS running_total FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1884.86 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc, ch.charge_dt, ch.charge_amt ORDER BY c.category_no, ch.charge_dt;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS active_members, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' ) AND c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 98266.98 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, (SELECT AVG(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS avg_recent_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 719.2 AND s.statement_amt >= 2926.25 AND m.curr_balance <= 1312.18 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 6 AND SUM(ch.charge_amt) < 9918.16 ORDER BY member_count DESC, avg_recent_payment DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_balance, MAX(p.payment_amt) AS max_payment, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no AND ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no AND m.region_no = co.region_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 392928.81 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.issue_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (p.payment_dt IS NULL OR p.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01') GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 7127703.31 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 570 AND AVG(m.curr_balance) < 421996.4 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, r.region_name ASC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM member m JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 1905.01 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 48058.69 ORDER BY total_statement_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 754.8 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 3370.92 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 1811.49 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 798.89 AND c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 2833.92 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_no ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 8441.79 AND p.payment_amt > 475.91 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 7825.43 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) > 3 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank, payment_rank;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM member m WHERE m.member_no = ch.member_no AND m.curr_balance > 5653.14 ) AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 36768.47 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 231.09 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 8944.36 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN provider pv ON r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN charge ch ON pv.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no AND m.region_no = co.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 1034.98 AND s.statement_amt > 5207.78 AND m.prev_balance < 4550.04 AND co.corp_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 646210.4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 706 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_no, category_desc;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment, MAX(s.statement_amt) AS max_statement, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN provider pv ON r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN charge ch ON pv.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation cp ON m.corp_no = cp.corp_no AND m.region_no = cp.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3722.51 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 300251.11 UNION ALL SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, 'ALL_CATEGORIES' AS category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment, MAX(s.statement_amt) AS max_statement, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 8014.28 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 559685.43 ORDER BY region_no, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members_charged, SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_amt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE p.payment_amt END) AS total_payments_received, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 618536.09 AND ch.member_no IN (SELECT m2.member_no FROM member m2 WHERE m2.curr_balance > 36321.25 AND m2.region_no = r.region_no) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 1457114.0 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank_by_region;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1031.97 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 29196.9 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, r.region_name, COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_balance, MAX(p.payment_amt) AS max_payment, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no AND ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no AND m.region_no = co.region_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 430001.29 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.issue_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (p.payment_dt IS NULL OR p.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01') GROUP BY c.category_desc, r.region_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 7129816.49 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 183 AND AVG(m.curr_balance) < -57592.91 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, r.region_name ASC;
