SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_current_balance, SUM(py.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name, c.category_desc) AS region_category_total FROM region r INNER JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment py ON m.member_no = py.member_no AND s.statement_no = py.statement_no INNER JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no INNER JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no INNER JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 8258.22 AND m.curr_balance < 91969.54 AND s.statement_amt > 27357.73 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 8761.78 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) >= 97 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.provider_no) AS unique_providers, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no AND m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN provider pv ON c.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 1903.77 AND m.curr_balance < -1976.69 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM charge c2 JOIN statement s2 ON c2.statement_no = s2.statement_no WHERE c2.member_no = m.member_no AND c2.charge_amt > 880.76 AND s2.statement_amt > 6930.03 ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 12073.95 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) >= 67 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) BETWEEN 1871.46 AND 9812.01 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS distinct_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS distinct_payments, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments FROM region r JOIN provider pr ON r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN charge c ON pr.provider_no = c.provider_no JOIN payment p ON c.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 18581.32 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_member_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS charged_member_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.member_no) AS paying_member_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_per_corp FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2010-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2010-01-01' AND s.due_dt >= '2010-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '2010-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 5455.32 AND (p.payment_amt IS NULL OR p.payment_amt > 1828.35) AND m.curr_balance < -5146.19 AND m.prev_balance < -7797.47 AND pr.expr_dt > '2025-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 26863.65 AND (SUM(p.payment_amt) IS NULL OR SUM(p.payment_amt) < 5972.26) AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) > 28 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, cat.category_no, total_charges DESC;

SELECT s.statement_no, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_amt, SUM(p.payment_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY s.member_no ORDER BY p.payment_dt) AS running_payment_total, COUNT(p.payment_no) OVER (PARTITION BY s.member_no ORDER BY p.payment_dt) AS payment_count, AVG(s.statement_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY m.region_no) AS avg_statement_by_region FROM statement s JOIN member m ON s.member_no = m.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE s.statement_amt > 8211.86 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY s.statement_no, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, s.statement_amt, m.region_no, p.payment_dt, p.payment_amt, p.payment_no ORDER BY m.member_no, p.payment_dt;

SELECT c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.state_prov ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_state FROM charge ch JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE c.category_code LIKE 'A' AND m.state_prov LIKE 'AA' AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt < '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.state_prov HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 5045.44 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 14804.85 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.corp_name, cat.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation c ON m.corp_no = c.corp_no JOIN region r ON c.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 2584.13 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.corp_name, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 6871.1 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.country AS member_country, p.country AS provider_country, cat.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_curr_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no AND m.country = r.country JOIN corporation c ON m.corp_no = c.corp_no AND m.country = c.country JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND p.country = r.country JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND s.member_no = m.member_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND pay.payment_dt BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '1990-01-01' WHERE ch.charge_amt > 715361.28 AND m.curr_balance < -82458.7 AND c.corp_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.country, p.country, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 3433745.76 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 859 UNION ALL SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, NULL AS member_country, p.country AS provider_country, cat.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS total_statements, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, 0 AS total_payments, 0 AS avg_prev_balance, 0 AS avg_curr_balance, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no AND p.country = r.country JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 564848.03 AND p.provider_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, p.country, cat.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 9152403.27 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 143 ORDER BY region_charge_rank, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_code, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 7566.51 AND c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_code ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, c.corp_no, cat.category_no, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_year, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2800.02 AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2020-01-01' AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 4366.56 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, c.corp_no, cat.category_no, statement_year), (r.region_no, c.corp_no, cat.category_no), (r.region_no, c.corp_no), (r.region_no), () ) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 24541.24 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, cat.category_no, statement_year;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY MAX(ch.charge_dt)) AS previous_charge_total FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5610.74 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_amt < 32227.91 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 13577.96 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 21 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, AVG(SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no) AS region_avg_net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS balance_rank_in_region FROM region r JOIN corporation cor ON r.region_no = cor.region_no JOIN member m ON cor.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 234626.64 AND c.charge_amt > 72317.56 AND p.payment_amt > 84946.01 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 894756.15 ORDER BY r.region_no, balance_rank_in_region;

SELECT c.category_code, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_code ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.provider_name) AS provider_total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON s.statement_no = pm.statement_no AND s.member_no = pm.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 46103.31 AND s.due_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_code, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 41316.46 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 44 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, provider_name, lastname;

SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment_amount, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS unique_members, COUNT(DISTINCT SELECT r.region_no, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, COUNT(c.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge c ON p.provider_no = c.provider_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 9212.87 GROUP BY r.region_no, p.provider_no, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 40902.28 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(*) AS total_charges, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = ch.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01') AS member_recent_payments FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1992-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 877.35 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, ch.member_no HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 86735.93 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS total_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, MAX(ch.charge_amt) AS max_charge_amount, MIN(p.payment_amt) AS min_payment_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.corp_no ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank FROM region r INNER JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no INNER JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no LEFT JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 2364.15 AND s.statement_amt BETWEEN 1753.91 AND 7925.23 AND m.curr_balance < -1032.12 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 5 AND SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 47062.24 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) < 2515.42 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, net_balance ASC LIMIT 547;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_corp FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '2020-12-31' AND cat.category_code = 'A' AND pv.provider_code = 'P' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 470281.93 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 56 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 192172.48 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_curr_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT p.statement_no) AS distinct_statements_paid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_rank_global FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no LEFT JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no WHERE ( (ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' OR p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' OR s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01') AND (ch.charge_amt > 132687.54 OR p.payment_amt > 962461.84 OR s.statement_amt > 394979.52) AND NOT (m.country = 'USA' AND m.state_prov IN ('CA','NY')) AND (m.expr_dt > '2024-01-01' OR m.expr_dt IS NULL) AND (c.expr_dt > '2024-01-01' OR c.expr_dt IS NULL) AND (r.region_no IN (38, 22, 84) OR c.corp_no BETWEEN 81 AND 1494) ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 93117.57 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 19358.14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 5 AND (AVG(m.prev_balance) - AVG(m.curr_balance)) > 94474.99 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_payments ASC, region_no, corp_no;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY ch.charge_dt) AS prev_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON m.member_no = pay.member_no AND s.statement_no = pay.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3394.0 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_amt >= 24597.97 AND m.curr_balance <= 72523.12 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, ch.charge_dt HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 9068.18 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 6 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charges, COALESCE(SUM(pm.payment_amt), 0) AS total_payments, COALESCE(AVG(s.statement_amt), 0) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS active_members, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) DESC) AS provider_rank_in_region FROM region r INNER JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no INNER JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no INNER JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.member_no = s.member_no AND ch.statement_no = s.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment pm ON s.statement_no = pm.statement_no AND s.member_no = pm.member_no INNER JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no LEFT JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no AND m.region_no = co.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND (pm.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' OR pm.payment_dt IS NULL) AND s.due_dt <= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 3881.54 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING COALESCE(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 0) > 33336.69 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 40 ORDER BY r.region_no, provider_rank_in_region, total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) AS statement_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1995-01-01') AS recent_payments FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 4964.34 AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 8889.65 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND p.payment_dt <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 9948.14 AND AVG(p.payment_amt) < 754.2 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2453.3 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 44978.98 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 7228.81 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_amt > 540.41) GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 15904.6 ORDER BY total_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.country, m.state_prov, m.city, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.statement_no) AS statements_with_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, MAX(s.due_dt) AS latest_due_date, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region_category FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6574.9 AND s.statement_amt > 5881.38 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.country, m.state_prov, m.city), (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), (m.country, m.state_prov, m.city), () ) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 9551.92 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 53 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no, total_charge DESC, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.country, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SELECT AVG(sub_c.charge_amt) FROM charge sub_c WHERE sub_c.category_no = cat.category_no AND sub_c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND sub_c.charge_dt <= '2020-01-01') AS avg_category_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, MAX(s.statement_dt) AS latest_statement_date FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON c.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 700624.24 AND p.payment_amt > 420722.78 AND s.statement_amt > 683160.81 AND m.curr_balance < -59655.29 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.country, cat.category_no HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > SUM(p.payment_amt) AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) > 339.85 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, latest_statement_date DESC;

SELECT r1.region_no AS region1_no, r2.region_no AS region2_no, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.member_no) AS members_in_region1, COUNT(DISTINCT m2.member_no) AS members_in_region2, AVG(m1.curr_balance) AS avg_balance_region1, AVG(m2.curr_balance) AS avg_balance_region2 FROM region r1 JOIN member m1 ON r1.region_no = m1.region_no JOIN region r2 ON r1.region_no != r2.region_no JOIN member m2 ON r2.region_no = m2.region_no WHERE m1.curr_balance > 3868.16 AND m2.curr_balance > 4315.8 GROUP BY r1.region_no, r2.region_no HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.member_no) > 98 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m2.member_no) > 1 ORDER BY r1.region_no, r2.region_no;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amt, AVG(outer_subquery.avg_charge_per_category) AS overall_avg_charge_per_category FROM member m JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN ( SELECT c.member_no, cat.category_desc, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_per_category FROM charge c JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.member_no, cat.category_desc ) outer_subquery ON m.member_no = outer_subquery.member_no WHERE s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, r.region_name HAVING SUM(s.statement_amt) > 2697.94 ORDER BY overall_avg_charge_per_category DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, COUNT(c.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge c ON p.provider_no = c.provider_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 6188.98 GROUP BY r.region_no, p.provider_no, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 31035.53 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9794.79 AND (m.curr_balance < 923.82 OR m.prev_balance IS NOT NULL) AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 16641.67 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5306.45 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc), (r.region_no, r.region_name), (c.category_no, c.category_desc), () ) ORDER BY r.region_no, c.category_no, total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 8888.44 AND c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS charge_count, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 7362.19 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 29081.0 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) AS statement_count FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider p ON c.provider_no = p.provider_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment pmt WHERE pmt.member_no = m.member_no AND pmt.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' ) GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 3506.12 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS distinct_members FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no AND co.corp_code = 'A' JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND m.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1995-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1995-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 11344.76 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amt, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charge ch2 WHERE ch2.member_no = m.member_no AND ch2.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch2.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01') AS recent_charge_count FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2328.23 AND s.due_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -66312.58 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 486763.17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) >= 21 ORDER BY r.region_no, charge_rank_in_region, total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(c.charge_no) AS charge_count, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, MAX(c.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 3554.69 AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 15845.35 UNION ALL SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(p.payment_no) AS payment_count, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, MAX(p.payment_dt) AS latest_payment_date FROM member m JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE p.payment_amt > 472.1 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(p.payment_amt) > 1660.51 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, member_no;

SELECT r.region_no, c.corp_no, m.member_no, cat.category_no, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS statement_month, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_current_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.provider_no) AS unique_providers FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pv ON ch.provider_no = pv.provider_no AND r.region_no = pv.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3498.97 AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2020-01-01' AND TO_DATE(s.statement_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2022-01-01' AND m.curr_balance > 3631.19 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.region_no, c.corp_no, m.member_no, cat.category_no, statement_year, statement_month), (r.region_no, c.corp_no, cat.category_no, statement_year, statement_month), (r.region_no, cat.category_no, statement_year, statement_month), (r.region_no, statement_year, statement_month), (statement_year, statement_month), () ) HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 10666.2 ORDER BY r.region_no, c.corp_no, m.member_no, cat.category_no, statement_year DESC, statement_month DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.charge_no) AS distinct_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS distinct_payments FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt > 9812.05 AND p.payment_amt > 5310.47 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name ORDER BY distinct_charges DESC, distinct_payments DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.country, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS total_members, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment, MAX(CASE WHEN s.statement_amt > (SELECT AVG(s2.statement_amt) FROM statement s2 WHERE s2.member_no IN (SELECT m2.member_no FROM member m2 WHERE m2.region_no = r.region_no)) THEN s.statement_amt ELSE NULL END) AS max_above_avg_statement, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no AND c.corp_no IS NOT NULL JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND m.member_no IS NOT NULL JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND s.statement_no IS NOT NULL JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND ch.charge_no IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND p.payment_no IS NOT NULL WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 1341.36 AND m.curr_balance < -6029.89 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM provider pr WHERE pr.region_no = r.region_no AND pr.expr_dt > '1990-01-01') > 90.56 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.state_prov, m.country HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > (SELECT AVG(total_charge) FROM (SELECT SUM(ch2.charge_amt) AS total_charge FROM charge ch2 JOIN statement s2 ON ch2.statement_no = s2.statement_no WHERE s2.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY s2.member_no) AS sub) AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 577.19 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, total_members ASC;

SELECT c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statement FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no JOIN member m ON s.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2833.68 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND r.region_no = 2 GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(s.statement_amt) > 630938.83 ORDER BY total_statement DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1783.61 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND r.region_no = 47 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc UNION ALL SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.provider_no) AS unique_providers, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 1257.39 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND r.region_no = 7 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance, (SELECT SUM(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1995-01-01') AS total_recent_payments, (SELECT AVG(s.statement_amt) FROM statement s WHERE s.member_no = m.member_no AND s.statement_dt >= '1995-01-01') AS avg_recent_statement FROM member m JOIN region r ON m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN corporation c ON m.corp_no = c.corp_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 3942.74 AND r.region_name = 'North America' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.curr_balance ORDER BY m.curr_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, COUNT(*) AS total_charges_count FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND m.member_no = pay.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 1748.58 AND m.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 3775.18 AND payment_dt BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-01-01' ) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 59045.17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 60 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_no, category_desc;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = ch.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01') GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 27734.15 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_code, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, CASE WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 35890.06 THEN 'High' WHEN SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 7341.52 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS charge_volume_category FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_code ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 371.1 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation cor ON r.region_no = cor.region_no JOIN member m ON cor.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE (ch.charge_amt > 846.28 OR s.statement_amt < 641.77) AND NOT (c.category_code = 'A' AND ch.charge_dt < '1990-01-01') GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING AVG(ch.charge_amt) > 7513.21 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 5346.62 ORDER BY total_payment DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) FILTER (WHERE ch.charge_code = 'A') AS charge_code_A_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, LAG(SUM(pay.payment_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.member_no ORDER BY MAX(s.statement_dt)) AS prev_member_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND m.member_no = pay.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7957.88 AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND p.provider_no > 75044 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 56241.7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) >= 98 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount, SUM(st.statement_amt) AS total_statement_amount, AVG(st.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(pm.payment_amt) AS total_payment_amount, AVG(pm.payment_amt) AS avg_payment_amount, SUM(m.prev_balance) AS total_prev_balance, SUM(m.curr_balance) AS total_curr_balance, (SUM(st.statement_amt) - SUM(pm.payment_amt)) AS net_outstanding, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(st.statement_amt) DESC) AS statement_rank_overall FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement st ON m.member_no = st.member_no JOIN payment pm ON st.member_no = pm.member_no AND st.statement_no = pm.statement_no JOIN charge ch ON st.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 986.14 AND st.statement_amt > 26741.48 AND pm.payment_amt > 3436.41 AND m.curr_balance < 63823.08 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND st.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND pm.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND r.region_no IN (7, 1, 1) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_desc, p.provider_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 30246.27 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 82 AND AVG(st.statement_amt) > 7763.22 AND SUM(pm.payment_amt) < 40694.63 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC, net_outstanding DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_amt), 0)) AS net_balance FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9179.09 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.member_no IN (SELECT s.member_no FROM statement s WHERE s.statement_amt > 44400.65 AND s.due_dt >= '1990-01-01') GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 87932.19 ORDER BY net_balance DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, p.provider_name, r.region_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.country, m.state_prov, m.city, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(py.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(st.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT py.statement_no) AS statements_with_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(py.payment_amt) AS net_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_by_region, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(py.payment_amt) DESC) AS payment_dense_rank, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY m.country, m.state_prov ORDER BY m.city) AS prev_city_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no JOIN region r ON p.region_no = r.region_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN statement st ON ch.statement_no = st.statement_no LEFT JOIN payment py ON ch.member_no = py.member_no AND ch.statement_no = py.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 3611.69 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND st.statement_amt > 11102.63 AND py.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -32658.99 GROUP BY c.category_desc, p.provider_name, r.region_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.country, m.state_prov, m.city HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 72390.27 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) > 61 ORDER BY net_amount DESC, charge_rank_by_region;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, c.category_code, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_dt, MIN(ch.charge_dt) AS earliest_charge_dt FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no JOIN region r ON co.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9999.99 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -4350.43 GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc, c.category_code HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 81067.64 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) >= 108 UNION ALL SELECT p.provider_no, p.provider_name, p.provider_code, SUM(ch2.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch2.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, COUNT(DISTINCT ch2.member_no) AS unique_members, MAX(ch2.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_dt, MIN(ch2.charge_dt) AS earliest_charge_dt FROM provider p JOIN charge ch2 ON p.provider_no = ch2.provider_no JOIN member m2 ON ch2.member_no = m2.member_no JOIN corporation co2 ON m2.corp_no = co2.corp_no JOIN region r2 ON co2.region_no = r2.region_no WHERE ch2.charge_amt > 7940.15 AND ch2.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch2.charge_dt <= '1990-01-01' AND m2.curr_balance < -2182.31 GROUP BY p.provider_no, p.provider_name, p.provider_code HAVING SUM(ch2.charge_amt) > 95123.95 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch2.member_no) >= 434 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.firstname, m.lastname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(p.payment_no) AS payment_count FROM member m JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.charge_dt = p.payment_dt WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9756.66 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.firstname, m.lastname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 30798.19 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) AS charge_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_no) AS payment_count, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement_amount, SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 5008.36 AND s.statement_amt > 48911.45 AND p.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 41149.42 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_no) > 40 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) < 48961.95 AND AVG(s.statement_amt) > 6537.86 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, net_balance DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, COUNT(ch.charge_no) AS total_charges, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amount, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amount FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no LEFT JOIN corporation co ON m.corp_no = co.corp_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 6521.57 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (co.corp_code = 'A' OR m.member_code = 'A' OR co.corp_code IS NULL) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 46517.28 ORDER BY total_charge_amount DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, COUNT(c.charge_no) AS charge_count, COALESCE(SUM(c.charge_amt), 0) AS total_charges FROM member m LEFT JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE m.curr_balance > 6549.81 AND (c.charge_dt IS NULL OR c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01') GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING COUNT(c.charge_no) < 29 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4114.19 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < 4646.95 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 43730.04 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS statements_with_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT p.statement_no) AS statements_with_payments, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(SUM(ch.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name, c.category_desc ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS prev_category_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation co ON r.region_no = co.region_no JOIN member m ON co.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2686.23 AND s.statement_amt >= 39306.83 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.due_dt <= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 10054.6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) > 30 ORDER BY r.region_name, total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(p.payment_amt) AS avg_payment FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5636.54 AND p.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > (SELECT AVG(charge_amt) FROM charge WHERE charge_amt > 7730.79) ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM region r JOIN provider p ON r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN charge ch ON p.provider_no = ch.provider_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 2258.0 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.curr_balance < -4920.07 GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 49148.38 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.corp_no, c.corp_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, COUNT(DISTINCT p.provider_no) AS distinct_providers, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.category_no) AS distinct_categories, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.charge_code) AS distinct_charge_codes, COUNT(DISTINCT s.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, COUNT(DISTINCT py.payment_no) AS distinct_payments, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(s.statement_amt) AS total_statements, SUM(py.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(m.prev_balance) AS avg_prev_balance, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_curr_balance, MAX(ch.charge_dt) AS latest_charge_date, MIN(ch.charge_dt) AS earliest_charge_date FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN payment py ON s.statement_no = py.statement_no AND m.member_no = py.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 5181.07 AND s.statement_amt > 36288.99 AND py.payment_amt > 11567.65 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND py.payment_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND m.issue_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND c.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND p.expr_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.corp_no, c.corp_name HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 213848.01 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) > 72.48 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.provider_no) > 42.67 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, distinct_members DESC, distinct_providers DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS balance_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND s.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND s.statement_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 8229.39 AND m.curr_balance < 4221.02 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 47890.47 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 2 ORDER BY r.region_no, balance_rank;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 781.63 GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 2679.14 AND COUNT(*) >= 14 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND ch.member_no IN (SELECT member_no FROM member WHERE region_no = 15) GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 55728.09 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = ch.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01') GROUP BY c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 76665.81 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(pay.payment_amt) AS total_payments, AVG(s.statement_amt) AS avg_statement, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) AS distinct_statements_charged, COUNT(DISTINCT pay.statement_no) AS distinct_statements_paid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank, SUM(SUM(ch.charge_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no) AS corp_total_charges FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider p ON ch.provider_no = p.provider_no AND r.region_no = p.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no LEFT JOIN payment pay ON s.statement_no = pay.statement_no AND m.member_no = pay.member_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 4679.13 AND s.statement_amt >= 29017.05 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, p.provider_no, p.provider_name, cat.category_no, cat.category_desc, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 16862.67 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ch.statement_no) >= 20 ORDER BY r.region_no, total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 78041.28 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, m.member_no, SUM(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.category_no) AS region_category_total, AVG(ch.charge_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no) AS region_avg_charge FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 9685.74 AND ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, m.member_no, ch.charge_amt ORDER BY region_category_total DESC;

SELECT c.category_no, c.category_desc, AVG(ch.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges FROM category c JOIN charge ch ON c.category_no = ch.category_no JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND ch.member_no IN (SELECT m.member_no FROM member m WHERE m.region_no = 12) GROUP BY c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 439496.0 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no AND m.member_no::integer = c.member_no::integer JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND m.member_no::integer = p.member_no::integer JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND m.member_no::integer = s.member_no::integer WHERE c.charge_amt > 4386.15 AND p.payment_amt > 1520.36 AND s.statement_amt > 2038.59 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 35701.28 AND SUM(p.payment_amt) > 20728.61 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_payments_count FROM member m JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN statement st ON ch.statement_no = st.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2023-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 748.43 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 5287.24 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.member_no) AS unique_members FROM charge ch JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no JOIN member m ON ch.member_no = m.member_no JOIN corporation corp ON m.corp_no = corp.corp_no JOIN region r ON corp.region_no = r.region_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_amt > 3068.68 AND ch.member_no IN ( SELECT member_no FROM payment WHERE payment_amt > 4556.91 AND payment_dt >= '2019-01-01' ) GROUP BY r.region_name, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 44254.67 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS distinct_members, AVG(m.curr_balance) AS avg_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ch.charge_amt) DESC) AS region_charge_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no AND m.region_no = r.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category c ON ch.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON m.member_no = p.member_no AND ch.statement_no = p.statement_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 7278.68 AND ch.charge_dt >= '1990-01-01' AND (p.payment_dt IS NULL OR p.payment_dt <= '1990-01-01') GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.category_no, c.category_desc HAVING SUM(ch.charge_amt) > 91415.48 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) >= 290 ORDER BY total_charges DESC, region_charge_rank;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(*) AS charge_count, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_payment) FROM (SELECT MAX(p.payment_amt) AS max_payment FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY p.member_no) sub) AS max_payment_last_period FROM region r JOIN member m ON r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '1992-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 52113.83 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, m.lastname, m.firstname, m.member_no, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charge_amt, AVG(c.charge_amt) AS avg_charge_amt, COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) AS distinct_statements, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_payments_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p2.payment_amt), 0) FROM payment p2 WHERE p2.member_no = m.member_no AND p2.payment_dt BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2023-12-31') AS payment_sum_in_period, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS charge_rank_in_region, LAG(SUM(c.charge_amt), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amt) DESC) AS prev_member_charge FROM region r JOIN corporation corp ON r.region_no = corp.region_no JOIN member m ON corp.corp_no = m.corp_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge c ON s.statement_no = c.statement_no JOIN provider pv ON c.provider_no = pv.provider_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND c.charge_amt > 12696.72 AND s.statement_amt > 79511.32 AND cat.category_code = 'A' GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 338814.08 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) > 6 ORDER BY r.region_name, total_charge_amt DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_no) AS member_count, (SELECT AVG(p.payment_amt) FROM payment p WHERE p.member_no = m.member_no AND p.payment_dt >= '2023-01-01') AS avg_recent_payment FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN statement s ON m.member_no = s.member_no JOIN charge ch ON s.statement_no = ch.statement_no AND m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no AND r.region_no = pr.region_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no WHERE ch.charge_amt > 599.74 AND s.statement_amt >= 346.19 AND m.curr_balance <= 6712.1 GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, m.member_no HAVING COUNT(ch.charge_no) > 13 AND SUM(ch.charge_amt) < 6878.33 ORDER BY member_count DESC, avg_recent_payment DESC;

SELECT m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges, COUNT(DISTINCT c.statement_no) AS statement_count FROM member m JOIN charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no JOIN category cat ON c.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider p ON c.provider_no = p.provider_no WHERE c.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment pmt WHERE pmt.member_no = m.member_no AND pmt.payment_dt >= '2020-01-01' ) GROUP BY m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING SUM(c.charge_amt) > 6666.48 ORDER BY total_charges DESC;

SELECT r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname, SUM(ch.charge_amt) AS total_charges, SUM(p.payment_amt) AS total_payments, (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) AS net_balance, AVG(SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no, c.corp_no) AS avg_net_balance_per_corp, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_no ORDER BY (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) DESC) AS region_net_balance_rank FROM region r JOIN corporation c ON r.region_no = c.region_no JOIN member m ON c.corp_no = m.corp_no AND r.region_no = m.region_no JOIN charge ch ON m.member_no = ch.member_no JOIN category cat ON ch.category_no = cat.category_no JOIN provider pr ON ch.provider_no = pr.provider_no LEFT JOIN statement s ON ch.statement_no = s.statement_no AND m.member_no = s.member_no LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.statement_no = p.statement_no AND m.member_no = p.member_no WHERE ch.charge_dt >= '2020-01-01' AND ch.charge_dt <= '2023-12-31' AND ch.charge_amt > 7519.24 AND (s.statement_dt >= '2019-01-01' OR s.statement_dt IS NULL) GROUP BY r.region_no, r.region_name, c.corp_no, c.corp_name, m.member_no, m.lastname, m.firstname HAVING (SUM(ch.charge_amt) - SUM(p.payment_amt)) > 17006.31 ORDER BY r.region_no, region_net_balance_rank, net_balance DESC;
